4003.meaning: two similar things that go together as a set
4003.scene: Top-down view of two people standing toe to toe on a wooden floor. One wears bright yellow slippers with big googly eyes and a pink tongue sticking out; the other wears a matching set in green. They shuffle their feet until the two sets line up facing each other like cartoon monsters.

4005.meaning: turned to ice or completely covered in ice
4005.scene: A first-person view looking down the body of a climber in a red jacket standing on a glacier. Both gloved hands hold ice axes and the boots below wear steel crampons biting into the surface. The climber swings an axe into a bulging wall of blue-white ice and works up it.

4009.meaning: people or things standing one beside another
4009.scene: A cartoon flock of white ducks waddles down a winding gravel path through a bright green alpine valley. They walk one behind another in a long unbroken row, orange feet slapping the gravel, with dandelions, a wooden fence and a farmhouse on the hillside behind them.

4022.scene: A small white propeller plane is airborne over a city, with a river and a distant skyline behind it and rows of houses far below. A woman in a pink shirt sits in the open doorway, then steps out onto the wing and stands upright with her arms spread wide while the plane keeps flying. She crouches back down, holds the wing with both hands and climbs back inside. The plane flies on alone with the pilot visible in the cockpit.

4023.scene: Seen from above, a young man in swim shorts jumps off a bridge into a green river and drops towards a blue inflatable dinghy where two friends are lying. He hits the water beside them with a big splash and disappears under the surface. He comes up, grabs the side of the dinghy and hauls himself on board. All three end up standing and grappling on the wobbling dinghy, laughing and shoving each other while small motorboats sit moored along the wooded bank.

4024.meaning: to go or travel behind someone
4024.scene: A man in a white shirt and yellow rubber boots stands at the open door of a red barn on a muddy farmyard. Brown hens stream out of the doorway past him. A goat, a large black and pink pig and a goose come out next and walk after him, and the camera backs away as they come. Finally three white alpacas walk out of the barn and follow the camera closely, the leading one filling the frame with its face.

4030.meaning: a large public area of land with grass and trees
4030.scene: In a large public park with mown lawns, bare trees, benches and a gravel path, a man in a dark jacket walks along the narrow stone rim of a round ornamental pond. Orange and white koi swim just under the surface below him. He wobbles, throws one arm up to keep his balance and topples in with a huge splash. He sits up soaked in the waist-deep water while people walk past on the path behind, then hauls himself back over the stone rim.

4038.meaning: to have great affection for someone
4038.scene: A convertible car drives at night along a resort road lined with lit palm trees and low houses. Inside, a young man drives with one hand on the wheel and a young woman in a pale yellow cardigan sits beside him; they glance at each other and smile. She reaches across and lays her hand palm up on his knee, he takes it, and they hold hands over the centre console. The last shot is a close-up of their two hands raised together with the fingers interlocked.

4040.meaning: the food you eat at one time
4040.scene: A couple sit at a square table with a white cloth on a beach at dusk, palm trees and the sea behind them and a lantern with a lit candle in the middle of the table. A waiter in a white jacket sets down their food and steps back. In front of the woman is a plate of green salad; in front of the man a burger with a pile of chips. He picks the burger up in both hands and takes a big bite, then grins at the camera. The two of them talk and laugh over their plates with wine glasses beside them.

4044.scene: At a floodlit driving range at night, a woman in a red hoodie, grey leggings, white trainers and a white cap stands on a green mat with a club, a ball teed up in front of her. She settles into her stance, swings the club back over her shoulder and hits the ball out into the dark field, then follows through and watches it fly. A man in a beige hoodie stands on the next bay watching her.

4045.meaning: to discover something or where it is
4045.scene: In the living room of a stone-and-wood villa a man in a dark blue shirt and white shorts is looking for something: he turns on the spot, pats himself down, leans over the sofa and checks around the cushions while a woman in a cream robe sits on the sofa watching him. The camera cuts to a sunlit stone ledge by the window where two magazines, a bunch of car keys and a black phone are lying. Back inside, the man walks past the sofa holding the phone up, smiling, and the woman looks up at him.

4047.meaning: leisure time away from work for rest or fun
4047.scene: A couple lies together on a wide cushioned daybed under a wooden pavilion at a beach resort, with an infinity pool, palm trees and the sea behind them and the sky orange and pink at sunset. The man in a white sleeveless top and sunglasses holds a phone; the woman beside him in a green bikini and a white shirt talks and gestures, then pulls her sunglasses down onto her face. She settles against his chest and he puts his arm around her while they watch the sunset.

4049.scene: On a wide white-sand beach under a clear blue sky, a man in red shorts crouches between two tall stacks of turquoise sun loungers. He lifts both stacks at once onto his shoulders and walks across the sand carrying them, the loungers towering far above his head so only his legs and red shorts are visible beneath. He crosses the empty beach past parasols and the sea, then sets the whole load down and lines the loungers up in a row with the others.

4050.meaning: a person you know well and like a lot
4050.scene: Two young men stand barefoot on the open tailgate of a van in the desert at sunrise with their fists raised, cheering. The white van drives along a coast road above the ocean. Inside, the van is lined with pale wood and fairy lights, and a black dog in a red bandana lies on a wooden bunk while a hand reaches in to stroke it. At night four friends and the dog sit in camping chairs in a circle around a small fire pit in the sand beside the lit van. Finally the four of them and the dog sit in a row on the tailgate, backs to the camera, watching an orange sunset over the sea.

4083.scene: An animated shot filmed straight down onto a bed at night. A woman and a bearded man sleep on either side, with a small pug lying between them. The pug slowly stretches out and spreads its legs, pushing the two people further and further towards the edges of the bed. By the end the humans have been pushed off completely — only their hands still grip the sides of the mattress — and the pug lies alone, spread out flat in the exact middle of the bed.

4084.meaning: the upper part of the body, above the neck
4084.scene: An animated bald man in a red robe stands in a gold and green marble bathroom in front of a large mirror, holding up a small gold jar. A hairless sphynx cat sits on the washbasin beside him. A golden drop falls onto the cat's bare head and onto the man's bald head. Both heads sprout enormous hair: the man grows long thick black curls, the cat grows a golden lion's mane. The two admire themselves in the mirror.

4094.scene: A camera mounted on a horse follows its day on a desert ranch. First a close-up of the horse's muzzle dripping water as it drinks from a concrete trough, red rock cliffs behind it. Then a barn corner where a trolley is stacked high with brightly coloured sacks of animal feed in red, blue, green, yellow and pink, with a green shovel leaning beside it. Then a black horse and a chestnut horse stand nose to nose eating pale green hay from a big round metal feeder at sunrise. Finally the horse walks down a dirt road lined with tall golden poplars.

4095.meaning: a story told with moving pictures and sound
4095.scene: A behind-the-scenes clip from a film shoot in a red-rock desert at dusk. First the finished-looking action: a yellow muscle car races down an empty desert highway chased by a police car with flashing lights, then a shot from inside the car looking out through the windscreen at the setting sun. Then the camera pulls back to the reality: a young crew in hoodies and jeans stand in the sand around a monitor on a wheeled cart, watching the same shot play back, some holding tablets and notes. The last shot shows two pickup trucks parked on a dirt track under an orange and pink sunset sky.

4096.meaning: able to do what you want, not held back
4096.scene: Underwater on bright white sand in clear turquoise water. A green sea turtle is tangled in a heavy brown rope net, unable to move. Two snorkellers in fins hold the turtle steady and work at the ropes with their hands, then one cuts the strands away with a black-handled knife. They peel the net back off the shell and flippers. Freed, the turtle glides away over the pale sand, its shadow following beneath it.

4097.scene: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a dry dirt jump park under a blue sky. Ahead of the camera another rider hurtles up a huge sloping ramp of packed orange earth and launches high into the air, hanging above the ridge. The point-of-view rider races after him down the trail, the ground blurring past the front tyre as he drops through bermed corners and along the side of a green and brown hill, chasing the rider ahead across the jumps.

4100.meaning: an opening into or through something
4100.scene: A quiet bedroom with pale green walls, a wooden bed, a rug and a bedside table with a red digital clock. A man lies stretched out on the bed. Suddenly the ceiling bursts open and an enormous steel coil spring shoots down through it, punching a ragged hole in the plasterboard and driving straight through the floorboards into another hole below. Broken laths and clouds of white mattress stuffing rain down over the room. The man is left face-down on the floor in the debris, then picks himself up, stands and brushes the fluff off his clothes.

4104.meaning: the act of caressing someone with the lips
4104.scene: An animated park scene with cartoon pigeons. A small grey pigeon stands beside a much larger dark blue pigeon that leans over it; the small one glares up with narrowed eyes. A white pigeon with pink feathers stands next to it, half-closing her eyes. The camera holds close on the small grey pigeon while its eyebrows lower and its face turns sour. At the end the white pigeon leans in and presses her beak to its cheek in a kiss; the grey pigeon's cheeks turn bright red and it keeps scowling while blushing.

4106.meaning: feeling a need to eat food
4106.scene: A bearded man sits at a wooden dining table in front of a big white plate piled with creamy spaghetti. A brown dachshund is propped up behind him with its head peeping over his shoulder. Each time the man lifts a forkful of spaghetti, the dog stretches its neck around and grabs the strands from the fork before they reach his mouth, so the spaghetti hangs from the dog's jaws. The man pulls faces at the camera, wide-eyed and then laughing, while the dog keeps licking its lips and going back for more.

4108.meaning: a married man, a woman's partner in marriage
4108.scene: An animated city street. A tiny round red car covered in printed smiley faces is parked at the kerb. Inside sit two cartoon birds: a blue-green pigeon in the passenger seat, grinning, and a white and pink bird at the wheel wearing white gloves, glaring furiously ahead. The white bird scowls at the car while the pigeon beams. The camera pulls back to show the whole car from the side, with the words 'I'm her husband.' written large along the red door, and the white bird standing outside on the pavement with folded wings while the pigeon waves happily from the driver's window.

4113.meaning: an adornment such as a ring or necklace
4113.scene: An animated city street at sunset with cartoon pigeons on the pavement. A small grey pigeon wears a glowing pink diamond ring that sparkles and casts pink light over its feathers. A white pigeon with pink-tinted feathers leans in beside it, admiring the ring with wide eyes and an open beak, while a huge dark pigeon with heavy eyelids looms over both of them in the background. The white pigeon presses herself against the grey one, then rears up, opens her beak wide and shouts with one wing raised. At the end the two walk off together side by side down the street, the ring still glowing between them.

4129.meaning: the house or flat someone is living in
4129.scene: A grey-blue front door swings open from the inside, showing the hallway of the house behind it: polished wooden floorboards, a carpeted staircase with a striped runner and pictures on the wall. A golden retriever puppy in a mint green bucket hat, a purple harness and a red lead comes trotting out of the hallway, over the threshold and down the brick front steps of the house. Outside, it walks along the pavement in the sunshine with its owner's legs and red lead beside it, past a wooden fence, front gardens and a parked car, tongue out and hat still on.

4131.scene: A barber's shop with a deep green wall filling the whole background, a mirror and a framed picture hanging on the green paint, and green plants on the counter. A chimpanzee sits in the chair in a green cape with its eyes shut and a big round afro. A ginger cat in a white coat, standing on a wooden stool, works through the hair with a hot styling tool that sends up a puff of steam. The afro comes out sleek and straight, cut into a shiny black bob, and the chimpanzee turns to the camera and grins with the green wall and the green cape all around it.

4133.meaning: an electric refrigerator that keeps food cold
4133.scene: A kitchen with white cupboards and a dark polished wooden floor. A tall stainless steel fridge with a double door, an ice and water dispenser in the left-hand door and a freezer drawer underneath stands against the wall, and a raised metal dog bowl in a wooden stand sits next to it. A man in pink pyjamas crouches down on the floor in front of the fridge next to a golden retriever that is lying there, strokes its back and talks to it. He goes down onto his knees, then lies right down on the floor with his arms round the dog and his head against it, while a second golden retriever lies stretched out on the floor in the foreground.

4134.meaning: having a lot of flesh on the body
4134.scene: A barber's shop with a mirror and shelves of bottles. On the black leather seat of the barber's chair sits a very round, very plump hedgehog, so fat that its little legs and paws stick out sideways from a body shaped almost like a ball, with a big round belly hanging over its feet. A ginger cat in a white coat and red bow tie leans in with a pair of electric clippers and runs them over the hedgehog's back, shaving off all the spines. They fall away onto the seat and leave a completely bare, smooth, pale, round body sitting there. The hedgehog looks down at itself, its eyes go wide and its mouth drops open in horror, while the cat covers its own face with a paw.

4138.scene: A man in a white cap kneels on the tarmac drive outside a house and holds out both hands as an old golden retriever steps out of the open door towards him. He takes its head in both hands, rubs its ears and cheeks and kisses the top of its nose. The next shot is inside the open boot of a car, where the dog sits on a blanket beside him with a pink lead and licks at a small tub of vanilla ice cream he holds out. Then in the fenced back garden the dog runs to him across the grass and he crouches down, laughing, and rubs both hands through the fur of its back and sides.

4147.scene: At night in an empty car park in front of a fast-food restaurant, a man in a dark hoodie and cap runs towards a lit-up yellow arch sign. He grabs the sign, pulls it free and hurries back across the tarmac carrying the big yellow piece under his arm. He shoves it through the door of a waiting car, climbs in after it, and the last shot is his face inside the car, laughing, with the yellow sign filling half the frame.

4153.meaning: a major road for motor traffic
4153.scene: Filmed from inside a car driving on a highway, the shot looks over the bonnet at a bright blue sports car with a big rear wing driving in the same lane ahead. The highway runs straight ahead with white lane markings and a metal crash barrier on the left, green fields and villages on both sides. In front of them stands a wall of grey rocky mountains with snow on the peaks and a long white band of cloud lying across the slopes.

4159.meaning: at a great height in the air
4159.scene: A point-of-view shot from someone hanging in a harness, with their bare legs and blue-soled trainers dangling in the bottom of the frame. They sweep fast over a steep green mountain meadow, the grass blurring underneath them, and then the ground drops away and they are flying high above a valley. Dark pine forest runs down both sides, a small road winds through the fields below, and the grey rocky peaks of the Dolomites stand against a deep blue sky.

4161.scene: Two old sports cars stand nose to nose on a concrete driveway in front of a tall green hedge. The camera holds on the front of an orange car on the left, with its round chrome headlight and chrome mirror, and the front of a yellow car on the right, with its indicator and chrome bumper. The camera moves slowly so the two fronts almost touch in the middle of the frame. At the end a man in dark blue overalls and a cap leans over the front of the yellow car and works on it.

4169.meaning: the act of turning your eyes toward something
4169.scene: A man in an Alaska cap and a black hood films himself from a canoe on a wide green river with bushes along the bank. Two brown bears are swimming in the water behind him and one of them comes right up alongside the boat. He keeps his face to the camera and turns only his eyes for a long sideways look at the bear beside him, then relaxes into a grin as it swims past.

4177.meaning: the opening you eat and speak through
4177.scene: A hen runs over a grassy hilltop at sunset carrying a small cloth sack, then climbs a sheer grey rock face with the sack in her beak. At a ledge she tips grain out of the sack into a nest where three grey hawk chicks stretch up with their mouths open wide to be fed. At night the adult hawk lands in front of her beside the sack, wings spread and eyes hard on her.

4181.meaning: to make something available to someone
4181.scene: In an empty car park at sunset an old woman in a bright pink cardigan sits on a red mobility scooter. Someone in front of her holds out a round turquoise cake covered in rainbow sprinkles on a white board and presses silver 1, 0 and 0 candles into the icing. She drives the scooter after the cake, laughing, and reaches out both hands for the plate as it is held towards her.

4182.scene: A young man in a cap crouches on a big garden lawn and sprays purple paint onto the grass through a hose-fed spray gun, leaving coloured shapes behind him. He then leads an elderly white-haired woman, blindfolded with a red cloth, across the freshly painted grass. She takes the blindfold off, gasps with both hands at her face, then sits and lies back on the lawn laughing while a drone rises above her. The camera pulls up to reveal the whole lawn painted as a giant picture reading HAPPY 100 BIRTHDAY GRANPA with orange stars and blue gift boxes.

4183.meaning: something you are given for free
4183.scene: A young man walks an elderly white-haired woman along a garden path towards a gift box taller than she is, wrapped in white paper with a wide red ribbon and a big red bow. He points at it and she pulls the front panel open like a door. A second young man steps out of the box holding a huge bunch of red heart-shaped balloons and spreads his arms. She raises her hands to her face, then hugs him tightly while the first man stands smiling beside them.

4190.scene: A ginger and white cat sits on a low stone ledge outside a zoo enclosure, at the black iron bars. On the other side a huge male lion with a dark mane walks straight up to the bars and lowers its head until its face is right in front of the cat, the two noses almost touching through the bars. A lioness comes up behind and bares her teeth. The cat stays sitting where it is; the lions turn and walk away across the muddy enclosure, and the cat sits calmly at the bars with visitors watching in the distance.

4197.meaning: after the usual or expected time
4197.scene: A cartoon: a round white character with a red cap lies in bed under a blue duvet in a sunlit bedroom, an alarm clock on the bedside table. It picks up its phone, sees 7:01 on the red screen, frowns, puts the phone down and goes back to sleep with a happy smile. Time passes, the light in the room turns brighter. It picks the phone up again and the screen now reads 10:50. Its eyes go wide, it throws the blue duvet up into the air and shoots out of the room, leaving the bare mattress, the flying blanket and a puff of dust behind.

4215.meaning: the orange color, like the fruit
4215.scene: A couple pose in a white panelled room, their outfits changing from shot to shot. First she wears an orange halter top with wide white trousers while he wears a white linen shirt with orange trousers. Then she is in an orange vest with navy wide trousers and he in a navy shirt with the same orange trousers. Next both are in pink, hers an off-shoulder puff-sleeved top with grey trousers, his a pink linen shirt with grey trousers. Finally she wears a rust top with a pleated olive skirt and he a sage shirt with rust trousers.

4217.scene: A corgi drives a small green go-kart straight down the middle of a quiet suburban street of brick houses, its tongue hanging out and its paws up on the steering wheel. Behind it a white police car with POLICE across the bonnet chases it with its blue and red lights flashing, getting closer and closer until it fills the shot right behind the kart, while the corgi keeps driving without looking back.

4242.scene: A ginger-and-white cat and a tabby cat sit side by side on a dark polished tiled hallway floor, looking up at the camera. A tall white metal safety gate blocks the doorway behind them. The ginger cat walks up to the gate and slips between its bars into the dark room beyond. The tabby then crosses to a small square cat flap set low in the white wall next to the gate, pushes its head through and squeezes its whole body out, until only its striped tail is left in the hallway.

4243.meaning: to give money for goods or services
4243.scene: A black cat in a red apron works behind a street hot dog stand while a husky stands at the grill behind it turning sausages with tongs. A customer's hand holds a turquoise bank card out to the card reader on the counter. The cat lays a sausage into a long bun, then squeezes a zigzag of ketchup along it from a red bottle, and finally lifts the finished hot dog up to the camera.

4248.scene: A huge artificial wave pool inside a hall, with a steel roof, rows of ceiling lights and windows along the upper wall. A big turquoise wave rolls across the pool and a person on an orange board rides down its face before the white foam swallows them. The wave collapses into churning white water that fills the frame, and the person is left swimming through the foam. Staff in red stand watching on the concrete deck above.

4268.meaning: an enthusiastic supporter of a sport
4268.scene: In a pale living room a big brown dog sits bolt upright on the sofa like a person, front paws resting on a small black and white football, head turned to a wall-mounted television showing a live football match. A man in checked pyjama trousers lies stretched out on the sofa behind it, half watching. A low table in front holds white roses in a vase and two mugs.

4272.meaning: made from or covered with gold
4272.scene: A woman in a plain white shirt and black trousers stands in a clothes shop between rails of colourful dresses. One by one she puts on shining gold pieces: big gold hoop earrings, then fine gold chains at her neck, then a thick stack of gold bangles on her wrist, then a red belt with a heavy gold buckle. She finishes the look with a wide straw hat, sunglasses and two bags and presents herself to the camera.

4293.meaning: an airplane powered by jet engines
4293.scene: A watercolour of a twin-engine passenger jet climbing steeply away just after take-off with its landing gear still down, filling the sky above an airport; below it runs a long runway with centre-line markings, an orange windsock on a pole, a lit runway edge light, and in the distance the control tower and terminal with parked aircraft, all under peach-coloured evening clouds with a flock of small birds.

4294.meaning: in a low position, near the ground
4294.scene: A plane spotter in a keffiyeh with a DSLR on a strap stands at an airport perimeter fence looking up and grinning; a twin-engine airliner crosses just above the fence behind him, and then a far bigger four-engine jumbo passes directly over his head with its landing gear down, so close that its belly and wheels fill the whole frame while he ducks and laughs.

4303.scene: A sunny narrow street of old apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A white emergency vehicle marked with orange stripes and blue star-of-life symbols is parked at the kerb with its blue lights flashing. The camera moves in on the bonnet and windscreen, then two crew members in yellow high-visibility jackets walk across the road carrying a red bag toward a cafe terrace where people sit at tables.

4304.meaning: the oval ball used in American football
4304.scene: Golden evening light on a suburban street. A bearded man in a cream-and-brown varsity jacket and a grey cap has just released an oval brown ball, which hangs in the air at the top right of the frame. Behind him a white clapboard house flies a striped flag from its porch, a chrome-sided diner stands across the road and an old muscle car is parked at the kerb.

4314.scene: A watercolour of a bright holiday flat seen from the open front door, the key still in the lock. A young man with a backpack wheels a large suitcase in across the terracotta tiles. At the far end a woman pushes open the louvered balcony doors onto a blue sea view and the net curtains billow inward. On the tiled kitchen counter in the foreground stands a bowl holding four round orange fruits and a bunch of purple grapes; a beige sofa with folded towels sits beside it.

4315.meaning: the amount of money something is sold for
4315.scene: A woman in a beige trench coat walks through flats one after another. First a cramped room with a bed pushed against the wall, a boiler above it, a radiator and a small cooker by a narrow window. Then a small living room with a grey sofa and a balcony door, where she sits down and the caption 1,200 EUR appears over her. Finally she stands in a vast empty glass-walled floor high above a city, turning to look around with her mouth open as the caption 10,000 EUR appears.

4320.meaning: a scale drawing of a building
4320.scene: A watercolour of a bright studio with tall windows. A man in a light blue shirt leans over a large wooden table covered with big sheets of technical drawings showing rooms and walls in fine line. He steadies a metal rule with one hand and draws along it with a yellow pencil. Rolled-up sheets, a second pencil, an eraser and an angled desk lamp lie on the table, and a small white card model of a flat-roofed house stands on a base board at the right.

4323.scene: A photograph of a narrow cobbled lane running between rows of brightly painted corrugated-iron houses — red, blue, yellow — with a yellow iron balcony above on the left. The lane narrows away towards a low sun at the far end. In the middle of it a couple dance: a man in a brown waistcoat holds a woman in a long grey skirt in a dance hold, both leaning into a long step.

4329.meaning: the furnishings that make a room ready to use
4329.scene: Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

4331.meaning: walking with regular steps in a procession
4331.scene: A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.

4337.meaning: to get in touch with someone by telephone
4337.scene: An anime-style drawing of an office corridor with glass-walled meeting rooms. A young woman in a teal trouser suit hurries straight towards the camera with a mobile phone wedged between her ear and her shoulder, mouth open in mid-sentence. She clutches a stack of buff folders against her chest with one arm and balances a cardboard tray of four takeaway coffee cups on the other hand. Loose sheets of paper and pens fly out behind her, and two colleagues stand talking further down the corridor.

4345.scene: A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.

4349.meaning: a person who keeps watch over something
4349.scene: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.

4354.scene: A woodcut-style illustration of an autumn wood in ochre, orange and brown. A woman in a chunky knitted jumper, a long knitted scarf and lace-up boots leans back against a thick tree trunk with one hand, swings her right leg forward and sends a fan of dry orange and red leaves flying up off the path in front of her. More leaves spiral down from the bare branches overhead. A squirrel sits on a fallen log beside the leaf-covered path further back, and acorns and chestnuts lie among the leaves in the foreground.

4358.scene: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.

4365.scene: An older woman pulls a tray of just-baked golden rolls out of the oven in a country kitchen. A younger woman in a red apron turns to the camera holding a warm loaf of bread in one hand and a berry tart in the other, mouth open in delight. The table fills with steaming rolls, croissants, loaves and pies straight from the oven, and both women throw their arms up beside it.

4366.meaning: the main activity you do to earn money
4366.scene: A watercolour of a man at work in a bakery. He wears a flour-dusted apron over rolled-up sleeves and holds a long wooden peel with two golden loaves on the end, sliding them out of a glowing brick oven. Smoke drifts up, baguettes hang from a rail, finished rolls sit on the shelves behind him and sacks of flour stand below. He is smiling as he works.

4373.scene: A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.

4376.meaning: sound of any kind, often unpleasant
4376.scene: A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.

4380.scene: A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.

4386.meaning: a sign put up in a public place as an advert
4386.scene: Three bedrooms one after another. The first is a small room whose walls are completely covered with band and film posters and fairy lights; a lad in a hoodie lies back on the bed next to an acoustic guitar. The second is a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman kneels and lays out a futon. The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.

4405.meaning: the activity of doing something for someone's need
4405.scene: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.

4407.meaning: having good health in body or mind
4407.scene: A young man in a neon sports vest stands at a kitchen counter and drops sliced banana into a blender jug already filled with chunks of mango, then adds raspberries and a big handful of fresh spinach. He clamps the lid on and runs the machine until everything turns into a thick orange drink, pours it into a tall glass and holds the full glass up to the camera.

4425.meaning: to direct somebody to do something with authority
4425.scene: A comic book style drawing of a meeting room high in a futuristic city. A tall robot in a business suit leans right over a glass table, one metal hand slammed flat on the surface hard enough to send a cracking flash out from under it, the other arm flung out pointing at the screen on the wall behind him. His visor glows and his mouth is set in a hard grin. A cup has been knocked over and a pen has bounced into the air. Around the table three other robots shrink back, hands raised to their heads, glowing tablets in front of them.

4426.scene: A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.

4430.scene: A soft cartoon of a small child with thick curly brown hair, big brown eyes and pink cheeks, laughing with his mouth wide open. He wears a yellow t shirt, rolled up blue denim shorts, white socks and red trainers, and he is caught mid run with both arms flung out and one foot lifted behind him. In front of his other foot sits a large ball painted with red, blue and yellow stripes and dots. Behind him are rounded green trees, pale grass and a soft blue sky with two white clouds.

4439.meaning: a day or period set aside for celebration
4439.scene: A photograph taken at dusk in a narrow cobbled street between old colonial houses with lit windows and glowing wall lamps. In the middle a young drummer marches towards the camera wearing an enormous headdress of green, blue and gold feathers and a matching feathered shoulder piece over a bare chest, a big wooden barrel drum slung at his waist and a beater raised in his hand. Behind and beside him a whole band of drummers in bright shirts play more drums, dancers in gold costumes move among them, and paper streamers in green, yellow and pink fly through the air with bunting strung overhead and the low sun burning at the end of the street.

4446.meaning: a hard transparent solid that breaks easily
4446.scene: Inside a dark wooden pub, a smiling man in a grey coat leans across a wooden table and knocks his tall glass against another one held by the person filming. Both glasses are full of amber beer with a white head, and you can see the light coming straight through the clear glass and the drink inside. Behind him the pub is fitted with panels of frosted, patterned glass above the bar and beside the windows, with a dartboard, brass beer taps and other drinkers laughing in the background.

4448.meaning: the part of an object you hold to use or move it
4448.scene: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.

4452.meaning: to be the source of pain
4452.scene: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.

4456.meaning: belonging to the present, modern era
4456.scene: A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.

4467.meaning: meat from the thigh of a pig, usually smoked
4467.scene: A woodcut-style illustration of a butcher at work behind his block. He wears a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a green striped apron, and has a heavy moustache. One hand holds a raw steak flat on a thick wooden chopping block while the other swings a big cleaver up above his head, ready to bring it down. Behind him a rail runs across the wall with strings of sausages and whole cured hams hanging from steel hooks, a slab of meat on the bone at the right, and three knives on a wall rack.

4474.meaning: a list of dishes available at a restaurant
4474.scene: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

4476.meaning: a large entrance or reception room
4476.scene: A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.

4477.meaning: one of the twelve parts of the year
4477.scene: An illustration of a man in a colour-blocked polo shirt standing at a wall, lifting the top sheet of a pinned-up calendar with one hand and turning the page over with the other. The sheet underneath shows a grid of squares with one square ringed in red. A red marker hangs from a string beside the calendar and three blank notes are pinned to the wall below it.

4479.scene: A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.

4481.meaning: to bring something to a central point
4481.scene: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

4485.scene: A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.

4487.meaning: having a considerate and helpful nature
4487.scene: A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.

4490.scene: A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.

4497.meaning: to place something into someone's hands
4497.scene: A soft illustration of a small village shop seen from the customer's side of the counter. A dark-haired young shop worker in a floral apron leans over the wooden counter and holds out a single coin between his fingers, while the customer's two open hands reach up from the bottom of the frame to take it. In his other hand he holds a jar he has just scanned. Behind him a conveyor belt carries apples, a pear, oranges and packets towards a paper grocery bag, and shelves of bottles and jars fill the wall.

4501.meaning: a small air-breathing creature with six legs
4501.scene: A soft cartoon illustration of a plump green caterpillar with yellow stripes resting along a big green leaf in a sunny garden. It has a small smiling face with pink cheeks and a row of little round legs gripping the leaf. A bite-shaped piece is missing from the edge of the leaf just in front of it, with one crumb of leaf floating away. Behind it are rounded bushes, pink, blue and yellow flowers and sparkles of light.

4512.meaning: an ordered set of names or items
4512.scene: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

4525.meaning: to give help or assistance to someone
4525.scene: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.

4530.meaning: a story told with moving pictures and sound
4530.scene: A dark cinema drawn in black and white. At the front a wide screen glows bright blue with a blurred moving picture on it, and a broad beam from the projector cuts through the dark air above the rows of seats. Most of the seats are empty and a few silhouetted heads watch from the rows. In the middle a man has jumped up out of his seat and is hurling a bucket of popcorn into the air; the popcorn scatters through the beam and over the seats around him while the man in front of him ducks away.

4531.meaning: corn heated until it bursts into white pieces
4531.scene: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

4535.scene: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.

4548.scene: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.

4550.meaning: after a long delay, at last
4550.scene: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.

4553.meaning: the threadlike growth covering the head
4553.scene: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.

4565.meaning: an object shaped like a ball
4565.scene: An anime-style painting of the inside of a spacecraft. A child in an orange spacesuit with a white life-support pack and a tether floats up to a big round porthole, seen from behind, with both gloved hands pressed against the glass. Filling the window is the earth as one enormous blue and green ball, wrapped in white cloud, with the land masses spread across it. Instrument panels with glowing screens and bundles of cable line the walls, and a strip of black starry sky shows through a second window above.

4567.meaning: affected by a physical or mental problem
4567.scene: A soft cartoon of a young woman standing in a bright room with a bookshelf, potted plants and a sunlit window behind her. She wears an olive green jumper over a white collared shirt. She has turned her head away, screwed her eyes shut and pulled up her arm to cough hard into the crook of her elbow, her cheeks flushed pink, with little motion lines drawn beside her face.

4569.meaning: to cook food in hot oil in a pan
4569.scene: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

4593.meaning: a health facility where patients get treatment
4593.scene: A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.

4596.meaning: the organ of smell in the middle of the face
4596.scene: A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.

4621.meaning: a traveler riding in a vehicle, not driving it
4621.scene: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

4627.meaning: to go away from a place
4627.scene: A stout older man in a flat cap and shirtsleeves waves a white handkerchief above his head, three times over. First he stands beside a city tram stop as a long white tram slides away from the kerb past him. Then he is on a station platform under the overhead wires as a red and cream train pulls out along the track. Finally he stands alone on a stone quay in the sun, waving up at an enormous white cruise ship as it moves off its berth into the deep blue sea, a lighthouse in the distance.

4630.meaning: the shape and style your hair is cut in
4630.scene: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

4660.meaning: a collection of objects laid on top of each other
4660.scene: In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.

4667.meaning: an aircraft with fixed wings and engines
4667.scene: Seen from directly below, a small white and red propeller aeroplane passes low across a clear blue sky and lets a wooden crate fall from underneath it. The crate floats down on a rainbow parachute into open green grassland, where a woman in a striped robe runs up laughing to take it. The aircraft banks and comes round again, its wings and propellers clear against the sky, dropping a line of further crates under coloured parachutes. It flies over a settlement of white round tents while villagers and horses gather in the grass and a woman spreads her arms wide beneath the falling loads.

4671.meaning: a mechanical or electrical device that does work
4671.scene: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

4681.scene: A traveller films herself through a trip in Egypt. First she rides a camel in front of the pyramids with a scarf over her hair. Then she walks through a covered bazaar where hundreds of coloured mosaic-glass lamps hang from the ceiling and the walls, glowing red, blue, orange and green; she reaches up, takes hold of a big blue glass lamp and turns it in her hand, laughing. Finally she stands on the deck of a wooden sailing boat at sunset with her arms spread wide.

4692.scene: In a supermarket a worker in a green polo shirt and apron reaches into a cardboard box full of drink cans standing on the floor by a cold room door. He carries the cans to the aisle and lines them up on a shelf already packed with rows of colourful tins and cans. He straightens the front row so all the labels face out, then picks up the empty flattened box and walks off down the aisle between the full shelves.

4704.meaning: headwear that protects the head from bad weather
4704.scene: A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.

4707.meaning: a person who needs medical care
4707.scene: A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.

4709.meaning: a number of people or things taken as a unit
4709.scene: A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.

4720.scene: A group of teenagers crowd a phone held at arm's length in a bright classroom and take turns pulling faces into it. A girl with curly hair pushes her lips out in a fish pout and rolls her eyes sideways. A boy in glasses shoves his face right up to the lens, then grins with his mouth wide open. A girl with rainbow braids stares with her eyes stretched as wide as they go and her lips pushed forward. At the end the three of them squeeze their heads together and burst out laughing at the camera, mouths wide open, one of them showing her braces, while classmates work at the desks behind.

4724.scene: A woman in black sportswear at a trampoline park. She sits in a pit of red, blue, yellow and green foam cubes with her mouth wide open, laughing hard. She climbs out, walks along the ledge, then jumps back in and lands among the blocks, still laughing with her eyes screwed shut. At the end two women lie side by side in the foam pit laughing together.

4725.meaning: Italian bread dough baked with sauce and cheese
4725.scene: A sunlit farmhouse kitchen where three generations make pizza together. A man stretches a disc of dough in the air while a small boy presses his own ball of dough on the floured worktop and a grandmother rolls out another with a wooden rolling pin. Then a woman and a man carry two finished margherita pizzas out of the oven. The scene moves outside at night to a long table under string lights, where a steaming margherita is set down in front of the whole family and everyone clinks glasses of red wine over the food.

4726.meaning: a person who operates a farm
4726.scene: An older man in a flat cap, checked shirt and rubber boots works his vegetable plot at sunset beside a sunflower field. He bends down and pulls carrots out of the dark soil by their green tops, then throws handfuls of grain out across a freshly seeded bed. He carries a wooden crate along the rows while a dog runs past, and finally stands behind a wooden hand cart loaded with cabbages, marrows and a crate of carrots, smiling and giving a thumbs up.

4727.scene: A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.

4731.meaning: a body of people under a single government
4731.scene: A flag-raising ceremony outside a large curved glass building. A woman in a grey uniform suit hauls on a rope and a flag climbs its pole above her. The shot widens to a long line of women in the same grey suits, each raising a different national flag on a white pole, so that the flags of many countries rise together in a row. Rows of officials in dark suits stand watching in silence, and the final shots show the whole semicircle of flagpoles in front of the glass facade with a large flag flying at the centre.

4741.meaning: to cause something to move by pulling
4741.scene: A young man in yellow waterproof dungarees stands in a small blue and orange wooden fishing boat on open sea below green cliffs. He leans right back with both hands on a fishing rod that is bent almost double, dragging the line up out of the water until a large silver fish breaks the surface on the hook and swings over the side of the boat. He then works a round landing net, hauling it up out of the water and swinging it in over a wooden crate on the deck, where several silver fish are already lying. At the end he lifts the full crate up towards the camera with both hands and grins.

4746.meaning: someone who takes photos as their job
4746.scene: A viewing spot at the end of an airport runway under a bright blue sky, with a row of parked airliners on the apron behind. Two men stand on a low concrete wall with big white telephoto lenses on tripods, one crouched behind his camera with his eye to the viewfinder, tracking a jumbo jet as it comes in to land; a third watches beside them. A young man with bleached hair in a denim jacket leans back in the foreground filming himself and staring straight up. The aircraft passes directly overhead, so low that its whole underside, four engines and lowered landing gear fill the frame, while the photographers swing their lenses up to follow it and the man raises one finger and points at it.

4751.meaning: a person who shows tourists around a place
4751.scene: A woman in an orange jumper films herself while holding a yellow umbrella high above her head so the group behind her can see it. She walks backwards down a narrow cobbled lane between yellow and white houses, and a small group of visitors follows her. She leads them past a yellow tram on rails, along a busy street with more people trailing behind, and turns back to smile at them while a stray dog trots alongside.

4756.meaning: the European country whose capital is Paris
4756.scene: A woman with a red scarf rides a bicycle along a paved riverside path with a long baguette sticking out of the front wicker basket; the Eiffel Tower and a stone bridge over the river fill the background. She then walks between rows of a purple lavender field at dusk with her arms out, turning to laugh at the sky. Finally she sits under the red awning of a pavement cafe at sunset, biting into a croissant with crumbs on the paper in front of her.

4757.meaning: being free, with nothing holding you back
4757.scene: A teenager in a plaid shirt leaps down a flight of stone steps outside a big brick building with both arms flung wide and his mouth open in a shout. He vaults over a metal farm gate onto a country lane at golden hour. He rides a bicycle down an empty road through open fields with both hands off the bars and his arms stretched out to the sides. At the end he stands with the bike on a grassy hilltop above a wide valley, tips his head back to the setting sun and throws his arms open.

4758.meaning: containing as much as is possible
4758.scene: A man in a cream sweater opens a tall fridge-freezer in a bright white kitchen and looks at completely bare shelves. The camera drops to an empty freezer drawer holding only one ice-cube tray. Then hands start loading the shelves: bags of frozen vegetables and berries, tubs, boxes and packets, until every shelf and drawer is packed. The last shot is a wide of the double doors open on a fridge stuffed from top to bottom while the man beams at it.

4766.scene: An elderly woman in a straw hat, blue cardigan and a floral apron pushes open a wooden garden gate under an archway of roses and comes down the path. She walks between tall pink and white hollyhocks, then bends over a bed of tomato plants tied to bamboo canes and turns the ripe red fruit over in her hand. Further along she works between beds of marigolds and dahlias beside a wheelbarrow heaped with cut flowers, then stands in the middle of the beds and throws her arms open.

4767.meaning: a person who looks after a garden
4767.scene: A woman in a wide straw hat, white shirt and a denim work apron with tools in the pockets clips a round clipped bush with a pair of long shears in a formal park garden. She works her way along a row of the round bushes, then swaps the shears for a metal watering can and pours a fan of water over a long bed of pink and white flowers. She finishes walking down the gravel path between the clipped bushes towards the camera, smiling, shears in her gloved hand.

4769.meaning: a barrier that goes around an area
4769.scene: A woman in a denim cap with a plait, an orange fleece and a backpack holds the camera at arm's length on a canyon viewpoint at sunrise. Behind her a wooden post-and-rail fence runs along the rim, closing off the drop. She turns from the camera to the canyon, her mouth open, and swings her free arm out towards the orange-lit rock walls; then she claps her hand over her mouth and keeps staring out over the fence at the canyon.

4771.meaning: a large grand house where a king lives
4771.scene: A red-haired woman in a bright green raincoat opens a series of ever grander gates. First a low white picket gate in a cottage flower garden, then a heavy wooden farm gate with sheep grazing behind it, then tall black iron gates opening onto an avenue of clipped hedges. Finally she grips a huge gold-painted gate and looks through it at an enormous stately palace, then turns to the camera smiling with the palace and its wide gravel forecourt behind her.

4774.meaning: all the people of about the same age alive now
4774.scene: A cartoon garden scene under a blossoming apple tree hung with bunting. A white-haired old woman sits laughing in a floral armchair; a grown man in a shirt and brown trousers stands behind her laughing with his head back; a younger man holds a small boy in dungarees up in the air, and the boy throws his arms wide as a red and yellow beach ball flies above them. A scruffy little dog stands on the grass and a picnic table with a checked cloth sits to the right.

4776.meaning: showing good manners towards other people
4776.scene: A sepia engraving of a man standing on a tree-lined park path. He wears a long tailored coat over a waistcoat, a bow tie and a tall top hat, and has a waxed moustache. With one gloved hand he lifts the top hat off his head in greeting, smiling slightly at the viewer, while his other gloved hand rests on the curved handle of a walking cane. Bare trees and a railing line the path behind him.

4777.meaning: providing useful help to other people
4777.scene: A silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit moves through a city. He holds a cafe door open and waves someone ahead of him inside. In a marble shopping arcade he bends down and picks up a blue patterned scarf that a passer-by has dropped. At a rainy tram stop an elderly woman is standing with heavy paper shopping bags and loose oranges; he steps in and opens his black umbrella over her head. Finally, on a tram, he lifts his straw hat to a seated woman.

4779.meaning: the country in central Europe, capital Berlin
4779.scene: A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.

4781.meaning: to take someone as your husband or wife
4781.scene: An outdoor garden ceremony. A blonde bride in a white dress and veil, tears on her cheeks, slides a ring onto the finger of a groom in a black suit while he laughs with joy. They kiss under a tall flower arch. Confetti falls as they turn hand in hand and walk back down the aisle between rows of clapping guests, past flower arrangements and lavender, and at the end the whole wedding party throws their arms in the air and cheers.

4782.meaning: an open area where people go to play
4782.scene: A sunny asphalt school yard fenced in behind a low building. A girl in denim dungarees with yellow ribbons in her bunches runs up and then hops along a hopscotch grid chalked on the ground, landing with both feet in the numbered squares. Other children swing a long skipping rope to one side, a boy bounces a ball at the back and a teacher watches from behind. At the end her friends rush in and pile into a laughing group hug around her.

4784.meaning: to cause someone to have something
4784.scene: A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

4794.meaning: the mother of your mother or father
4794.scene: A white-haired woman in a flowered apron and oven gloves lifts a hot tray of chocolate-chip cookies out of the oven in a wooden cabin kitchen while a small girl behind her presses her hands together and gasps. Two girls crowd in beside her and she hands each of them a cookie from the tray. She then sits in a wing armchair with a picture book open on her lap, one girl asleep against her shoulder and the other leaning in wide-eyed as she turns the pages. In the last shot she sits at the head of a long garden table with the girls and other adults, all clinking teacups over a plate of the cookies.

4797.meaning: below average in number or quantity
4797.scene: At an outdoor restaurant on an Italian street a young waiter in a white shirt and dark apron stands over a checked tablecloth and grates a large block of hard cheese onto a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce. He keeps going, grinning, as the diner beside him leans in laughing and the cheese buries the pasta. The camera holds on the plate as the shavings pile higher and higher until the food has disappeared under a huge white cone of grated cheese that rises above the wine glasses. In the last shot he holds up the cheese block and grater beside the mountain of cheese and smiles at the camera.

4802.meaning: a building for displaying valuable old objects
4802.scene: A uniformed guard walks through a marble museum hall past bronze statues in glass cases and framed paintings, raises a hand to hold someone back, opens a tall wooden door, points out the way for a family holding a map, then stands in the middle of the skylit hall with his arms folded while visitors walk past.

4807.meaning: having the color between red and yellow
4807.scene: A man in a bright orange sleeveless sports top sits at a weathered wooden table on a sunny sports field and drinks a small glass of orange juice in one go, then lifts the whole glass jug and tips it up over his face, draining it in big greedy gulps, and finally puts it down and breathes out with the empty glasses and the empty jug in front of him.

4814.meaning: to look for and gather things by hand
4814.scene: In a vegetable garden a hand takes a big red tomato off a staked plant hung with green and red fruit. A man drops the tomato into a wicker basket that already holds cucumbers and more tomatoes. In the next shot a man turns the soil with a spade and pale potatoes come up out of the dark earth. A woman in a headscarf kneels behind a full basket and holds a large potato up to the camera in surprise, and finally a couple tip a basket of peppers onto a wheelbarrow already heaped with tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers and potatoes.

4816.meaning: the muscular organ in your chest
4816.scene: A young woman in a neon yellow vest stands on an outdoor basketball court breathing hard with her mouth open after playing. She presses her flat hand onto her chest over her heart and looks down, still panting. A man in a green shirt comes up beside her, puts his hand on her shoulder and stares wide-eyed at the camera; the two of them then lean over the smartwatch on her wrist and both react in shock at the number on it while other players carry on with the ball behind them.

4819.meaning: feeling or showing thanks to someone
4819.scene: A drawing of a wet cobbled street in the rain. A boy in a hooded raincoat crouches down and holds a big umbrella up over an elderly woman in a brown coat whose shopping has burst out of her bag. She is bent over next to him holding what is left of the bag; she is smiling warmly at him with her free arm laid around his shoulders while oranges, tins and a packet lie scattered in the puddles around their feet.

4822.meaning: a short written or spoken communication
4822.scene: A young woman in a white summer playsuit sits on the edge of a bed typing on her phone with both thumbs and grinning at the screen. She carries on reading and typing standing in a bright kitchen, laughing at what she reads. Back in the bedroom she sits cross legged on the bed holding the phone and beaming into the camera, then throws herself backwards onto the covers kicking her legs in the air, and finally pulls the white duvet right over herself so only a foot sticks out.

4824.meaning: to make believe something is real
4824.scene: A girl in full equestrian competition kit - black show jacket, white breeches, tall black boots and a riding helmet - gallops on her own two legs across the sand of an indoor riding arena, holding a stuffed hobby horse on a stick between her knees as if she were riding it. She is laughing, and a wooden pole lies on the sand behind her.

4827.meaning: a coloured substance you put on a surface
4827.scene: A canvas on an easel holds a half-finished sunset over dark mountains. A hand drags a metal palette knife through a thick slab of bright orange paint, spreading it across the sky and leaving ridges of wet colour, then switches to a flat brush and blends the orange into the mountains until the sky glows.

4839.meaning: to change location, to travel or proceed
4839.scene: A montage of one young man shifting heavy things. He leans into the back of a small silver car on a suburban street and shoves it along the kerb. Next he is behind a supermarket trolley in a car park, driving it forward across the tarmac. Then he stands behind a child on a playground swing and sends him forward. In a warehouse he braces his shoulder against a huge wooden crate and tips it along the floor, and finally a group of friends put their hands on a giant stone ball on a grassy hill and roll it over the grass.

4840.meaning: to keep yourself or something from being seen
4840.scene: A dark room where someone is pressed behind a heavy beige curtain with only a hand showing at the gap. Cut to an office, where a grinning man in a blue polo shirt is folded up under a desk with his arms round his knees. Then a small boy in a red shirt presses himself against a wide tree trunk in a park and peers round it with wide eyes. A quiet living room with an empty fireplace swings past, and finally a whole group of people leap up from behind a sofa with their arms in the air as confetti falls.

4841.meaning: a small metal device that turns in a lock
4841.scene: A woman in a denim jacket stands in a hallway looking around with a frustrated frown. She crouches at an open kitchen drawer and rakes through hair ties, tape rolls, markers and packets. She moves into a walk-in wardrobe and pushes along the rail of hanging clothes, then tips a wicker laundry basket full of clothes upside down onto a chest of drawers. Finally she sits on the floor by a pile of clothes and holds a small metal key up to the camera with her mouth open in triumph.

4844.meaning: one of two equal parts of something
4844.scene: In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

4847.meaning: the flat inside surface of a room you walk on
4847.scene: A blue spin mop is pushed across beige kitchen tiles, leaving a wet shine between the grout lines. Cut to a woman in a grey shirt bending over a flat mop in a cream-tiled corridor. Then an older woman with white hair drags a wide dust mop down the aisle of a shop between shelves of bottles. Next a woman works a long-handled mop across the vast polished concrete of an empty warehouse, the ceiling lights reflected in it. Finally she sits down on the gleaming warehouse floor with her arms thrown wide.

4848.meaning: to get bigger gradually, the way a plant does
