4848.scene: Gloved hands press the soil around a small green seedling just set into a terracotta pot on a patio, with other pots and plants behind. Cut to a watering can pouring a wide spray over a raised bed packed with orange, pink and purple flowers beside a wooden house. Then a woman in gloves closes a pair of red secateurs on a stem inside a tall glossy hedge. Next she bends over a vegetable patch and takes hold of a large orange pumpkin among the broad leaves, and finally she straightens up holding the pumpkin against her chest and grins.

4859.meaning: a separate part of something bigger
4859.scene: A woman in a big cardigan and glasses leans over a table scattered with jigsaw pieces in a bright room full of plants and bookshelves. She picks up single pieces and presses them into the picture, the puzzle grows onto the wall, and finally it covers the whole floor as she fits the last pieces in the middle.

4861.scene: A woman in a field vest and big headphones holds a furry microphone and a handheld recorder close to a singing bird in a wood. She crouches to record a stream over stones, raises a long boom microphone up into the green canopy, and finally records beside a thundering waterfall, beaming.

4863.meaning: a series of steps to reach a goal
4863.scene: In an office a woman sticks a green sticky note onto a square of a huge wall calendar, then sits and writes in a colour-tabbed planner. She adds more notes to the calendar, and the wall grows into an enormous grid covered with hundreds of coloured notes while she stands with her hands on her hips looking up at it.

4884.meaning: to indicate a direction or thing with your finger
4884.scene: A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.

4895.scene: A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.

4897.meaning: to become part of a group
4897.scene: On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.

4909.meaning: widely known and admired by people
4909.scene: A young woman films herself in a packed street party at sunset, laughing into the camera with people pressed all around her. She climbs a green lamppost and pulls herself up above the crowd while people below film her on their phones. A wide shot shows the whole street filled with thousands of people facing the low sun. She grins into the lens, then stands raised above the crowd with her arms up while everyone below cheers with their hands in the air and confetti falls through the golden light.

4911.scene: A blonde woman holds up a ring of keys in front of her face and smiles behind them. She pushes open the glass door of a small cafe that still has a CLOSED sign hanging on it and steps inside. She ties a grey apron behind her neck over her white shirt, then walks along the wooden counter past the espresso machine and the pastry display case, spreads her arms to show the room, and laughs with her hands raised in the empty cafe that is now hers.

4914.meaning: a stringed instrument with six strings
4914.scene: A young man sits on a bench in a city plaza between office towers, playing a wooden acoustic instrument with six strings, one hand on the fretboard, the other strumming over the sound hole. A runner in a race bib jogs past. Office workers with shopping bags stop and gather in a half circle around him, clapping and smiling; a toddler dances in front; two people hold up phones to film him as he keeps playing and singing.

4922.meaning: a person who invites guests and looks after them
4922.scene: A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.

4927.meaning: a person whose job is to practice law
4927.scene: A tall stack of thick hardback volumes sits on a polished wooden table in front of floor-to-ceiling shelves of matching legal books. A woman with a low ponytail in a navy suit and white shirt smiles to one side. She stands behind the table and lifts a black leather briefcase onto it with both hands. Outside, seen from behind, she climbs the wide stone steps of a courthouse with loose papers under one arm and the briefcase in her hand. At the top she shakes hands with a man in a dark suit, smiling.

4929.meaning: the value your school work is given
4929.scene: Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.

4936.meaning: a room equipped for preparing meals
4936.scene: A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.

4939.meaning: having the slightly brown color of gold
4939.scene: A young baker presses a ball of pale dough on a floured wooden table while low sun pours through the window behind him. A board of dough balls is slid towards the mouth of a glowing brick oven. He wipes his floury forehead with the back of his hand in front of the fire. A tray comes out full of croissants baked to a deep golden brown, and he holds a steaming round loaf with a golden crust towards the camera.

4941.meaning: a person whose job is putting out fires
4941.scene: A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. Outside, an extension ladder leans against a tree with a ginger cat sitting on a branch; the firefighter climbs it, lifts the cat down and hands it to a relieved man waiting below. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.

4951.meaning: to the place where your home is
4951.scene: A watercolour illustration seen from a dark hallway looking through an open front door into a warmly lit entrance hall. A young man in a dark coat and scarf has just stepped inside, keys still dangling from his hand, and is leaning down towards a golden dog that has run up to him with its tail swinging. Behind him are coats on hooks, boots lined up under a shelf and a wall of framed family photos under a glowing ceiling lamp.

4957.meaning: a building where travelers pay to stay
4957.scene: A three-tier montage of places to stay. A young backpacker with a big rucksack leans out of the doorway of a shabby wooden roadside place under a pink and blue neon HOTEL sign. Cut to a woman in a grey suit wheeling a silver suitcase out of a revolving glass door into a bright marble lobby, with the caption 150 EUR over her. Cut to an elderly man in a dark suit with a walking stick greeted by a uniformed doorman in front of a floodlit palace facade with a fountain, then walking through a chandelier-lit marble hall, caption 2,000 EUR.

4961.meaning: an animal kept at home for company
4961.scene: A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.

4970.meaning: freedom from the control of others
4970.scene: A night photo of a packed old-town street: a huge crowd fills the square in front of a stone clock tower, fireworks burst in the dark blue sky and confetti falls over the people. Several people sit on friends' shoulders waving large plain flags in red, blue, green and yellow, and everyone below is cheering with raised fists and open mouths.

4977.meaning: the end of the limb you grab things with
4977.scene: A first-person clip in the tropics: an outstretched arm and open hand with beaded bracelets fills the foreground, leading the camera along a path through misty green rice terraces while a smiling long-haired man holds on at the other end. He then sits on the steps of a carved stone temple beside a monkey, and finally rides a big rope swing out over a jungle valley of palms and terraces, feet bare against the sky.

4979.meaning: a place of business where people do office work
4979.scene: An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.

4983.meaning: a person who holds a position of authority
4983.scene: At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.

4989.meaning: a raised piece of land, smaller than a mountain
4989.scene: Filmed from behind a rope barrier at the foot of a grassy ridge. First one armoured fighter with a red banner appears on the crest, then a long line of re-enactors with coloured flags comes over the top and charges down the slope toward the camera, passing a white canvas tent. Spectators in the foreground film it on their phones.

4990.meaning: the hot tool for pressing clothes smooth
4990.scene: A young man in a grey sleeveless top works alone in a launderette in front of a row of big industrial washing machines. He shakes out a striped shirt, lays it flat on an ironing board and presses it with a heavy steam iron, then reaches for the next item beside a tall stack of folded, freshly washed clothes.

5001.meaning: a wide view of scenery you see at once
5001.scene: A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.

5006.meaning: the pot you boil water in for tea or coffee
5006.scene: An older woman in a patchwork apron fills a stainless steel electric kettle from the kitchen tap, then sets it back on its round base on the worktop, where a red light comes on and it starts to boil. She carries it to a wooden table where five brightly patterned mugs stand in a row, each with a teabag in it, and pours the boiling water into one mug after another.

5007.meaning: a fastener on a door that keeps it closed
5007.scene: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat stands on the step of a blue front door with a brass knocker, digging anxiously through her beige tote bag. She finds a bunch of keys and holds them up in front of her face, grinning with relief. A close shot shows her sliding one key into the round metal lock set in the blue door and turning it. She pushes the door open and steps into the hallway.

5010.meaning: a man who rules a kingdom
5010.scene: In a stone hall lined with guards in bearskin hats, a man in a red velvet robe walks up a red carpet to a golden throne. He sits down and a gold crown is placed on his head, then he strides back through the hall smiling. He steps onto a castle balcony above a huge crowd and raises his arms while the crowd cheers below the towers and flags.

5011.meaning: having lived for a long time
5011.scene: On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.

5016.meaning: the joint in the middle of your leg
5016.scene: A young man in a white T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot on a clinic examination couch while a doctor in a white coat stands beside him holding a reflex hammer. He stands up, bends his legs and drops into a deep squat facing the camera so his bare knees are in the middle of the frame, then sits back on the couch, puts a hand on his knee and laughs with the doctor.

5021.meaning: a polite name for any woman
5021.scene: An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

5025.meaning: a funny remark that causes laughter
5025.scene: In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.

5031.scene: A black-and-white linocut print on tan paper. A bearded man in a fur-lined hood and a heavy coat stands high on a snowy ridge with one boot up on the rock, gripping an ice axe and throwing his free arm out to point at the peak ahead. Below and behind him a roped line of smaller climbers works its way up the slope. Carved swirls of cloud and a low sun fill the sky.

5036.meaning: to get new knowledge or skills
5036.scene: In a courtyard between brightly painted apartment blocks a young man in a rust hoodie tries to juggle two balls, fumbles and grabs his head in embarrassment while a young woman in a denim jacket beside him holds more balls and shows him how. He tries again, tossing one ball up and catching it, gets a little further each time, and at the end both of them laugh and she claps.

5044.meaning: to notice a sound with your ears
5044.scene: A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.

5047.meaning: the room in a home where people sit and relax
5047.scene: An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.

5052.meaning: having little physical weight, not heavy
5052.scene: An inked, muted illustration of a railway station hall. A porter's trolley is stacked far too high with battered leather suitcases, canvas bundles and tied sacks, and the whole tower is sliding off. Cases tumble through the air, one lands open on the tiled floor with a wheel spinning away, and a man in a dark jacket throws both hands up as the baggage rains down on him. Blurred travellers and a second trolley stand in the background under the arched glass roof.

5057.meaning: letters and packages sent by post
5057.scene: A soft watercolour of a girl on a village path at sunset. She reaches up and pulls open the flap of a big wooden mailbox on a tall post, and a fan of letters bursts out of it; more envelopes drift through the pink sky and one large envelope floats past the bottom of the frame. Hedges, a tiled cottage roof and a half-timbered house sit behind her.

5058.meaning: a person whose job is to bring letters to houses
5058.scene: A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.

5059.meaning: a written message you send to a person
5059.scene: A young man in a navy hoodie stands at a black roadside mailbox with its red flag up and pulls the front hatch open; the box is empty. A postal worker in a blue jacket and cap arrives and pushes a thick block of white envelopes and a brown parcel into the box, filling it completely. The man reaches back in, drags out the enormous stack of letters and holds it against his chest, mouth open in delight.

5073.meaning: something you take that treats an illness
5073.scene: A young woman in a grey hoodie sits at a kitchen table with a box of tablets, an open pill case, a glass of water and a brown medicine bottle in front of her. She pours the brown syrup onto a spoon, swallows it, screws up her face in disgust and sticks out her tongue, gulps down the water, shudders, and finally screws the cap back on the bottle.

5074.meaning: to make people come to know each other
5074.scene: A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.

5076.meaning: one of the persons who joined a group
5076.scene: A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.

5081.meaning: the color between red and blue
5081.scene: A young man in a blue hoodie stands in a hallway and inspects a silver ring through a small jeweller's magnifier, frowning at it. A blonde woman in a grey t-shirt tucks her hair behind her ear in front of a round black-framed bathroom mirror. A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.

5082.meaning: the way someone's hair is cut and arranged
5082.scene: A young woman in a coral top and a chunky yellow bead necklace dabs powder onto her cheek from a compact in a bright hallway, her hair piled up in a high bun. She leans towards a round gold-framed mirror on the wall, smooths her hair back with one hand and talks to her reflection, then adjusts the necklace at her throat. She turns to a large vanity mirror ringed with light bulbs, and in the last shot her hair has been arranged into two big rounded buns, which she shows off to the camera beside her reflection.

5084.meaning: the color between blue and yellow
5084.scene: At a fashion show, a model with a shaved head and large gold hoop earrings walks straight towards the camera down the runway in a floor-length, loose, shiny green gown with wide draped sleeves. Photographers and seated guests along both sides hold up phones to film her. She comes close enough for the green fabric to fill the frame and looks into the lens, then turns and walks away so the back of the gown swings behind her.

5089.meaning: a woman who has given birth to a child
5089.scene: A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

5091.meaning: a two-wheeled motor vehicle you ride
5091.scene: A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.

5092.scene: A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.

5096.meaning: the solid surface of the earth you stand on
5096.scene: A pencil sketch of a woodland floor seen close up. A large mushroom with a thick stalk and a smooth domed cap grows straight out of the ground, its gills drawn in fine lines underneath. A hand comes in from the right and a finger touches the base of the stalk at ground level. Fallen leaves, twigs and smaller mushrooms cover the earth all around, with bare trees sketched softly in the background.

5097.meaning: an art form of instrumental or vocal tones
5097.scene: A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.

5098.meaning: belonging to one nation or country
5098.scene: A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.

5099.meaning: a print of a person or scene
5099.scene: In a flat with a huge political world map on the wall, housemates take turns stepping up to it. Each one holds a small square instant print showing their own face and a little paper flag, and presses both onto the map over the country they come from. A man in a green football shirt sticks his onto northern Europe, a woman with a camera round her neck presses hers onto Africa, a long-haired man adds one near Japan, a blonde woman adds one over South America. The map fills up with flags and small portraits, and at the end the whole group crowds behind the framed map, holds it up and takes a selfie with it.

5103.meaning: the part that connects the head to the body
5103.scene: A woman in a lilac blouse sits at an office desk in front of a computer monitor, tips her head to one side and rubs the back of her neck with her hand, wincing. She rolls her head and talks to the camera. The shot cuts to a close-up of her chest and shoulders as she loops a thick mustard scarf around her neck and knots it. Then the scene cuts outdoors: she stands at a green fence at a wildlife park in the same blouse and scarf, and a giraffe lowers its very long neck down over her head from above. She turns to the camera with her mouth wide open in astonishment, hand at her chin.

5116.scene: A hand pushes a small frosted kitchen window outwards above a steel sink, letting daylight and a potted plant on the outside sill into the dim room. Cut to a young man in a pale linen shirt striding through a bright Paris apartment towards the windows. He grabs the long white curtains and throws them apart, then swings the tall casement windows open over the rooftops. Finally he pushes both leaves of the balcony doors wide open with his arms spread and walks out onto the wrought-iron balcony into full sun.

5128.meaning: damage to the body from an accident
5128.scene: In a bright living room a young man in a grey tracksuit bangs his leg on the corner of the sofa. He throws his head back with his mouth wide open, hops on one foot into the hallway, doubles over and clutches his shin with both hands. He slides down the wall by the doorframe, sits on the floor with his face screwed up and keeps holding the sore leg.

5130.meaning: a cloth wing on strings pulled by the wind
5130.scene: A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.

5131.meaning: to direct your attention on something
5131.scene: A pen-and-ink drawing of a narrow alley between old brick houses. A young man in a shalwar kameez swings a cricket bat at a tennis ball that is right in front of the bat face; his eyes are locked on the ball and his brow is furrowed. Boys sit on a wall behind him watching, another man watches from a doorstep, tangled electric wires cross overhead and dust puffs up around his feet.

5134.meaning: a father or mother of a child
5134.scene: Four short scenes of a mother and a father looking after their children. The mother spoons food from a bowl into a baby's mouth in a high chair while the father steadies the chair. Both of them kneel on a rug and help two toddlers stack a tall tower of coloured wooden blocks. At night the mother leans over a bed and tucks a boy under a blue duvet, and the father sits beside the next bed reading a picture book to a girl. Finally children run and swing in a sunny playground while the adults stand and watch.

5143.meaning: the state of having no war
5143.scene: A stained-glass panel in strong leaded colours. Two soldiers in helmets and different uniforms - one in green, one in grey - lean towards each other over a churned strip of ground and shake hands, their heads bowed. Both of their rifles are stuck muzzle-down in the earth in front of them. Above their joined hands a large white dove flies out of a burst of blue and yellow light with a green sprig in its beak. Behind them are broken fence posts and green fields, and red, blue and purple wildflowers grow out of the bare soil in the foreground.

5147.meaning: any group of human beings together
5147.scene: A low shot follows the legs of men and women in dark suits carrying shopping bags as they stride across a wide striped crossing. The camera then moves into a covered market arcade so full that shoulders and backpacks touch: shoppers in coats and school blazers press slowly past stalls hung with food and signs. Finally the view rises above a huge city junction, where hundreds of walkers pour off every kerb at once and fill the whole crossing from both directions under tall buildings and video screens, until the road cannot be seen for the moving mass of them.

5148.meaning: the time between dawn and noon
5148.scene: Early light over an empty paved plaza: a person in a mustard coat stands at the edge with a flock of grey birds pecking in front of them, then the birds lift off low across the stones. Inside a deserted station hall the same person stands alone at the foot of a bank of escalators under the bright ceiling lights. They sit by themselves on a long empty row of seats with a canvas bag beside them, sipping from a can. In the last shot they stand in the middle of a wide boulevard, alone on the white stripes of the crossing with no traffic at all, while the sun comes up between the buildings and the trees behind them.

5149.meaning: a shop where you buy medicine
5149.scene: A young man with a red, sore nose stands at a lit pharmacy window under a green cross sign while a hand behind the glass passes him a small box of medicine. He then waits inside a modern pharmacy under a red digital queue-number display, carrying a paper bag, and pays at a self-service terminal. Finally he stands open-mouthed inside a grand old pharmacy whose walls are floor-to-ceiling wooden drawers, watching a pharmacist in a white coat climb a tall wooden ladder to fetch something from the top row.

5151.meaning: a decorated border that surrounds a picture
5151.scene: An elderly man in a patterned cardigan stands by a bright window holding up a small painting of a mountain valley in a silver moulded border, turning it so the camera can see it. He carries it to a hallway wall already filled with dozens of bordered landscape pictures, lifts it onto a hook and nudges the edges until it hangs straight among the others. He steps back and stands beside the finished wall, which runs the whole length of the hallway.

5155.meaning: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
5155.scene: A woman in a blue shirt lowers a large empty white plate onto a wooden dining table by a sunny window. A serving spoon lifts rigatoni and spaghetti in tomato sauce out of a pan and sets a portion on the plate, finished with a basil leaf. The camera pulls back over a long table laid with cutlery and many identical plates of pasta, a family already seated around it in the midday light, and the woman spreads her arms to invite everyone to eat.

5176.meaning: a big cup with a handle for hot drinks
5176.scene: A run of pours in a kitchen: dark coffee streams from a carafe into a big white mug standing on the counter, pale pancake batter is poured into a black frying pan on the stove, golden syrup is drizzled over a tall stack of pancakes, and finally sparkling wine is poured into the top glass of a champagne tower.

5186.meaning: people in general, taken as a whole
5186.scene: A colourful cartoon of a busy town square seen from above. Ordinary people of every age fill it: two old men feed pigeons from benches, a jogger in a headband runs past, a woman pushes a pram, a man in a suit checks his watch, a boy cycles by in a green helmet, a long-haired busker plays guitar by a stone fountain, teenagers chat at the fountain rim, and shoppers walk in front of a row of pastel shopfronts. A pigeon sits on the frame at the top.

5194.meaning: a long fictional story printed as a book
5194.scene: A young blonde woman sits curled up on a grey sofa in a bright living room, a white curtained window behind her. She holds a thick paperback open in both hands and reads it, her lips moving slightly as her eyes track the lines. She smiles at something on the page and turns over a page. At the end she closes the book, holds it on her lap and looks up and away with a satisfied smile.

5200.scene: Inside a bright living room several young people burst into motion one after another. A woman throws off a grey blanket on the sofa with a huge grin, a man springs forward out of an orange armchair, another drops to the carpet and pumps out press-ups, and then the whole group jumps, high-fives, claps and cheers around the coffee table.

5204.scene: Two people in paint-spattered dungarees work on a wrecked room whose walls are bare plaster with old paint peeling off in sheets. One hammers at a battered built-in shelf unit, the woman rolls fresh paint onto a wall while the man smooths the plaster beside her with a trowel, the camera pans across the wet cream paint, and then the same room appears finished: smooth painted walls, new wooden shelves, a plant and a clean tiled floor, with the two of them standing in it looking pleased.

5225.meaning: to bring something to an end
5225.scene: A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.

5254.meaning: the person you are married to
5254.scene: In a green park an old man in a flat cap and tweed jacket dances along a path with his fists up, beaming. An old woman with white hair in a lilac cardigan leans down over a bed of bright orange marigolds and looks at them closely while a cyclist rides past behind her. Then several elderly couples dance together on a wide paved terrace under a blue sky with white clouds: one white-haired man holds his wife by the hand and waist and turns her, and the pair in the foreground hold each other by the shoulders, laughing into each other's faces as they dance.

5263.meaning: a printed picture of a person or scene
5263.scene: A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.

5267.meaning: a weapon that fires a bullet at high speed
5267.scene: At a biathlon shooting range, a female athlete in a turquoise race suit lies prone on a mat in the snow with her rifle resting on its stand. She sights along the barrel at a row of five round metal targets set out across the snow, works the bolt and fires. Officials and other athletes stand behind her by the fencing, and at the end she pushes herself up off the mat, smiling.

5285.meaning: the feeling of joy and contentment
5285.scene: A loose watercolour of a young woman in a long blue-and-yellow dress swinging a small girl around by both hands in a sunny garden. Both are laughing, the girl's legs fly out behind her and her hair and ribbon stream sideways. Washing hangs on a line behind them, flowers grow at the edges and an empty wooden swing hangs from a tree.

5293.meaning: the handwear used to catch a baseball
5293.scene: Baseball action in a sunlit stadium: a runner in a white uniform slides feet first through the dirt towards the plate in a cloud of dust; an infielder in a colourful cap crouches low with a leather mitt on his hand as the umpire watches; the runner dives full length head first and reaches the base; the fielder scoops the ball into his glove; a final dive sends dust flying across the base line.

5299.meaning: not allowed by law or the rules
5299.scene: An elderly woman in a headscarf pushes a checked suitcase onto the belt at an airport checkpoint while a long queue waits behind her. An officer in uniform opens the case and it is packed with sausages, cheese and jars of pickles - none of it allowed through. On the scanner monitor the outline of a chicken leg shows up inside the bag. The officer holds the case open and speaks to her while she clutches a jar and looks up at him.

5309.scene: A woman in a grey blazer and glasses sits at her desk in a large open-plan office and looks down in surprise: a takeaway coffee cup and a wrapped pastry have appeared next to her keyboard. She picks up a small white card propped against them and holds it up — a smiley face is drawn on it in pen. She looks around over the top of her monitor at the rows of cubicles where her colleagues are working, then stands holding the coffee, scanning the room to work out who left it. She ends up back at her desk with the cup in both hands, smiling.

5315.meaning: a card with a picture you write on and send
5315.scene: A young woman stands in a souvenir kiosk hung with racks of picture cards, holding up a small metal Eiffel Tower keychain while the smiling stallholder watches. She holds a snow globe up against the sky by the river, then tries on a red and a navy beret in front of a mirror. At the end she carries two straw baskets and a thick fan of picture cards showing Paris landmarks, spreading them out towards the camera.

5340.meaning: a building where a car is kept
5340.scene: Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.

5357.meaning: not plain but decorated and showy
5357.scene: A battered pram with patched fabric and rusty wheels rolls along a park path. Then a woman in a beige blazer pushes a plain modern grey stroller with a small fluffy dog sitting in it and the caption 500 euro appears. Finally a man in white robes pushes an ornate chrome carriage-style stroller with buttoned leather upholstery, the same dog inside wearing sunglasses, captioned 5000 euro, while the woman stares open-mouthed.

5359.meaning: a very big grey animal that lives in rivers
5359.scene: A ranger in a khaki uniform and cap stands on a wooden jetty over green river water and points behind her, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise. A large grey hippo floats just off the deck with its head and back above the water, then sinks lower and lower until only its nostrils and finally just ripples are left on the surface, while she keeps staring at the camera.

5399.meaning: a story that actors perform on a stage
5399.scene: A loose watercolour of a theatre seen from the side. Two actors in tunics, boots and capes perform on a wooden stage: one stands with his arm flung out and his cloak flying, the other strides towards him. Heavy red curtains are drawn back on either side, a painted forest backdrop hangs behind them, footlights glow along the front edge of the stage, and rows of seated people and gilded balcony boxes fill the auditorium.

5400.meaning: a drama sung to music with an orchestra
5400.scene: A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.

5404.meaning: wanting much more wealth or things than you need
5404.scene: A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.

5408.meaning: a case holding a set of things you need
5408.scene: A woman in a denim shirt and a patterned headband stands in an open garage with a wooden kitchen chair in front of her; she presses on the seat and it wobbles. She turns to a red hard case on the bench and opens it: inside, held in moulded slots, are rows of screwdrivers, spanners, pliers and sockets. She lifts one screwdriver out of the case, tightens the loose joint under the chair, stands the chair back up and sits down on it to show it holds.

5421.meaning: food and waste thrown out of a kitchen
5421.scene: A drawn grey-green kitchen scene. A metal bin stands in the middle of the floor, so full that its lid has been pushed off and hangs to one side; empty milk and juice cartons, a tin and crumpled paper stick out of the bag inside it. More screwed-up paper and food packaging lies scattered across the tiled floor. On the right a young man in a jacket and boots pulls back with both hands raised as a crumpled paper ball flies past him towards the viewer.

5430.meaning: moving or able to move very quickly
5430.scene: A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.

5439.meaning: a color between white and black
5439.scene: A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.

5452.meaning: not disturbed by fighting or trouble
5452.scene: A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.

5456.meaning: approval that lets you do something
5456.scene: A young man in a grey shirt sits at an outdoor counter under palm trees with a passport, an envelope and printed forms in front of him, pressing his hands together hopefully. Inside an airport terminal he then holds the passport open to a page with his photo on it, eyes wide. He steps up to an officer beside a metal detector, who reaches out for the document, and finally he walks through the gateway grinning and holding up a small card.

5481.scene: A smiling young woman with long bright pink hair kneels in a tiled laundry room beside an open front-loading washing machine. Her pink hair fills most of the frame as she lifts coloured clothes out of a laundry basket and pushes them into the drum. The camera then shows the closed machine with the wash turning behind the round glass door, and finally, filmed from inside the drum, she pulls out a clean white t-shirt and holds it up to her face.

5486.meaning: a clay container that a plant grows in
5486.scene: An elderly man in a flat cap and body warmer stands at a greenhouse windowsill holding a metal watering can over a terracotta flowerpot with a pale green succulent growing in it. He then waters a garden bed full of pink, yellow and red zinnias and pansies from the same can, moves on to a raised bed of leafy vegetables and waters those too, and finally stands back with a hand on his hip looking over the watered garden.

4018.meaning: a light motorbike with a small engine
4018.scene: Filmed over a car bonnet on a dirt track running between tall golden reeds at sunset. A mint-green scooter rides ahead with two small dogs aboard, one in a blue cap. The dogs hop down and mill about on the track, then climb back on and the scooter tips over into the reeds at the edge.

4020.scene: A black labrador stands in a shallow forest creek with the water around its legs, head lowered towards the surface. A small brown frog swims slowly across the water just in front of its nose. The dog holds completely still and keeps its eyes fixed on the frog as it paddles away between the reflections of the ferns and trees.

4026.meaning: with a surface free of bumps or roughness
4026.scene: A woman in a yellow top and white flared trousers stands barefoot on a wooden-topped hydrofoil board that is lifted clear of the water on a thin mast. The harbour water is completely flat and mirror-like, reflecting her and the palm trees, and she glides across it leaving only a thin line of ripples. She rides past a breakwater of grey concrete blocks and a marina, then comes back in and steps off onto a floating plastic dock.

4028.scene: A brown and white bulldog rides away from the camera on a small skateboard along the wet road of a campsite lined with parked caravans and pickup trucks. It pushes with one back leg past an American flag and a big mossy oak, gets smaller in the distance, then swings round and comes back the other way. In the last shot it rides straight towards the camera with its tongue out.

4034.meaning: a device that catches an animal
4034.scene: The tiled floor of a shop stacked with boxed toys is covered with dozens of black mousetraps, all set and laid out in rows. A man in a white shirt and shorts, blindfolded and holding a red foam bat, swings it around trying to hit a second man who is creeping between the traps in bare feet. The second man dodges away and steps carefully over the traps, but ends up sprawled on the floor among them while the blindfolded man swings again.

4035.meaning: to move by taking a step
4035.scene: A first-person view looks down at the filmer's own feet in black sandals on an outdoor water obstacle course, above a pool of green water. He steps from one floating blue and white block to the next along a line of them, arms out to keep his balance. He crosses a narrow beam, then reaches a tall red tower covered in scale-shaped panels and takes hold of a thick white rope with both hands to pull himself up. At the top he stands behind a red railing looking down over the whole course.

4036.meaning: a face with the corners of the mouth turned up
4036.scene: By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.

4042.meaning: a shop where goods are sold
4042.scene: At dusk a young couple stands on the pavement outside a brightly lit convenience store, its glass front and stocked shelves glowing behind them. The woman, in a pale yellow wrap dress with a white frangipani in her hair, sips from a whole green coconut through a red-and-white striped straw; a close-up shows her drinking with the store's shelves of packets and bottles filling the background. She looks up at the tall man in a white t-shirt beside her; he looks down at her and says no. She keeps holding the coconut between them and smiles up at him as scooters and other shoppers pass behind.

4052.meaning: to make a record of something to keep
4052.scene: On a white-sand beach with palm trees and shallow turquoise water, a couple in white pose for a phone that stands on a small tripod in the sand in the foreground; the phone's screen shows the shot it is taking of them. They stand arm in arm making peace signs at the lens. The woman then walks straight up to the phone, frowns and reaches down to adjust it, then goes back and they pose again. At the end they both laugh and give a thumbs-up as a small dog runs into the frame behind them.

4058.scene: A man in a red cap and white t-shirt lifts a single small brown suitcase onto a white bed in a bedroom and closes it. He carries it out to a blue SUV standing on a sunny driveway with its boot open. He then turns and sees a woman in a black dress wheeling out a tower of about ten stacked suitcases in pink, green, teal, blue and black, balanced far above her head. He stands in front of it with his mouth open and his hands raised, staring up at the tower while she waits beside it.

4074.meaning: the light and rays of the sun
4074.scene: A short sequence shot at the end of the day. A laughing woman in a red swimsuit sits chest-deep in a calm lagoon with the low sun blazing behind her and lighting up her wet hair. The camera drops to water level, where the sun sits just above a sand dune and lays a long band of light across the ripples, with a wooden boat moored to one side. Two red kites hang against the orange sky, then a kitesurfer skims across the shallow water in the sunlight, followed by a point-of-view shot of hands on the control bar. The last shot is a huge orange moon behind a row of wind turbines.

4087.meaning: activity done to make or do something
4087.scene: A series of shots of tabby cats dressed in grey business suits living a full office life. Two of them sit side by side on the blue seats of a commuter train between human passengers. One types at a laptop in an open-plan office, walled in by towering stacks of paper. Two stand chatting with paper cups by the coffee machine and the water cooler. Two sit at a boardroom table watching a bar-chart presentation on a projector screen. In the last shot a cat in striped pyjamas works on a laptop in bed at night, surrounded by scattered documents.

4088.meaning: having a great distance from one side to the other
4088.scene: A steady shot taken from the very brink of an enormous waterfall on a bright day. A broad sheet of deep green water slides towards the camera and pours over a long curved edge that stretches far away across the frame. White foam breaks along the top, and a huge white cloud of spray rises from below and fills the right-hand half of the picture. Blue sky and small clouds sit above the far shore.

4101.meaning: to present something to an interested audience
4101.scene: A circus arena in a spotlight, with rows of the audience in silhouette. A performer in a blue costume stands on a gold pedestal and lifts a huge sheet of white cloth above their head, then opens their arms so the cloth falls into an enormous cone around them, spreading across the ring like a gown. The crowd hold up phones to film. The white cloth is then whipped away and in its place a giant peacock tail opens out in orange, white and green with a blue wheel at its centre, and the audience raise their hands and cheer.

4102.meaning: the warm light and rays of the sun
4102.scene: An illustrated clip. A thin man sits on a wooden chair at a small desk in a bare room, typing on a laptop. Through the big window in front of him the outside is bright: a yellow sun in a blue sky, a purple kite flying on a string, and a green ocean wave rolling in. His head tips back toward the sunny sky while his hands stay on the keyboard. His body then stretches further and further out of the chair toward the window until the chair tips over and he is pulled almost horizontal, hands still on the laptop, drawn toward the sunshine outside.

4115.scene: A tiled seaside promenade at night, lit by the lights of souvenir stalls. Racks of sunglasses and rows of straw sun hats stand outside the shops on one side, dark pine trees rise on the other, and the lights of the bay glow further along. A young couple walks away from the camera down the promenade with his arm around her shoulders. He reaches over and ruffles the top of her head; she ducks away, spins round with her blonde hair flying, and laughs. He puts his arm back around her and they walk on together past the stalls.

4116.meaning: below average in size or number
4116.scene: A car park by the sea. A bearded man in a flat cap and navy jacket pushes a bright red bubble car by hand out of a parking space; the little car is so low that it barely reaches his waist and it is dwarfed on both sides by two enormous black SUVs. He rolls it out, climbs in through the front and drives it along a coastal road, its three wheels and glass bubble roof tiny against the wide blue bay. He parks under a big spreading tree and sits on a bench beside it, with the city skyline across the water, then drives slowly away down the path.

4117.meaning: looking carefully in order to find something
4117.scene: An animated living room with a low round wooden table, a pale sofa and big windows onto a green garden. A man in a dark blue shirt stands looking worried, then starts hunting through the room: he throws the sofa cushions into the air, crouches down to look under the furniture and turns around again and again. A woman in a cream top sits calmly on the sofa watching him with a small knowing smile. The camera drops to the coffee table, where his phone and a bunch of car keys are lying in plain sight; a hand reaches in and points at them. He looks up, sheepish, picks up the phone, and she stands behind the sofa with her arms folded, pointing at the table.

4122.meaning: to take something by force from its owner
4122.scene: A flat cartoon in stick-figure style. Behind a service counter a plain white figure stands with a clipboard in front of him. Through the window behind him a black masked figure smashes the glass, and shards fall on the floor. The masked figure climbs in, points a revolver over the counter and shouts at the clerk, who stares back without moving. After the clerk answers him, the masked figure lowers the gun, turns away and walks back out through the broken window, past the parked cars in the street, leaving the shattered glass and the untouched counter behind.

4124.meaning: a boxy road vehicle for carrying people or things
4124.scene: A series of shots from life in a camper van. A curly-haired young man leans out of the open side door of a white van with a shaggy grey dog beside him, the blue ocean and a beach behind them. A drone shot follows the van along a winding coastal road at sunset. Then, on a bare clifftop at dusk, three friends sit on folding chairs around a small open fire built inside a ring of pale stones; the flames burn orange in the middle of the circle and light their faces while a dog sleeps on a blanket beside them and the van stands with its door open behind. Later the friends and the dog sprint across the wet sand of a beach, and at the end they sit together on the open tailgate of the van watching the sun drop into the sea.

4127.scene: A red dirt track through a dry pine forest. A white and chestnut sifaka lemur comes bounding down the track towards the camera, hopping upright on its back legs with its arms held out. It stops right in front of the camera, sitting up on its hind legs, and a woman's hand offers it a small piece of orange carrot, which it takes in both black hands and nibbles. While it eats, the hand reaches out and strokes the thick white fur of its chest and belly, running over it slowly again and again while the lemur sits still and lets her, staring straight into the camera with big orange eyes.

4128.meaning: the enclosed land around a house
4128.scene: A sunny back yard behind a house, closed in on all sides by a tall wooden fence, with a brick paved path along the house and a patch of green and dry grass in front of it. A pale golden retriever puppy comes trotting along the brick paving towards the camera, ears flapping and tongue out, then steps down off the paving onto the grass of the yard and keeps coming, tail up. It bounds the last few steps through the grass and drops down right in front of the lens, filling the frame with its face, panting happily in the sunshine.

4137.meaning: the yellow color, like a lemon
4137.scene: A pale lilac nursery with a white cot under a cream canopy, a round pink rug on the wooden floor and a cream armchair in the corner, filmed from the doorway. A bearded man is kneeling on the floor in an enormous bright yellow ball gown, the wide yellow skirt spread out all around him over the rug. In front of him a golden retriever sits in a red cape with a white ruff. The man leans down to the dog, picks up a yellow rubber bone from the rug and holds it out; the dog takes the yellow bone in its mouth and holds it there while he strokes its head and talks to it, the yellow skirt filling half the frame.

4142.meaning: to fall as rain from the sky
4142.scene: A short montage of outdoor moments. A big wave breaks over a wall of sand and floods a dug-out pool on the beach at sunset while people watch from the ridge; a man is washed over by the foam. Then a woman floats in a grey-green sea with raindrops hitting the water all around her. Then an empty wet road runs straight into an orange sunset over a snowy plain. Finally a woman in a white shirt and denim skirt spins barefoot and laughing on a wet mountain road in the rain, green cliffs and mist behind her.

4144.meaning: a long hollow pipe for liquids or gases
4144.scene: A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.

4154.meaning: an active game with physical competition
4154.scene: On an orange clay court at night, a woman in a black top, white skirt and blue cap serves a tennis ball. She throws the ball high above her head, swings the racket up and hits it, then runs forward into the court. Floodlights light the court, a green fence runs behind her and palm trees and a lit apartment block stand behind that, with two people watching from a balcony. She then waits with the racket in both hands and plays a forehand back.

4163.scene: A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.

4165.meaning: how fast something moves, distance per time
4165.scene: A young blond man, filmed from the passenger seat of a sports car, drives along a mountain road while he talks; through the side window beside him the trees and the verge rush past as a green blur. The shot cuts outside to a yellow supercar coming fast round a bend below a rock face and a wall of pine forest, then back to him at the wheel.

4168.scene: A split-screen cartoon of the old fable. In the top half a brown hare bounds over a grassy hill, then sits down, then lies flat on its back asleep. In the bottom half a tortoise plods forward step by step with a purple butterfly beside it and never stops. Behind them the sky turns from green daylight to an orange sunset and then to a starry night with a crescent moon, and the tortoise is still walking.

4170.meaning: to keep someone safe from harm
4170.scene: An animated hen leads four yellow chicks across a frozen lake, one chick carrying a white daisy. The ice splits into sharp plates and gives way; the hen and a chick drop into the blue water below and sink among the bubbles. The hen swims up and breaks the surface holding the soaked chick against her chest, lifts it out onto solid ice, and stands over all the chicks huddled together again.

4186.meaning: to go or come back to a place
4186.scene: On a blue tennis court in bright sun, an apricot goldendoodle stands next to an orange and white egg-shaped ball machine placed on the service line. A tennis ball is hit over the net towards the dog. The dog runs off across the court after it while a person stands waiting at the far baseline. The dog comes back to the machine with the yellow ball in its mouth, drops it into the opening on top and stands beside the machine waiting for the next ball.

4191.meaning: to appear very tall and large
4191.scene: A young man in a black t-shirt jumps up and down with his arms spread wide on the concrete of a launch site at sunset. Behind him, filling the whole frame, stands an enormous stainless-steel rocket lying on its transporter, so big that he only reaches the height of its lower fins. The shot cuts to a low angle looking straight up the shining rocket into the pink evening sky, then to the rocket standing tall in silhouette between two palm trees with the sun behind it. Back at the transporter he jumps again with both fists in the air.

4194.scene: On a large mown lawn at golden hour, a grown woman in sunglasses, a white t-shirt and white trainers sits in a tiny pink toy jeep, far too small for her, with her legs folded up over the bonnet. She drives it slowly across the grass past a huge old oak tree, filmed from a vehicle following behind her. She steers around, waves an arm, and carries on away from the camera towards a weeping willow, a row of tall poplars and two wooden sheds in the evening light.

4208.scene: A hamster sits on a grey sofa in a dim room and works through one small meal after another straight to camera: a cheeseburger with a red paper cup of soda, a red pot of instant noodles eaten with chopsticks, a pink tub of yoghurt with a spoon, a corn dog covered in ketchup, then a slice of strawberry cream cake with a fork, ending with cream on its nose. Finally it lies flat on its back on the sofa with its belly up, crisps scattered all around it and an open bag of Lay's tipped over on the floor.

4213.scene: Two women pose together in a white panelled room in matching floor-length satin evening gowns with a high slit. The gowns and accessories change from look to look: black gowns with gold heels and small gold bags, then black gowns with bright green heels and a green bag, then chocolate satin gowns with lilac heels and lilac bags, and finally deep red gowns, one with a long cape sleeve, worn with emerald necklace and earrings and a green clutch.

4216.meaning: the lightest color, the opposite of black
4216.scene: A couple pose together in a white panelled room in front of a cream sofa. In the first look she wears a deep red satin gown and he an all-black shirt and trousers. Then she wears a sleeveless white tiered cotton dress with white heels while he wears an olive shirt with cream trousers, and they turn to face each other. In the last look she wears a long fitted black dress with black heels and he a tan shirt with dark brown trousers, his arm around her waist.

4224.meaning: a room with a toilet in it
4224.scene: In a warm, softly lit hallway with a rug and a potted plant, an enormously fat green cartoon lizard waddles up to a doorway and has to squeeze its round belly through the frame. The door swings shut, and a small dark sign on it reads WC. The hallway sits quiet for a few seconds. Then the door opens again and the same lizard comes out completely slim, throwing both arms in the air with a delighted open-mouthed grin.

4228.meaning: the land along the edge of the sea or a lake
4228.scene: A man in a khaki shirt climbs into a dark blue helicopter on a sunny airfield. The camera flies low over pine forest and steep green mountains towards a bright turquoise lake. He stands on the grassy shore with his arms spread wide facing the water and the grey rock walls behind it. He then cracks two eggs onto a flat black pan on a small camping stove set on the rocks by the lake, and finally sits at a low wooden table eating the cooked eggs with sliced bread and tomatoes.

4230.scene: At night, a torch shines into the open window of a dark red pickup truck. A golden retriever in a camouflage jacket and cap sits upright in the driver's seat with a paw on the steering wheel, staring back at the camera. In the seat beside it a dachshund in an orange hat sits stiffly. Nobody moves for a long moment. Then the shot cuts to the truck's red tail lights speeding away down an unlit country road.

4231.meaning: the glass opening in the side of a vehicle
4231.scene: At night the camera looks at the closed side window of a dark red pickup truck. The glass is completely fogged up, with only vague golden shapes moving behind it. The window clears and shows two golden retrievers in the cab, both wearing baseball caps, one with a paw up on the door, as pale smoke drifts out around them. They sit there staring out. Then the truck pulls away and speeds off down a dark road.

4232.meaning: the act of entertaining people in public
4232.scene: At a marine park with palm trees and empty rows of stadium seating, a shirtless man crouches at the edge of a big turquoise pool holding a large silver ball and talks to a bottlenose dolphin resting at the wall. The dolphin lifts its head and listens, then backs off into open water, launches itself high into the air upside down and strikes the ball away with its tail. The man leaps up with both hands on his head, mouth wide open, watching the ball fly off into the blue sky.

4233.meaning: rock cut into blocks for building
4233.scene: A drone films a tall bridge built of stone blocks, its arches and piers rising out of a green jungle gorge, with an enormous waterfall pouring down the cliff directly behind it. A freight train with a blue locomotive and dark red wagons rolls slowly across the top of the stonework. The camera pulls back to show the full height of the falls, the water breaking into white threads over the rock while the train crosses in front of them.

4238.meaning: to cook with dry heat in an oven
4238.scene: Two hands rinse a raw rack of lamb ribs in a fast mountain stream, with green hills and grazing horses behind. The rack is then laid on a flat stone slab set over glowing red coals and slowly browns, steaming, with the sun low over the hills. A man inflates a big white tent on the grass with an orange pump. Inside the tent, on a patterned carpet, two men sit at a low wooden table and eat the roasted ribs, which are served on a bed of lettuce with cherry tomatoes.

4247.meaning: a deep hole dug to get water
4247.scene: A drone looks down on a huge flat field of bright green rice. In the middle of it sits a round stone well full of dark water, with a narrow footpath leading to it through the crop. A line of boys in red shorts stands along the well's stone rim; one after another they jump in, each landing with a white burst of spray. The last shot is straight down from above: five of them float on their backs in the round pool of water in a star shape, the green field all around.

4253.meaning: to clean your body with soap and water
4253.scene: A motocross rider sits on a green dirt bike in a wet paddock, caked from helmet to boots in thick brown mud, so that the goggles and the whole suit are one solid brown crust. Two mechanics in team shirts and caps work on him with a pressure hose: one wipes the mud off the helmet with a cloth while the other kneels and blasts water over the rider's legs and the bike. Brown water runs off in sheets and the green bodywork of the bike appears clean again under the mud.

4257.scene: An animated pond scene. A baby panda and a small green turtle swim underwater below a big lily pad, blowing streams of bubbles, while a grumpy fish watches from behind. They shoot up out of the water and fly through the air above a sunlit bamboo forest with their arms and legs flung out and shocked faces. Then the panda sits on a huge floating lily pad with the turtle clamped in a tight hug against its chest, arms wrapped right around the shell; the grumpy fish pokes its head out of the water below. The last shot shows the panda squeezing the turtle close among pink water lilies.

4261.meaning: bright and pleasant, full of sun
4261.scene: A rectangular garden pool with a blue rim and clear turquoise water stands on a lawn in bright sunshine, with a row of small conifers and a dark fence behind it. Two Jack Russell terriers swim in the pool pushing a big red ball with their noses. One paddles across the pool nudging the ball ahead of it towards the camera, water sparkling in the sun, while the second dog swims behind. At the end the red ball rests against the sunlit edge of the pool in close-up with the second terrier still paddling towards it.

4264.meaning: a game where two teams hit a ball over a high net
4264.scene: A point-of-view shot down a quiet suburban street lined with parked cars and clipped hedges under a blue sky full of white clouds. The camera holder's ringed hands push a yellow and blue volleyball up out of frame; a person in white clothes standing further down the road sets it back, and the ball drops into the waiting hands again.

4279.meaning: a building where plays or films are shown
4279.scene: An art-deco poster of a theatre interior. A man in a gold and black geometric suit stands alone in a bright spotlight on the stage, one hand pressed to his heart and the other flung out, head thrown back as he declaims. Heavy crimson and gold curtains are swagged back on either side of the stage, and rows of empty seats stretch away into the dark behind him.

4284.meaning: the act of moving hurriedly and carelessly
4284.scene: A pencil sketch of a man dashing out of the front door of a flat: a slice of toast clamped in his teeth, a travel coffee cup and a briefcase in one hand, his jacket half pulled on over an untied tie, his free arm thrown out after a set of keys flying through the air, both shoelaces trailing loose behind him, with coats on hooks and shoes scattered by the door.

4288.meaning: a point or object to shoot at
4288.scene: A young archer stands on an open grass steppe drawing a recurve bow back to her cheek with one eye squeezed shut in concentration; the shot cuts down the range to three round black-and-white bullseye targets standing in the grass with green hills behind them, then back to her holding her aim while teammates in tracksuits watch from behind.

4298.meaning: in a direct line, without deviation
4298.scene: In a school gym a boy in white PE kit shuffles his trainers forward until his toes touch a coloured line painted on the parquet floor; the camera then pans along a whole class of boys standing shoulder to shoulder with every pair of shoes exactly on the same line, forming one perfectly straight row, while a teacher in a red tracksuit with a whistle walks down the line checking it.

4311.meaning: in an early period of life
4311.scene: An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

4316.meaning: feeling regret over something you did
4316.scene: An office desk by a window. A young man in a knitted vest and glasses sits with his head bowed low over the desk, holding a wrapped bunch of white and yellow tulips; a large brown puddle of spilled coffee covers the laptop keyboard beside him. He sits up, grimaces at the mess and points at himself as he speaks, then mops the keyboard with a cloth. A woman colleague comes and stands over him with her arms folded; he bows deeply and holds the tulips up to her, and she takes them.

4326.meaning: the hard substance under the bark of trees
4326.scene: A photograph taken at sunset on a flat grassy plain with a low white farmhouse in the distance. A man in a black beret and a work shirt lifts a heavy iron grill rack loaded with racks of ribs off a long open fire pit, sending a shower of orange sparks up. The pit below is full of burning logs and a thick bed of pale ash. A rough wooden table on the left holds a mate gourd with a metal straw, and the pit itself is framed with thick wooden beams.

4352.scene: A bold comic-book illustration of a skier coming down a steep white slope. She wears a red, white and blue race suit, a blue helmet and mirrored goggles, and is leaning hard into a change of direction: her knees are bent, her body is tipped over towards the inside of the curve, both skis are up on their edges and a thick wall of snow sprays up off them to her left. Both poles trail behind her and speed lines streak down the slope. Above and behind, a cable lift carries red and yellow cabins over dark pine trees, with white mountain peaks and a few clouds in the blue sky.

4369.meaning: a long thin strip of cloth or paper for fastening
4369.scene: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.

4378.meaning: a fixture that sprays water over you
4378.scene: A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.

4381.meaning: having a comfortable degree of heat
4381.scene: A pastel cartoon beach on a bright sunny day. Striped parasols and towels are spread out over the yellow sand, with a bucket and spade beside one of them. A girl in a swimsuit and wrap skirt runs barefoot along the water's edge with her hair streaming behind her, while a beach ball bounces beside her. Seagulls glide overhead and a big sun hangs over the sea.

4383.meaning: not thin, wide from one surface to the other
4383.scene: In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.

4389.meaning: to take the first step in doing something
4389.scene: A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. An official on the poolside waves an arm at him, he goes into the water and swims a length, then climbs out at the wall, picks up his goggles and walks away along the tiles looking furious.

4413.meaning: the sensation you get from odors in the nose
4413.scene: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.

4416.meaning: a document that lets you ride or enter somewhere
4416.scene: At a check-in desk a small printer pushes out a long strip of boarding passes and a hand circles the gate number on it with a blue pen. A traveller with long braids takes hers, reads it and smiles, then holds the printed card against the scanner at the automatic gate until the light turns green. She walks down the jet bridge, through the aircraft door past the crew, and along the aisle looking for her seat.

4417.meaning: the act of going from one place to another
4417.scene: A blonde woman with a red backpack steps up through the doors of a tram, holding the handrail, and turns back to the camera from inside. Next she walks along a gangway onto a small blue and white ferry moored at a sunny harbour. Finally she climbs the aircraft steps onto a plane on the runway and turns at the top of the stairs to wave before going in.

4429.meaning: a building where people go to eat
4429.scene: A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.

4442.meaning: footwear shaped to fit the foot
4442.scene: A hand-drawn illustration of a bright dressing room. A young woman in a long white gown with a veil spins on the spot, her wide skirt lifting and swinging out around her, and she holds a bunch of white daisies up in one hand.
