As the skirt swings up it uncovers her feet: she wears a pair of plain white shoes with a low heel, one flat on the carpet and one lifted behind her as she turns. Behind her are a tall gold-framed mirror, a bright window with cream curtains, vases of flowers and a dress bag hanging on a hook.

4443.meaning: the event at which a marriage ceremony happens
4443.scene: In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.

4447.scene: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.

4451.meaning: a juvenile, between puberty and maturity
4451.scene: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.

4455.meaning: the piece of land where something is located
4455.scene: A drawn scene of a piece of open ground where a house is going up. Metal scaffolding poles rise on the left over a half-built brick wall, a concrete mixer turns on its stand, and two wheelbarrows full of wet mortar stand on the bare earth. In the middle a man in an orange hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest kneels on the ground, spreading mortar with a trowel and setting a brick into place, with a spirit level lying along the top of the courses and a stack of spare bricks beside him.

4463.scene: A soft pastel cartoon of the inside of a bus, seen from behind the passengers. The driver sits at the wheel in a dark blue uniform and peaked cap, smiling broadly with one hand raised in a wave to the people getting on. A ticket roll unspools from the dashboard beside him. In the foreground, a woman in pink, two small children and a boy holding a fluffy dog look up at him, one child waving back. Sunlight comes through the windscreen and the open door.

4464.meaning: to look at written words and understand them
4464.scene: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.

4465.scene: A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.

4499.meaning: to go to see a place
4499.scene: A red-haired young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and a backpack films himself on a selfie stick as he goes round several castles. He runs up a steep grassy slope towards a stone tower and touches the old wall, laughing. The camera then sweeps through a castle courtyard hung with coloured banners, and finally he walks up a path through trees towards an enormous turreted castle on a hill, grinning back at the camera.

4500.scene: A montage of people snatching things out of the air at the last moment. A young woman in a park pulls a falling tennis ball into her chest; a goalkeeper in green throws himself sideways and pins the ball to the grass in front of the goal; a young man in a kitchen shoots out a hand and grabs a plastic bottle before it hits the floor; a woman in a garden takes a whole watermelon out of the air with both hands; a boy lying on the grass stops a huge beach ball above his face with his hands and feet.

4503.scene: A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.

4504.meaning: an event that achieves its intended purpose
4504.scene: An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.

4509.scene: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.

4513.meaning: a large case with a handle for carrying clothes
4513.scene: A blonde woman in a khaki jacket stands with her suitcase in an airport hall in front of a wall of departure boards listing destinations and times. She reaches up and points at one of the rows, then looks down at her watch to see how much time she has left, opens her passport with the tickets inside and reads them, and finally looks back up at the board again with a satisfied smile.

4514.meaning: an ability you gain by training
4514.scene: A cartoon restaurant kitchen. A grinning chef in a tall white hat and white jacket stands in the middle: one hand tosses a copper frying pan whose contents (a lobster, prawns, bell peppers, onion rings and mushrooms) fly up in a huge sheet of orange flame, while the other hand holds out a steaming wooden spoon. Behind him three other cooks in white hats watch him and cheer, one with a pot lid, one with a whisk, one with a knife. Copper pans hang on the wall and plated dishes with silver cloches wait on the pass under warming lamps.

4515.meaning: to be the winner in a contest
4515.scene: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.

4522.meaning: a journey all the way around a place
4522.scene: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.

4527.meaning: a plant part you eat, like roots, leaves or stems
4527.scene: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.

4545.scene: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.

4571.scene: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count. The boat runs down the skids and reaches the water, and the group ends up in a circle in the shallows, hugging each other and cheering.

4588.meaning: the vehicles and people moving along a place
4588.scene: A drawing of a city street at night in heavy rain, lit pink and blue by neon buildings and glowing signs. A young man in a long black hooded coat and white trainers strides across the striped crossing in the middle of the road. Cars are stopped on both sides of him with their headlights on, and other people in raincoats walk across in front of and behind him. The wet road throws back the coloured light in long reflections and rain streaks the air.

4590.meaning: leisure time away from work for rest or fun
4590.scene: A cartoon of the top deck of a big white passenger ship at sunset. A woman in a pink swimsuit leaps off the edge into the deck pool and throws up a huge splash. Around the pool stand rows of red, blue and yellow sun loungers under red-and-white striped parasols on the wooden deck, and a steward in a white uniform and cap carries a tray of cocktails along it. Two striped funnels rise behind, seagulls circle, and beyond the rail the sea is turquoise with a palm island and a big orange sun on the horizon.

4591.meaning: a large vessel that carries passengers or goods
4591.scene: A woman in a straw visor pulls a suitcase up a metal gangway towards an enormous white passenger ship, its many decks of balconies and its orange lifeboats filling the frame behind her. She walks along the ship's wooden promenade deck with a keycard on a lanyard, someone dives into the pool on the top deck between the two funnels, and she eats at a buffet beside the panoramic windows with green cliffs sliding past outside. At sunset she stands at the deck rail with her suitcase as the ship sails through a bay of rocky islands.

4594.meaning: with each other, close or touching
4594.scene: A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.

4603.meaning: an open public way for travel by vehicles
4603.scene: A road cyclist in a teal kit and a white helmet rides down a narrow tarmac road that winds through green tropical hills. The camera holds on him from the front as he drives on the pedals, then swings to the side as he tucks low over the handlebars; behind him the road curves away with a crash barrier along its edge. He leans hard through a bend, then straightens up on a long descent with mountains and cloud filling the horizon.

4606.scene: A young man in an olive jacket films himself with a selfie stick as he travels. First he stands on a stone bridge at sunrise, the river orange behind him and a domed church and a tall gothic tower on the far bank. Then he stands in a crowded square looking straight up at the face of an astronomical clock set into a stone tower, with pigeons bursting into the air around it. Finally he sits in a wood-beamed beer hall, lifts a litre tankard, drinks and laughs with the men beside him.

4612.meaning: to give something in exchange for money
4612.scene: A busy street market. A moustached stallholder in a shirt and waistcoat stands behind a huge pyramid of peaches and holds one up to a young customer, turning it in his fingers to show it off. The customer leans in over the fruit. The vendor then piles peaches into a cardboard box and hands it across the stall. Brass hanging scales sway above the display, other stalls and shoppers fill the street behind.

4619.meaning: not processed or cooked, in a simple natural state
4619.scene: A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.

4623.meaning: a choice made by counting people in favor
4623.scene: A cartoon of an election count. A tall wooden ballot box painted in red, white and blue stripes is tipped on its side above a long wooden trestle table, and folded paper slips pour out of it onto the tabletop. A heap of the slips has already built up in the middle and more flutter through the air. Smiling officials in suits and hats stand along both sides of the table with their hands out, ready to spread the pile and sort it. Behind a rope barrier a crowd of onlookers watches, and banners hang on the brick wall above them.

4628.scene: A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.

4634.scene: A watercolour illustration of a young woman with a backpack standing at the end of a sandy coastal path, seen from behind with both arms thrown up in the air. Below and ahead of her lies a colourful seaside town of pastel houses around a turquoise bay full of small boats, with hills and a warm orange sky behind. Wildflowers grow beside the path in the foreground.

4670.meaning: the protective covering on top of a building
4670.scene: Evening light over an Italian city. A young woman in a white dress stands on the flat roof terrace of an apartment block and hangs washing on lines strung across it. The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.

4673.scene: A black-and-white cartoon in an old gym. A skinny character with thin rubber-hose arms and legs tries to lift one huge dumbbell in one gloved hand. The weight drags his arm and shoulder down, his knees buckle, his face is screwed up and drops of sweat fly off his head. Racks of barbells and dumbbells and a much bigger dumbbell lying on the floor fill the room around him.

4674.meaning: a flat horizontal surface for holding objects
4674.scene: An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.

4676.meaning: a pattern of action passed down over time
4676.scene: A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.

4683.scene: A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.

4685.meaning: to fix something by replacing a broken part
4685.scene: A comic-style illustration on a building site. A young workman in a yellow hard hat sits on a metal stepladder in front of an open grey fuse box on a wooden wall, with a small screwdriver held in his teeth. He holds red-handled pliers in one gloved hand and a bundle of cut red, green and blue wires in the other, and looks up at the row of circuit breakers he is working on. Coils of cable hang over his shoulder and lie on the floor, with a tool belt on his hip and a work light behind him.

4686.meaning: the act of making something work again
4686.scene: A dark flat with no power. A woman in a yellow hard hat with a headlamp stands at a wall panel, holding a pair of pliers and a bundle of coloured wires. Close-ups show gloved hands stripping a red wire and pushing it into a circuit breaker set into a broken-open wall box. A family stands in the dark hallway behind her lighting the corridor with phone torches. She works at the fuse panel, then turns to the camera smiling as the flat lights come back on.

4697.scene: A stark black, white and yellow illustration of a sprinter in the first instant of a race. He is driving out of the starting blocks in a packed floodlit stadium, front knee still on the track, back leg extended, one arm thrown up. A burst of yellow light and jagged lightning bolts explodes from the blocks where his foot pushes off, and white lines streak backwards along the lanes behind him. A spotlight beams down and the crowd is a silhouette in the stands.

4701.scene: A young man in a bucket hat kneels on the wet sand beside a tall, carefully carved sandcastle with towers, battlements and arched gates; kite surfers are out on the sea behind him. The surf runs in around the base of the castle. Each wave eats away more of it: first the outer walls slump, then the towers collapse one after another, until only a shapeless lump of wet sand and one small stump are left in the foam, and he sits back on his heels looking at it.

4715.meaning: a very big green fruit, red and juicy inside
4715.scene: A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.

4722.meaning: dark spectacles that protect the eyes from the sun
4722.scene: An outdoor garden party on a lawn, with a floral arch, string lights and a cream sofa behind. Guests in summer dresses and pale suits stand in a group; several of the women wear dark sunglasses. One by one the women swoon and sag at the knees while the others grab them under the arms and hold them up. A man in a beige suit fans himself with a white plate. By the end everyone is lying on the grass and on cushions, still fanning themselves with plates.

4728.scene: A woman in blue medical scrubs comes home through her front door at the end of a shift, hanging her keys in a bowl. She yawns hugely with her eyes screwed shut, peels off her grey jacket and drops her bag, yawning again and rubbing her face with her hand. She staggers to the sofa and drops onto it sideways, and the clip ends with her lying asleep on the cushions with her eyes closed and her phone beside her.

4733.meaning: the degree of hotness or coldness of something
4733.scene: A watercolour illustration of a boy lying ill in bed. He is propped on a pillow under a checked quilt with a glass thermometer in his mouth and a folded blue cloth laid across his forehead. His cheeks and nose are painted bright red and orange wavy lines rise from his head to show the heat coming off him. A lamp glows on the wooden bedside table beside the bed.

4742.meaning: having more power or strength than normal
4742.scene: An outdoor bootcamp session on a grass field at golden hour, with pull-up bars, mats and kettlebells set out and a trainer and other athletes working in the background. A woman in a dark red sports bra and leggings, with visible arm and stomach muscles, swings two heavy battle ropes up and down with both arms, her jaw set. She then swings a large black kettlebell up between her legs with both hands, breathing hard. Finally she jumps up onto a tall wooden plyo box, lands on top of it, straightens up with her arms thrown open and shouts in triumph while the trainer claps behind her.

4744.meaning: to rest and let your body and mind go calm
4744.scene: A pale turquoise salt lake with bare desert hills behind it. A woman in an orange swimsuit and a wide straw sun hat lies on her back on the surface of the water, arms spread out, not sinking, with a yellow rubber duck bobbing at her shoulder. Behind her three more people lie on their backs in a row in the same way, two of them with their hands folded behind their heads and their eyes closed. The woman drifts, then opens a glossy magazine and holds it up above her face and reads it while she is still lying flat on the water, her feet sticking up at the front of the shot.

4747.meaning: a big white and grey bird that lives by the sea
4747.scene: An older man in a flat cap and a dark knitted cardigan stands at the stern rail of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus at dusk, with the wake churning white behind him and a domed mosque and the city skyline on the shore. He holds a torn piece of bread in one hand and holds crumbs out in the other. One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.

4760.meaning: to use one thing together with someone
4760.scene: On a sunlit cobbled street in Lisbon two teenagers stand face to face with a single ice cream cone between them; he hands it across to her and they slap hands. They then run together along the rails after a yellow tram. The scene cuts to a wooden jetty at sunset where a group of friends dance, then pull into one tight huddle with their arms around each other, silhouetted against the low sun.

4764.meaning: a long soft seat for more than one person
4764.scene: A young woman and a young man sit side by side on a dark green sofa in a plain living room, each holding a lit-up game controller and staring at the screen off camera. A blue bowl of crisps sits on the cushion between them. She jumps up onto the sofa with a fist in the air, cheering, and crisps scatter over the seat; he throws his head back laughing. They drop back down onto the cushions still playing.

4780.meaning: independent, not joined to each other
4780.scene: A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.

4788.meaning: very surprised and upset by something bad
4788.scene: A busy hair salon. A stylist with long braids leans down and cups her hand to the ear of a client sitting under a leopard-print cape; the client's eyes go wide and her mouth drops open. The client is moved under a dome hair dryer and the two keep talking closely. Two women in the background stare with open mouths at a man having his hair clipped by a barber. At the salon's front desk a receptionist looks up from her computer with her mouth open, then the stylist is back beside the client under the dryer, both wide-eyed.

4798.meaning: a building where people go to worship
4798.scene: A woman in a white sundress and a straw hat walks up a stone path towards an ancient hilltop temple with tall columns in golden evening light, then runs down a narrow whitewashed alley under bright pink bougainvillea, then joins friends dancing arm in arm at a seaside table above a blue bay.

4801.meaning: great in height, from the ground up
4801.scene: A woman in a conical straw hat and a green apron waters a tray of tiny seedlings in a greenhouse, then waters tomato plants hung with red tomatoes, then stands beside a sunflower far taller than she is and looks up at its big yellow head.

4820.meaning: the same one, not a different one
4820.scene: Two young women meet face to face in a club with purple and pink neon lights behind them. They are wearing exactly the same patterned mini dress, and they stare at each other's dress with their mouths open. The blonde one shouts angrily at the other, then her face breaks into a smile as they talk it over; the dark haired one starts to cry and laugh at once, and the two of them fall into a long hug in their matching dresses.

4828.meaning: a flat side of a room, taller than its thickness
4828.scene: A man in a green T-shirt works across a tall bare plasterboard wall in an attic room, rolling dark green paint onto it with a long-handled roller. Half the wall is already an even green block, the other half is still grey plasterboard with white filler stripes, and a dust sheet covers the floor at his feet.

4830.meaning: to move through water with your body
4830.scene: Two freedivers in black wetsuits and long fins move through clear blue open water along a thin vertical line. One is far below in the dark blue, the other kicks upward towards the bright surface, and by the end both are near the top with sunlight breaking through the water above them.

4834.meaning: a thing designed to be played with
4834.scene: Two teenage boys lean over a wooden table with their elbows on it, watching a black plastic battle dish. Inside it a yellow spinning top and a purple spinning top race around the bowl, knock into each other and keep spinning, and both boys grin and laugh as they follow them.

4837.meaning: furniture with a flat top and legs
4837.scene: A group of friends sit around a long wooden dining table by a bright window, covered with dishes: a whole roast chicken, a pizza in its box, bowls of salad, pasta and fries, a round loaf of bread and glasses of beer. They pass plates of grilled vegetables across the table to each other, one woman holds out a slice of pizza, hands tear pieces off the loaf, and the camera pulls back to show the whole laden table with everyone smiling and reaching over it.

4838.meaning: to send something through the air
4838.scene: On a wide sunny beach a young woman in a bikini swings her arm and sends a small ball flying up over the sand. The shot cuts to a yellow ball high against the blue sky over the surf, then to her standing with legs apart and both arms raised as a watermelon-patterned ball drops towards her hands. A large red, white and blue beach ball sails through the air while a man runs under it, and finally she laughs as a rainbow-striped ball comes back at her and the man lands in the sand behind.

4842.meaning: to do physical or mental work for a purpose
4842.scene: A woman in a blue t-shirt stands at a white kitchen sink with the tap running hard into the basin. Cut to a workshop, where a woman in dark overalls kneels on a sawdust-covered floor and drives a cordless drill into the leg of a wooden chair. Then a pair of hands on a grey table hold an opened blue phone with its back off, the battery and circuit board exposed. A teenager in a checked shirt leans over the engine bay of an old blue car in a driveway with a spanner, and finally he punches the air and shouts beside the open bonnet.

4843.meaning: a thing built from many parts
4843.scene: On a trestle table in a sunny garden a man taps a hammer against a small wooden birdhouse, holding a finger over the round entrance hole. He steps back and turns the finished birdhouse, with its pitched roof, little porch and railings, to the camera. Cut to a lawn where about eight people crouch around a huge folded grey tarpaulin and spread it out flat. Then the same group heave a tall triangular timber wall frame upright, and finally they stand back on the grass looking up at the finished wooden house frame standing on its slab.

4849.meaning: the warmest season of the year
4849.scene: A hand tips a metal watering can over two terracotta pots of green herbs on a sunlit window sill, with trees in full leaf outside the open window. Cut to a close shot of a hand turning the knob on a sprinkler head standing in bright green grass. The sprinkler sends a tall jet of water arcing over a lawn with a stone fountain and flower beds behind. Then a girl reaches up to a hanging basket spilling pink and green foliage against a blue sky. Finally a man and two children run through the spray of a garden sprinkler, with a rainbow in the mist.

4854.meaning: to find the solution to a problem
4854.scene: A young man with wild hair and glasses stands at a huge blackboard in a university lecture hall full of students. He writes chalk equations fast, checks a pocket calculator, keeps writing, punches the air, and by the end the entire wall-sized blackboard is filled with mathematics while he stands back in front of it.

4855.meaning: to recall something from your memory
4855.scene: A young man in glasses with headphones round his neck sits at a desk holding small word cards. He taps his temple, reads a card, flips it over and drops it, and the cards multiply until the desk is buried and the wall behind him is papered with them.

4856.meaning: a person whose job is teaching
4856.scene: A woman with glasses and a pencil in her bun sits at a desk in an empty classroom marking a pupil's paper with a red pen. She corrects sheet after sheet and stacks of marked papers rise on the desk until towers of paper wall her in and she looks up, overwhelmed.

4857.meaning: a person who works at a job
4857.scene: A man in a yellow hi-vis vest and white gloves stands in a warehouse holding a handheld barcode scanner. He frowns at it, shakes it, then scans the label on a cardboard box and a red VERIFIED stamp appears; he goes on scanning boxes moving along a long conveyor belt between tall storage racks.

4864.meaning: clothing a group wears to be identified
4864.scene: A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

4872.meaning: a score showing the value of something
4872.scene: A woman in a leather cap and khaki jacket sits at a table set with small bowls of food, holding a clipboard and a pen. She stamps rows of stars onto small white cards with a rubber stamp and holds one up, wide-eyed. The table fills with dozens of cards each showing five stars, some black and some gold. The final wide shot reveals the table and the whole wall behind her covered with hundreds of identical five-star cards.

4874.meaning: a signal that controls traffic at a crossing
4874.scene: A cyclist in a yellow jersey and a white-and-yellow helmet is stopped at a big city junction, mouth open in shock; above and beside her a traffic light shows green and amber. The camera pulls back and pedestrians, runners and a dog stream across the striped crossing in front of her while tall buildings rise on both sides.

4875.meaning: a big road vehicle for hauling things
4875.scene: Outside a suburban house a woman in work gloves carries a cardboard box down the drive past a wall of stacked boxes, then a tower of five boxes. Behind her a large white box truck stands open with a ramp down; she and two other movers slide boxes and a brown leather sofa up the ramp into the truck's cargo hold, which is already packed with boxes.

4877.scene: A woman in a cream jumper and jeans is seated alone in a padded seat in an empty auditorium, blowing out a breath. As the camera pulls back, more and more people are seated in the rows around and behind her, until the whole vast hall is full of people sitting quietly in their seats, all facing the same way.

4883.meaning: to make something visible for everyone to see
4883.scene: A woman in a bright floral sundress walks smiling down a pale hallway; tall carved wooden double doors appear; she strides through the vaulted hall of an Italian villa with her arms flung wide; she pushes two huge studded wooden doors apart, steps outside, and the open doors show a sunlit valley of green hills behind her.

4885.meaning: a road in a town lined with buildings
4885.scene: A woman in a beige utility vest holds a small rainbow flag up high and walks up a sunny cobbled street in an old Italian hill town; stone houses with shutters and balconies line both sides, and a long line of people follows her up the street.

4892.meaning: trousers that end above the knee
4892.scene: A first-person ride down a water slide: bare legs in colourful swim shorts race feet-first through a blue chute past palm trees and a bright sky, then down a green flume into a burst of white water; the shot ends on the whole waterslide tower above a busy pool.

4894.meaning: not in motion, completely without movement
4894.scene: In a school sports hall a teenage boy in a grey shirt stands motionless on the centre line of the basketball court; the camera pulls back and more and more students appear standing in the same frozen pose, until an aerial view shows the whole hall filled with rows of unmoving students.

4896.meaning: a dark shade with clear edges
4896.scene: A group of friends crouches together in a circle on a sunlit cobbled square; a moment later everyone is running outward in every direction in front of a domed basilica, and the low sun throws a long dark shadow with sharp edges behind each runner on the pale stones.

4910.meaning: a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
4910.scene: A young man in a packed football stadium films himself in the stands. His face is painted in two halves, blue-yellow and red, and a long striped team scarf in club colours hangs around his neck over his shirt. A wide shot shows the ring of the stadium full of fans with a flag being waved on a pole. He shouts and screams with joy, the fans around him leap up and hold a scarf overhead, and he ends hugging a friend and roaring at the camera.

4915.meaning: the body part between the neck and the arm
4915.scene: Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.

4917.meaning: to hit something with a missile from a weapon
4917.scene: Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.

4923.meaning: to show someone to a seat
4923.scene: A blonde young woman in a white shirt and a black waist apron smiles at the camera inside a warm, candlelit restaurant. She walks through the dining room holding leather menu folders under one arm, passing seated guests and a bar. She reaches an empty wooden table, lays the menus down on the two chairs and gestures at the table with an open hand. A couple follows her in and takes the places she has shown them while she stands beside the table.

4933.meaning: a round frame that turns on an axle
4933.scene: A young man in a light blue shirt and dark tie sits in the driver's seat of a city bus at a depot, both hands on the large black steering wheel. He turns the wheel as the bus rolls out; a low shot from behind the wheel shows the dashboard and the road ahead. Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.

4937.meaning: to sound loudly, like a bell
4937.scene: A young man in a denim apron works the griddle of an American diner with red booths behind him. He cracks an egg onto the hot plate beside frying eggs and pancakes, flips the pancakes with a spatula, and stacks them on a green-rimmed plate. Syrup is poured over a pat of butter on top of the stack. He then leans over the counter, eyes wide, and strikes the metal service bell with his palm to call the order away.

4938.meaning: a woman who serves food to guests in a restaurant
4938.scene: On a sunny café terrace a young woman in a white shirt and striped apron carries plates between wooden tables where guests are sitting. A couple at a table laugh and raise their coffee cups. She walks to a table by the railing and sets down a plate of dessert. A close shot shows a hand writing an order in a spiral notepad with a pencil, next to a cappuccino and a jar of white flowers. She turns to the camera and smiles, a pencil stuck in her hair.

4945.meaning: to make music with your voice by singing
4945.scene: A young woman in an oversized band T-shirt presses a pair of big headphones to her ears in a recording booth strung with warm fairy lights. She leans into a large studio microphone behind a pop filter and belts out a note with her eyes shut and her mouth wide open. A cut shows an older man at a mixing desk pushing the faders. She keeps singing with her arms flung out, then laughs and looks over at a screen where the man behind the glass is clapping.

4954.meaning: going to see someone for a short time
4954.scene: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.

4956.meaning: the front desk where guests check in
4956.scene: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

4994.scene: An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.

5000.meaning: not thick from one surface to the other
5000.scene: A sushi counter clip. A young chef in a white jacket and a white headband leans over a wooden block and cuts thin flat slices off a long orange fillet of raw fish with a narrow knife. He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.

5004.meaning: to move forward in big leaps
5004.scene: A watercolour of red desert at sunset. A kangaroo is caught in mid-air, both back feet off the ground, driving itself forward in a long bound across the red sand, its heavy tail streaming out behind it for balance. A joey's head pokes out of the pouch on its belly. Dust puffs up where its feet just left the ground, low saltbushes dot the sand and pink clouds fill the sky.

5012.meaning: a loving relationship between two people
5012.scene: At a Paris cafe two young women in coats lean in close over a marble bistro table holding two cappuccinos. Then an elderly couple at a cafe table hold each other's faces and kiss. Next a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man leaning the woman backwards, and they end in a long hug on the pavement while cafe guests watch.

5014.meaning: having a lot of money and material wealth
5014.scene: Three cooks in three very different kitchens. An old man in a vest tastes soup from a wooden spoon over a battered pot on a gas ring in a tiled, run-down room, then cracks an egg into it. A woman in a bright white kitchen lifts a baked cheesy dish out of the oven with oven gloves. Finally a man in a black turtleneck tosses peppers in a frying pan in a penthouse kitchen with copper pans hanging overhead and the night skyline in the windows, then spreads his arms wide.

5020.meaning: to put a new thing in place of a broken one
5020.scene: In a bright flat a young woman points up at a ceiling fitting whose bare bulb is dead. She and a young man carry in an aluminium stepladder and open it under the fitting; she climbs the steps while he steadies the frame, screws a new bulb into the socket and it lights up warm and bright. They look up at the working light, then fold the ladder away.

5022.meaning: to be bright by casting or reflecting light
5022.scene: Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.

5035.meaning: natural abilities or qualities you have
5035.scene: In a sunny park a young person in a rainbow tie-dye tracksuit bends down and picks up three pastel balls from the grass, then straightens up and juggles them in a smooth cascade. Three friends sit on the lawn behind and watch, smiling. The juggler grins wide as the balls arc above their head.

5037.meaning: the paved path beside a road where people walk
5037.scene: A woman in a camel trench coat wheels a grey suitcase across a marble hotel lobby and out through a revolving glass door. She steps onto the wide paved sidewalk of a Paris street, cars passing on the road right beside her, and looks around while other people walk past her on the same pavement. She then comes back in and stops at the reception counter with a document in her hand.

5045.meaning: the effect you hear from something
5045.scene: At night on a neon-lit Korean shopping street, a young man with bleached hair and headphones around his neck cups a hand behind his ear towards the camera, then pulls the headphones up over his ears. The camera swings down to the pavement, where a big silver boombox with two round speakers stands next to a lamppost, playing while shoppers pass behind it. The clip ends at a concert in front of a towering wall of stacked loudspeakers, with a performer on stage and the crowd's hands in the air.

5046.meaning: broadcasting moving pictures to a screen
5046.scene: A cartoon illustration of three young people watching television in a living room at night. The glow of the screen, just out of frame at the left, lights the whole room blue. A man in a yellow jumper leaps up off the sofa with both arms raised, sending a bowl of popcorn flying so the kernels rain down through the air, a woman in a blue dress on the sofa punches the air, and a man in a green polo shirt sprawls back laughing. Behind them are a floor lamp with an orange shade, a bookshelf and a striped rug.

5066.meaning: a small part that shows what the whole is like
5066.scene: A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.

5080.meaning: the color between green and orange
5080.scene: A young woman in a bright yellow sundress stands in a small clothes boutique in front of a tall wooden-framed mirror and looks at her reflection. She takes a mirror selfie with her phone in front of racks of clothes, then leans towards a vanity mirror ringed with bulbs and checks her face, then spins so the yellow skirt flares out between two mirrors. In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.

5085.meaning: a sculpture of a person or animal
5085.scene: A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.

5108.meaning: a place where people live, smaller than a town
5108.scene: A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.

5109.scene: On a rooftop terrace at sunset a young woman in a denim jacket carries a tray of a dozen frosted cupcakes, cream swirls topped with chocolate, past strings of bulb lights. She sets the tray on a wooden table beside a small card that reads Welcome, walks to the glass door and knocks, then comes back, sits down alone at the table with the city skyline glowing behind her and reaches for the tray.

5110.meaning: with almost no activity going on
5110.scene: A watercolour painting of an empty wooden park bench standing on a path in a misty park. Bare grey trees fade into the fog behind it, fallen brown and orange leaves cover the ground, long shadows stretch across the path, and a single dried leaf lies alone on the seat of the bench. There is not a single person anywhere in the scene.

5115.meaning: to look at something in detail
5115.scene: In a meadow full of wild flowers a young woman in an olive rain jacket and a cap, her red hair in plaits, crouches down to a fallen wooden log lying in the grass. She holds a magnifying glass over a small green insect sitting on the bark and moves in close, her eye almost against the lens, studying it from a few centimetres away. Then she turns to an open notebook lying in the grass, full of pencil drawings of insects, and adds a new sketch with her pencil.

5118.meaning: the light and rays that come from the sun
5118.scene: Low morning sun pours through an open kitchen window over a dark worktop and a sink, with two potted herbs on the sill and rooftops beyond. A young man in a loose white shirt turns and walks down a bright hallway with a strip of sunlight across the parquet floor. He reaches the tall French windows, pushes them open and stands in the doorway as the sun floods over him. He steps out onto the small balcony, arms spread, and looks over the sunlit Paris rooftops with the sun low in a clear blue sky.

5125.meaning: to perform a play on a stage
5125.scene: Filmed from the seats of an old theatre, a play is being performed on the lit stage. A costumed actor with a moustache sits on a golden throne wearing a metal helmet while actors dressed as ragged peasants storm him with makeshift weapons. They tip the throne over and he tumbles onto a white mattress laid on the boards; a woman in rags holds the helmet up over her head and the whole auditorium rises, cheering and applauding.

5127.meaning: to move a lid so an opening is closed
5127.scene: In a bedroom papered with travel posters, a young woman kneels over a hard-shell suitcase lying open on the bed. She folds T-shirts and stacks them in until the case is heaped over the rim, then grabs the lid and swings it down. It will not close, so she climbs on top, sits on the lid with her whole weight and presses it down with both hands, pulling faces the whole time.

5138.meaning: railway cars joined together that carry people
5138.scene: A young woman in a mustard beanie climbs the steps into a train while a member of staff helps lift her hard-shell suitcase; another train and travellers with luggage are on the platform behind her. Inside, she walks down the narrow carriage corridor holding her ticket, heaves the suitcase onto the overhead rack, then sits by the window and watches the platform and rails slide past as the train pulls away.

5145.meaning: an electric city train on rails in the street
5145.scene: A young man in an orange hooded jacket with a bag strapped across his chest walks quickly along a brick pavement in a Dutch city, past shoppers and parked bicycles. He steps off the kerb and crosses a wide zebra crossing while the light shows red for cars, then hurries down a narrow lane lined with flower stalls full of tulips and bunches in buckets. He comes out on a big paved square where a long blue and white electric train runs along rails in the street right behind him, with cyclists passing in front of it. He looks down at his wrist as he keeps walking with the tram still rolling past behind him.

5173.meaning: a waterproof coat you wear in the rain
5173.scene: A hand holds a metal bottle under a thin fall of water trickling off a mossy cliff and fills it; then a woman in a bright red hooded raincoat with an orange backpack walks along a wet path, reaches into the spray of a small waterfall, and finally stands in front of a huge waterfall, mouth open, looking up at it.

5177.meaning: a container with a spout for pouring tea
5177.scene: A young woman with red braids in denim dungarees leans over a wooden garden table and pours tea from a white teapot into a small cup on a saucer, then pours orange juice from a glass jug into a row of tall glasses, and finally tips a clay pitcher of juice into a large glass bowl.

5180.meaning: someone who speaks to a group of people
5180.scene: A charcoal drawing of a man in a dark suit and tie standing at a tall wooden lectern on a stage; a spotlight falls on him from behind heavy drawn curtains, flags stand on either side, and he raises one open hand as he talks into a slim microphone.

5189.meaning: the state of the sky: sun, rain, wind, clouds
5189.scene: A wet cobbled street outside a Paris cafe under a grey sky. An elderly man with a white moustache, a flat cap and a beige trench coat holds his bare palm out flat to feel whether it is still raining, a folded red umbrella under his arm. Drops keep falling, so he lifts the umbrella, opens it with a snap over his head and stands under it, smiling at the camera while rain streaks past and other people pass behind him with their own umbrellas up.

5190.meaning: with a lot of wind blowing
5190.scene: A young woman stands in the pouring rain on a wet village street wearing a clear plastic rain jacket, grinning at the camera. She then appears in a bright yellow raincoat, doing up the front and pulling the hood up over her hair while rain falls around her. In the last part she stands on a seafront promenade in an orange raincoat and spotted rubber boots, grey sky above, big waves smashing over the railing behind her, and she spreads her arms wide as the wind and spray hit her.

5191.meaning: covered with snow or full of falling snow
5191.scene: On a flat white plain that is covered in snow to the horizon, a woman in a thick orange polar parka with a fur-trimmed hood holds a rope on a metal flagpole. A Norwegian flag climbs the pole against a deep blue sky. Two more people in the same orange parkas pull on the rope together to hoist the flag while others stand around holding mugs, a small hut on the snow behind them. The flag reaches the top and flaps in the wind above the group.

5201.meaning: to send an image or light back
5201.scene: A woman in a pink jacket and a woollen bobble hat stands on a flooded salt flat so still that it works like a mirror: her whole body, the snow-capped volcano and every cloud appear again upside down in the water below her. She crouches down, touches the surface with one fingertip so rings spread out, then stands up and walks away, small against the doubled sky.

5202.meaning: to set something down in a certain place
5202.scene: A woman opens a big double-door fridge and finds it almost bare, with only one jar of pickles on a shelf. Then hands start placing food inside: an apple onto a glass shelf, a bag of lettuce and cucumbers onto the shelf below, jars and a juice carton into the door racks. At the end she steps back in front of a fridge packed with fruit, vegetables, milk and juice and her mouth falls open.

5212.meaning: a place with special equipment for one purpose
5212.scene: Under the glass roof of a big railway station a family waits on the platform: a father in a cap, a mother in tears and a teenage son holding up a hand-drawn welcome sign, trains standing at the platforms behind them. A young woman with a rucksack and a duffel bag comes running out through the Arrivals doorway, drops her bag and throws herself into their arms. The four of them stand hugging on the platform, crying and laughing.

5217.meaning: clothing without sleeves worn over a shirt
5217.scene: A smiling man in a yellow high-visibility vest pulled on over his t-shirt stands on a terracotta tiled roof above an Italian old town; the camera pans away from him across a sea of red-tiled roofs, bell towers and a green dome under a clear blue sky, then comes back to him as he throws an arm out toward the view.

5218.meaning: a space inside a building with walls and a floor
5218.scene: A girl in a mustard cardigan opens one door after another in an old house: a dark panelled study, a small yellow kitchen, a bedroom with a patchwork quilt on the bed, and finally a tall vaulted hall with arched windows, which she walks into and turns around in.

5224.meaning: belonging to a king or queen
5224.scene: A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.

5228.meaning: to fall as snow from the sky
5228.scene: A drawn illustration of a wide open city square in the middle of a heavy snowfall: thick white flakes fall across the whole picture and the cobblestones are buried under deep snow. A woman in a fur hat, a long fur-trimmed coat, mittens and boots pushes forward through the snow, her long scarf and coat blown sideways by the wind. Behind her stand a many-domed cathedral, a red brick tower and a flag on a pole, all of them white with settled snow, under a grey sky.

5237.meaning: a body of hot gases that shines in the sky
5237.scene: A short travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and a checked headscarf sprints up the crest of a red dune at dusk, then stands at a sandstone cliff face and touches carved figures and inscriptions cut into the rock. The clip ends at night by a campfire in the desert, under a sky thick with stars, where someone pours tea from a brass pot into his small cup and he lifts it towards the camera.

5248.meaning: a payment you make to use something
5248.scene: A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.

5249.meaning: to clean something using a chemical process
5249.scene: A young man in a grey sweatshirt and mint-green rubber gloves stands at a kitchen sink and works on a blackened cast-iron frying pan, rubbing it hard with a soapy steel-wool pad until foam covers it. He lifts a heavy sooty pot out of the sink and scours its round underside, grimacing with the effort. He then hauls a cast-iron grill pan with a ridged rack out of the water, sets it over the sink and scours the black bars of the rack with both hands, foam and grime running off into the basin.

5251.scene: An older woman with short white hair and red glasses sits behind a curved wooden reception counter in a busy open-plan office. She holds a corded telephone handset to her ear with one hand while her other hand moves over the keys of a keyboard on the counter in front of her. She then leans over an open ring notebook and writes in it with a pencil, still on the phone, and presses a rubber stamp down onto a sheet of paper. At the end she laughs and raises her hand to greet someone off camera. Behind her, colleagues work at desks with monitors and rows of files.

5253.meaning: older, or higher in rank than others
5253.scene: In a sunny green park, an old man with white hair, a flat cap and a beige suit strides and bounces along the path with his arms swinging, laughing at the camera. A grey-haired man in a cycling jersey pedals a bicycle along the same tree-lined path. Then a group of about ten white-haired women and men in summer dresses and light clothes stand spread out on a paved square doing a dance-exercise class together, arms stretched out to the side, all moving in time under the trees.

5266.meaning: equipment you use to talk to someone far away
5266.scene: A retro cartoon illustration of a living room. A woman in a blue jumper and brown skirt bends forward with both gloved hands pressed to her open mouth, her eyes wide and her hair flying back, with jagged shock lines drawn around her head. On the floor beside her stands a cream rotary telephone; its handset has been dropped and hangs swinging on its coiled cord, with motion lines showing it still moving. A brown sofa and a table lamp stand behind her.

5270.meaning: a big store selling food and household goods
5270.scene: A young woman in a supermarket aisle grabs cereal boxes off the shelves and throws them into her trolley as she pushes it down the aisle. The pile in the trolley grows shot by shot until, at the checkout, she stands beside a trolley stacked with a tower of cereal boxes far above her head.

5281.meaning: someone who is very skilled and famous
5281.scene: A bright neon poster shows a young man in a shiny jacket on stage, eyes shut and mouth wide open as he belts into a hand-held microphone. Crossed beams of pink, yellow and blue spotlight sweep behind him and one arm is flung up above his head. Along the bottom the black silhouettes of a packed audience reach their hands up towards him.

5282.meaning: a short piece of music with words
5282.scene: Four scenes of people performing music with words. A grey-haired busker plays an acoustic guitar and sings into a microphone on a cobbled Lisbon street while a crowd stands round listening. A woman in a colourful apron sings into a wooden spoon in her kitchen while pots simmer behind her. Four friends belt out a number together in a car at night with the city lights behind them. Finally a performer in a white suit sings into a microphone on a huge arena stage in front of a packed, floodlit crowd.

5283.meaning: anything shaped like a tall column
5283.scene: A woman in a bright patchwork shirt and headwrap lowers a huge column of colourful plates into a steel kitchen sink, adding more plates to the top of the stack. Water pours over the tall pile and white foam runs down its sides. She rinses the plates one by one and slots them into the draining rack, and the camera ends on the empty gleaming sink and its drain as she smiles down at it.

5286.meaning: a warm soft long-sleeved top, often oversized
5286.scene: Two young women in a bedroom hung with fairy lights play tug-of-war over a lilac hooded sweatshirt, both laughing. They then bunch it up between them and pull faces at a phone held out at arm's length for a selfie. In the last third they sit on the bed and one plaits the other's hair while she gives a thumbs-up.

5287.scene: Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.

5288.meaning: narrow runners used in pairs to glide on snow
5288.scene: A skier in a red one-piece suit and helmet carves down a wide groomed piste in bright sun, throwing up a spray of snow on every turn. The camera follows from the side; behind him are snow-covered alpine peaks, a chairlift line and dozens of other skiers spread across the slope.

5294.meaning: soft warm shoes worn inside the house
5294.scene: A woman in checked pyjamas and a beige cardigan stands barefoot on a cold tiled hallway floor, hopping from foot to foot and hugging herself, shivering. A close-up shows her feet stepping into a pair of white fluffy sheep-face slippers on the wooden floor. She then walks comfortably down the hallway towards the camera in the slippers, relaxed and smiling.

5296.meaning: done the old way, from tradition
5296.scene: Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.

5303.meaning: a single small ice crystal that falls as snow
5303.scene: A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.

5305.meaning: a large social group with its own culture
5305.scene: A cream-and-black woodcut-style print showing a whole town at work at once, laid out as one connected scene. At the top a fisherman hauls a net from a rowing boat while the sun rises over a village of small houses and a town hall. Below, a driver leans out of a steam locomotive holding a lantern. In the middle a teacher stands at a blackboard with a book, pointing, while two children write on it. A baker in an apron pulls loaves from a brick oven and hands a wrapped parcel to a young workman, who in turn passes bread on. A doctor in a white coat listens to a seated patient's chest. At the bottom a bricklayer builds a wall and a farmer in a straw hat swings a scythe through wheat, with tied sheaves stacked beside him.

5308.meaning: a very tall flower with a big round yellow head
5308.scene: A young woman in a cream cardigan sits at a kitchen table biting into a chocolate-chip cookie, a plate of more cookies in front of her and fairy lights strung on the wall behind. Something makes her look up; she gets up, still holding the cookie, and pads down the hallway to the front door in slippers. She presses her face to the peephole and squints through it. She opens the door and a delivery man in an orange high-visibility jacket and helmet is standing there holding an enormous bunch of sunflowers — big round yellow heads on long green stems. Her mouth falls open in delight and she takes the bunch in both arms.

5310.meaning: a male child of his parents
5310.scene: A boy stands with his father at the open bonnet of a car in a bright garage; the father hands him a spanner and both grin. The same boy is then hugged tight by his mother in a white kitchen, kicks a football back and forth with his father on the driveway, and finally plays with other children on a park lawn while the parents watch.

5318.scene: A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.

5319.meaning: a network formed by weaving threads
5319.scene: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing: a wide spider web is strung between bare tree branches, and a large spider hangs on a thread just below it. Drops hang along the web threads, a single leaf drifts down, and patterned flowers fill the bottom of the page.

5321.meaning: to glide over ice wearing ice skates
5321.scene: A figure skater in a navy outfit glides across an ice rink with one leg stretched out behind him, pulls his arms in to his chest and spins fast on one skate, then slows, straightens up and glides away across the ice.

5323.meaning: a lump or mass of hard rock
5323.scene: Two children sit on a wooden jetty at a turquoise mountain lake. A man picks up a large grey stone lying on the boards, carries it to the edge with both hands and hurls it into the water, throwing up a huge white splash. He then jumps in himself and surfaces in the lake.

5324.meaning: a soft object with holes used for washing
5324.scene: A young woman stands at a kitchen sink and squeezes a white drop of dish soap from a blue-capped bottle onto a yellow-and-green sponge she holds over a large steel pan crusted with red tomato sauce. She scrubs the inside of the pan with the sponge under the running tap until foam covers the surface and the sauce washes away. She rinses the pan, then turns to the camera holding the clean, shining pan in one hand and the sponge in the other.

5329.meaning: a small hard fruit that grows into a plant
5329.scene: A man's open palm fills the frame holding one small pale seed that has split open, with a white root curling out of it and two tiny green leaves. He crouches over a black seed tray of soil blocks where the same seeds have pushed up as bent green shoots, laughing and pointing at one of them with his finger. The shot pulls back to show him standing behind the tray of seedlings with a large green field stretching to the horizon behind him at dusk.

5330.meaning: a secret agent who gets information for a state
5330.scene: At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.

5338.meaning: to stay put in one certain place
5338.scene: A price caption rises with every scene. At 10 euros a backpacker climbs barefoot onto a metal bunk in a crowded hostel dormitory. At 100 euros a woman in a suit opens the door of a bright hotel room with a city view and walks in past the big white bed. At 10,000 euros an older couple step out through glass doors onto the deck of an overwater villa with a glass floor over turquoise water, then sit together on the bed above the sea, laughing.

5346.meaning: the muscular organ that holds the food you eat
5346.scene: A curly-haired young man stands in a school canteen queue with both hands flat on his middle, wincing and talking as the line shuffles past trays of food. He then sits at a table and forks up a huge mouthful of spaghetti in tomato sauce, chews with his eyes shut, and finally leans back and pats his middle with both hands, satisfied.

5347.scene: A traffic policeman in a khaki uniform and peaked cap stands on the centre line of a busy Indian street. He raises a white-gloved palm towards the oncoming traffic and the scooters, motorbikes and cars slow and come to a halt in front of him. A city bus rolls up and stops right behind him, and he then stretches both arms out sideways to hold the two lanes still.

5348.scene: On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.

5362.meaning: foolish in a funny, ludicrous way
5362.scene: A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.

5378.meaning: to put something down in a certain place
5378.scene: Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.

5390.meaning: a young person, especially a young man or boy
5390.scene: Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

5401.scene: A black-and-white montage of five people puzzling over something they want to figure out: a young woman in a kitchen holds a pen against her chin and stares upward with a frown; a man at a chess board in a library hovers his hand over a piece; a teenager in a hoodie presses a hand over his eyes; a student in a jumper bites her pen over an open notebook; finally a young woman at a kitchen table gasps with delight and starts writing on her papers.

5403.meaning: what clocks measure, in hours and minutes
5403.scene: A young woman in a beige trench coat stands at a glass tram shelter and runs her finger down a printed timetable, then looks at her wristwatch and smiles. At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.

5406.meaning: one of the five small end parts of the foot
5406.scene: A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.

5407.meaning: the bathroom fixture you sit on to pee
5407.scene: At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.

5409.meaning: one of the hard white parts in your jaws
5409.scene: A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.

5410.meaning: a small brush used for cleaning the teeth
5410.scene: A close shot shows a blue-and-white tube squeezing a stripe of pale blue paste onto the bristles of a small green-and-white brush. A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.

5415.meaning: the color at the end of the spectrum
5415.scene: A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.

5429.meaning: to have confidence in other people
5429.scene: In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.

5441.meaning: the brother of your father or mother
5441.scene: A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.

5447.scene: A single dusty old pickup truck is parked on the shoulder of a two-lane road that runs dead straight into an empty desert, with nothing else in sight in any direction: no houses, no other cars, no people, just scrub, sand and huge red rock buttes standing far off on the horizon in the low evening sun. A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans steps up onto the truck's front wheel and reaches for the roof, her hair blown sideways. A small flag on a pole is fixed behind the cab and flaps in the wind. The road's faded yellow centre line runs away to the far horizon.

5457.meaning: someone who comes to visit you
