5457.scene: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.

5464.scene: A watercolour and ink drawing of a woman's body from the neck to the knees. She wears a fitted blue-grey long-sleeved top and dark grey jeans. Her build is narrow and slender: the top follows a thin torso that pulls in above the hips. Her right hand rests flat on her side just above the hip, her left arm hangs down. The background is a plain cream wash.

5468.meaning: a big board that shows advertisements
5468.scene: A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

5480.meaning: a piece of work you take on
5480.scene: A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.

5487.meaning: the sport of riding a surfboard on waves
5487.scene: A high-contrast black-and-white illustration of a giant ocean wave curling over into a hollow barrel; inside the glowing turquoise tube a tiny silhouetted surfer crouches on a surfboard, riding along the face of the wave. Spray flies off the crest above and dark rocks and choppy water fill the foreground.

5489.scene: In a bright clothing boutique lined with rails of coats, a woman poses for the camera in one outfit after another. She is first dressed in an oversized denim jacket and a colourful scarf, then in a long red coat, then in a silver sequinned mini dress, then in a thick knitted coat, and finally in an enormous feathered coat with a matching feather hat. Between each look the shot cuts and she is dressed in the next piece.

5495.meaning: a story passed around by word of mouth
5495.scene: In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.

5498.meaning: a glass opening in a wall that lets in light
5498.scene: A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.

5499.scene: A sunny open-air street market lined with fruit and vegetable stalls and tall old apartment blocks. A young woman in a red summer dress spins round on the pavement, hair flying, laughing. A second woman in a neon-yellow sports top and black leggings jogs towards the camera down the same street. An elderly white-haired woman leans out of a first-floor window onto a balcony packed with red geraniums, watering can in hand, smiling down. Back at street level the woman in red meets a woman in a navy business suit carrying a briefcase; they talk face to face beside a stall of tomatoes, then stand together with shopping bags while the woman in red waves at the camera.

5507.meaning: a place where wild animals are kept to see
5507.scene: A young man in a bright palm-print shirt tours a zoo holding a spotting sheet of animal pictures. He crouches on the grass and lets a goat eat a handful of hay out of his hands, then stands at a glass pool where penguins stand on the rocks and swim past him, and finally holds a leafy branch up to a giraffe that leans over the wooden fence and takes the leaves with its tongue.

4001.meaning: a fast military plane that fights enemy aircraft
4001.scene: A hand lowers two slices of white bread into slots on the back of a grey model fighter jet standing on a granite kitchen counter. The heating elements inside the slots glow orange and a blue-and-orange flame roars out of the jet's exhaust nozzle like an afterburner. The flame dies down and the hand lifts out two browned slices.

4002.meaning: a steady state where you do not fall over
4002.scene: Two women type at computers in a bright open-plan office. The camera whips round to a long meeting table where a woman in a dark leotard holds a handstand on the tabletop, legs straight up in the air. Colleagues crowd both sides of the table, throwing their arms up, cheering and filming her on their phones.

4013.meaning: a floor or platform built into a vessel
4013.scene: A first-person view looks down from the bow of a wooden sailing ship at the planking and rigging beneath, with the viewer's boots on the boards and loose pack ice drifting in the dark water either side. The camera lifts to a huge pale blue iceberg passing the varnished rail, then to snow-covered mountains mirrored in the flat polar sea.

4025.meaning: to go after someone to catch them
4025.scene: A fluffy grey kitten stands on a windowsill next to a wooden toy tower made of stacked spiral ramps, with bare winter trees outside the window. A small green ball rolls down the ramps and the kitten swats at it with one paw, then follows it round the tower to the bottom tray. It bats the ball again, rears up on its hind legs to reach the top ramp, and finally leans right over the top bowl and takes the ball in its mouth.

4039.meaning: to move slowly with the body near the ground
4039.scene: In a gym lit with purple and green neon, a man and a woman are down on their hands and toes at the start of a marked running track, joined by a long red resistance band. They crawl forwards along the track side by side with their hips low, the band stretching tighter behind them. The band pulls the woman back and she is dragged flat onto her stomach, then ends up sitting on the track laughing while the man stands over her holding the band.

4059.meaning: to give food to someone or an animal
4059.scene: Filmed from the driver's seat through the windscreen of a safari vehicle on a dirt track in the bush, with the steering wheel and dashboard in the foreground. A single yellow banana has been stood upright on the bonnet. A large baboon walks along the bonnet towards it and sits down beside it; a second and then a third baboon climb up and sit in a row, all staring at the banana with more of the troop on the track behind. One of them finally reaches out, takes the banana and starts to eat it while the others crowd in around it.

4066.meaning: loose earth or soil on the ground
4066.scene: A green parrot stands on bare red earth while a hand lowers a tiny motocross helmet onto its head. The parrot hops onto a miniature dirt bike and rides off down a track of deep red-brown dirt that runs through open eucalyptus woodland. A low close-up shows the rear tyre spinning on the loose dirt as the bike speeds along, then the camera looks up from ground level as the parrot launches the bike off a mound of red dirt and lands, riding away over the ridge.

4086.meaning: to cut or grip something with your teeth
4086.scene: A simple cartoon set in a dark blue house at night. A mosquito with an angry face hovers by a door next to a glowing red plug-in insect repeller, then next to a wall socket, unbothered by it. It flies on to a bedroom where a person sleeps under a blue blanket with the crescent moon in the window, and lands on the sleeper's bald head. In close-up the mosquito braces its legs and drives its long proboscis down to bite. The last shot is the little white house from outside.

4091.meaning: to break on the surface without falling apart
4091.scene: A woman in a cream fleece jacket, white trousers and a cream beanie walks across the glassy black ice of a frozen lake, her reflection sharp beneath her feet. She opens a steel thermos, unscrews the cup, and pours steaming dark tea onto the ice. The hot liquid spreads across the surface and stains it brown. The camera looks straight down as fine white lines shoot out from the spot in every direction, until the ice is covered by a wide star of cracks under her feet.

4118.meaning: a marked area where a game is played
4118.scene: A point of view shot from one end of an orange clay tennis court, high in the mountains. The white lines of the court run away from the camera to the net across the middle, and beyond it a grey rock face with snow on top rises into a deep blue sky under a bright sun. On the far side of the net a player in red hits the ball back; the yellow ball bounces on the clay and crosses the net again and again. The player at the camera end reaches into the frame to play a shot, and the rally goes on across the empty court with the mountain behind it.

4119.meaning: to break down or fall apart
4119.scene: A misty beach at dawn, with dark pine trees on the shore and driftwood and seaweed on the wet sand. A figure has been built out of balanced grey and green beach stones: two stone legs, a rounded stone body, outstretched stone arms and a small stone head, standing on the wet sand with its reflection under it. It stands still for several seconds. Then one arm drops away, the head tips off, and the whole stack falls in on itself until nothing is left but a low heap of pebbles lying in the shallow water with the same trees and fog behind.

4143.meaning: a container, usually with a lid
4143.scene: The camera looks straight down into a big grey wheelie bin standing on a path in front of green bushes. A raccoon is sitting at the bottom of the bin next to a crumpled green rubbish bag. It looks up at the camera, then stands up on its back legs and stretches both front paws up the smooth inside wall, trying to get out. It slips back down, turns around and curls up, then sits up again and stares at the camera.

4145.scene: Two men in swimming shorts play with a ball in the shallow water of a sunny beach, sailing boats on the blue sea behind them. One man throws himself full length through the air to reach the ball and lands flat in the water with a big splash. Later he leaps up and kicks the ball over his own head with an overhead bicycle kick, both legs in the air. He lands in the water, then stands up in the shallows and raises both fists above his head in triumph while the other man bends over on the sand in the foreground.

4146.meaning: extremely tired, with no energy left
4146.scene: A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.

4156.scene: In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.

4167.meaning: an opening you can escape through
4167.scene: A point-of-view ride on a chestnut horse in an orange bridle along a wet black-sand beach under a grey sky. The horse walks straight towards a black cliff and into the mouth of a sea cave, and the frame goes almost completely black except for the outline of the horse's ears. A bright doorway of daylight appears ahead, and horse and rider come out again onto the open black beach with a green headland beyond.

4171.meaning: to move slowly and low to the ground
4171.scene: A grey wolf steps out of dense dark leaves onto a stony riverbank and comes slowly towards the camera with its head low. The shot cuts to a close-up of a brown hen, then to two yellow chicks beside a green bamboo tube on the gravel. Back on the wolf, it lies down with its muzzle flat on the wet stones, its amber eyes still following what is happening in front of it.

4173.meaning: the act of pursuing someone to capture them
4173.scene: A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.

4174.scene: A hen carries three yellow chicks in her wings out of a burning barn, beating her wings at the flames in the doorway. Later, under a full moon over a pine forest, the three chicks sit alone on the grass while mice and a red fox creep out of the dark towards them. The hen plants herself in front of the chicks and spreads both wings wide to block the way.

4192.meaning: to catch or try to catch fish
4192.scene: A bald eagle glides low straight towards the camera over flat grey-green sea water, with a dark forested shore behind it. It holds its wings out wide and drops its yellow feet, watching the surface. As it reaches the camera it swings its talons forward, skims the water, and lifts away with a silver fish gripped in both feet, water spraying behind it.

4199.meaning: to pull something along with effort
4199.scene: A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.

4206.meaning: a small emblem that shows your rank or membership
4206.scene: A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.

4207.meaning: to bring something to a destination
4207.scene: A hamster in a pink bow lounges on a small sofa in a dim living room, laughing and then scrolling on a phone. A second hamster in round glasses comes in carrying a pizza box and sets it down on the low table in front of the sofa. The two press their cheeks together, then sit side by side wrapped in a checked blanket, each holding a slice of pepperoni pizza and eating while the television flickers behind them.

4218.meaning: a motor that turns heat into movement
4218.scene: A corgi sits at the wheel of an old rust-orange tractor and drives it down a narrow road through green vineyards on a sunny day. The camera stays in front of the tractor, filling the frame with its big ribbed radiator grille, round headlamps and upright exhaust pipe. Halfway through, a thick cloud of black smoke bursts from the exhaust pipe as the motor is worked harder, and the tractor keeps rolling towards the camera past the vines and a stone farmhouse on the hill.

4219.meaning: a living animal that can move by itself
4219.scene: Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.

4234.meaning: a small room or cabinet for storage
4234.scene: In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.

4235.meaning: to put or send something out
4235.scene: A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.

4236.scene: Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. Both men turn their heads to follow her, still holding the heavy screen between them, and one nearly loses his grip. They set the television down and stand with their hands on their hips, watching her walk away.

4237.meaning: a farm building for storing grain or animals
4237.scene: Inside a long barn with grey metal stalls down both sides of a concrete aisle, a toddler in jeans and a cream jumper toddles up to a wooden crate full of carrots and pulls one out. He carries it down the aisle, holding it up in the air, to where a black horse has its head out over a stall door. The horse stretches down and takes the carrot from his hand, and the little boy claps his hands and laughs.

4244.meaning: to rush at someone in a sudden attack
4244.scene: Filmed from inside a car at sunset. On a gravel track beside a wooden fence a big brown longhorn bull walks along with a small white dog next to it, kicking up dust. The bull turns on the dog and they tumble together in a cloud of dust. Cut to two young men in the car, mouths wide open screaming and laughing. The bull then runs straight down the track towards the car, horns forward, and pushes its huge shaggy head right up against the open car window until its nose and horns fill the whole frame.

4252.meaning: a hard building material made with cement
4252.scene: A back garden with a large above-ground pool standing on a wide concrete patio, its slabs marked out by straight joint lines. A young man in sunglasses lies on a patterned Persian rug spread on the concrete, propped on one elbow under a small black umbrella, sipping an orange drink through a straw. Behind him another man in a white T-shirt scrubs the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush, pushing white soapy foam across the slabs. More rugs lie drying on the concrete and the whole patio is covered in suds and water.

4254.meaning: a long table where business is done
4254.scene: An animated fried chicken shop at dusk. A grumpy ginger cat in a white chef's hat and a stained white apron stands behind the metal counter, with lit menu boards of fried chicken above and a deep fryer full of bubbling oil set into the counter in front of it. A pigeon stands on the counter arguing with the cat, which scowls back with narrowed green eyes. The pigeon then flaps wildly, tips over the edge and drops into the bubbling fryer. A single feather floats down and the cat stares at it open-mouthed.

4260.meaning: the shape of a human body
4260.scene: A dark bedroom at night, lit only by a small bedside lamp and the glow of a tablet. A man lies in bed under a thick cream knitted blanket watching the tablet, its light on his face, with a golden retriever lying on the bed beside him. In the lit doorway behind them a dark human figure appears and stands still, only its outline visible against the blue light of the hall. The man falls asleep with his head back and the tablet resting on his chest while the figure keeps standing there, then he is awake and watching the tablet again with the dog still beside him.

4265.meaning: to make someone calm or still
4265.scene: A green cartoon parrot with a blazing red crest storms into a wood-panelled living room, wings spread and beak open in fury. A large blue parrot gets off the sofa and folds a wing around it. The red crest sinks and drains from fire-red to pale yellow to soft green, and the angry bird stops shouting, leans into the hug and closes its eyes.

4273.meaning: when two or more bodies come together and hit
4273.scene: An illustrated street scene at dusk. A dark blue saloon has run head-on into the side of a beige hatchback in the middle of a crossroads; the blue car's bonnet is folded up and smoking and one hubcap has rolled away across the road among scattered broken glass. A man in a brown jacket throws both arms up in shock while a man in a green coat runs to the hatchback's driver door. Bystanders watch from the pavement in front of lit shopfronts.

4274.meaning: a change for the worse, harm done
4274.scene: In a sunny supermarket car park a white delivery van has run into the back corner of a grey car. The car's rear wing is caved in and the tail light is smashed against the van's bumper. Both drivers, in matching blue work shirts, get out and clutch their heads in dismay, then lean over the car's boot photographing the crushed panel with their phones and filling in a form.

4277.meaning: someone who keeps and checks business accounts
4277.scene: A woman in a white shirt and grey cardigan sits at a desk buried under thick stacks of receipts and invoices, lit by a desk lamp at night. She frowns over a long till receipt held up in one hand, runs a red pen down a ruled ledger full of columns of figures, circles one number in red, taps the big black calculator, and finally throws both fists in the air in triumph.

4280.meaning: the act of making a film
4280.scene: A retro poster-style illustration of a film set. A woman with wavy auburn hair, in a long golden off-the-shoulder gown, stands in front of a flat coloured backdrop with tears running down her cheek, one hand at her face and the other lifting her skirt. A big studio lamp on a tall stand shines on her from the left, a boom microphone hangs in from the right, and an empty wooden director's chair stands beside her.

4286.meaning: to move the air with something, like a fan
4286.scene: A cartoon of a woman slumped back in a striped deckchair on a lawn under a blazing sun, sweat running down her face, waving a folding paper fan at herself; a tall glass of iced lemonade stands on a wooden side table beside her, the flowers behind her droop, and a ginger cat lies flat out asleep in the shade.

4290.meaning: to make something cool or cooler
4290.scene: A heavy-set man in a sweat-soaked blue shirt lies slumped on a sofa fanning himself with a magazine and complaining about the heat; he points a remote at the wall air conditioner above him, the shot cuts to the unit switching on, and he stands up under it with his arms spread and his eyes closed as the cold air brings his temperature down.

4297.scene: A young traveller with a grey neck pillow and a rolling suitcase turns to the camera in a small airport lounge with a propeller plane parked outside; she then rides an escalator down through a huge terminal beneath an enormous departures board covered in flight listings, past rows of luggage trolleys and crowds, and past an indoor waterfall with airliners lined up at the windows behind it, her mouth open in amazement.

4307.meaning: a long strip of cloth or paper with a message
4307.scene: A hand-drawn night scene in a packed stadium stand. Four long strips of cloth in brown, blue, dark red and gold stream sideways from tall poles above the terrace against a starry blue sky. Below them rows of people in winter coats, scarves and flat caps stand with their hands on their chests, mouths open in song; white puffs of breath show in the cold air.

4309.meaning: a song of loyalty to a nation or school
4309.scene: Close-up of a footballer in a green and gold shirt standing in a line before a match at night. She has her hand flat on her chest and sings, tears running down both cheeks and her eyes red. Her team-mates stand beside her doing the same. A flag flies from a pole behind her, and the packed stand of spectators also stands with hands on their hearts.

4310.meaning: driven by emotion rather than reason
4310.scene: A footballer in a green shirt stands in a floodlit stadium, her face wet with tears and her mouth open as she sings. Her team-mates stand in a line with their arms around each other's shoulders, singing toward the packed stand where a green flag waves. The camera returns to her; she is crying too hard to go on and covers her eyes with her hand.

4318.meaning: showing approval by clapping the hands
4318.scene: A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.

4319.scene: A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.

4325.meaning: cows and bulls as a group of farm animals
4325.scene: A colourful illustration of an open grassy plain. A young man in a wide-brimmed hat, poncho and baggy trousers stands with his back half turned, whirling a set of weighted cords above his head. A brown horse rears up in a cloud of dust behind him on the left. Across the middle of the plain several dark cows graze in a loose group, and behind them stand purple mountains. On the right a light-blue and white flag flies from a pole beside a saddle blanket with a gourd and a metal kettle on it.

4327.meaning: cooking meat outdoors on a grill over hot coals
4327.scene: Outdoors at sunset, a young man tends a large grill covered with sausages and racks of ribs over glowing embers. Behind him a long table with a white cloth is lined with friends and family sitting on both sides, drinks and plates in front of them, watching and clapping. He spoons green herb sauce over the meat, cuts into it with a long knife, then lifts a piece on the knife towards the camera with his mouth open in delight while the people at the table cheer.

4332.scene: A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.

4340.meaning: strips of potato fried in deep fat
4340.scene: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.

4344.meaning: a warm feeling of liking someone
4344.scene: A warm, sunlit home kitchen photographed from the doorway. An older woman in a patterned apron stands behind a younger woman in a flour-dusted apron and hugs her from behind, both arms wrapped round her chest, their cheeks pressed together. Both are laughing with their eyes closed; there is flour on the younger one's face and on their hands. On the wooden kitchen island in front of them sits a black baking tray of golden pastries just out of the oven, with steam and a metal mixing bowl beside it. Open shelves of jars and spices line the walls, ladles and knives hang on rails, and an oven with a checked tea towel stands to the left.

4347.meaning: to transport people from one place to another
4347.scene: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.

4348.scene: A photograph of a wide sandy beach on a clear day. A woman in a plain black one-piece swimsuit runs up out of the shallows with a pale, well-used surfboard clamped under her right arm. Her hair is wet and pushed back, her arms and legs are muscular, one foot is off the ground and sand sprays out from under her heel. A wave curls and breaks behind her. Two red-and-yellow patrol flags stand in the sand on either side of the frame, and a wooden lifeguard tower sits on the grassy dune behind.

4355.meaning: lovable in a sweet, childlike way
4355.scene: A soft pastel cartoon seen from above. A round-cheeked baby with one curl of hair, huge shining eyes and a wide open smile lies on its back on a white playmat printed with stars and little animal faces. It wears a pink top and a mint-green nappy, and it is waving both fists in the air and kicking its bare feet up so the toes point at the camera. A pink and blue rattle hovers just above it, still shaking. Adult hands reach in towards the baby from both bottom corners, and teddy bears, folded blankets and soft toys lie around the edge of the mat with sparkles drawn in the air.

4357.meaning: a heavy woven fabric used for sails or tents
4357.scene: A watercolour of a young woman stopped on a stony mountain trail, seen from behind and slightly to the side, her brown hair blowing across her face as she looks back down the path. She carries an enormous pale khaki rucksack made of thick woven cloth, painted so the weave and the creases show, with brown leather straps, buckles and a stitched patch on the lid, and a dented tin mug clipped to one side. One loose strap hangs down and trails on the ground behind her. The narrow path winds away below through rocks and pine trees, with blue ridges of hills and tall white clouds behind.

4363.scene: A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.

4364.meaning: a flour mixture you can knead or roll
4364.scene: In a rustic kitchen a young woman and an older woman shape pale balls of dough and set them in rows on a baking tray dusted with flour. The older woman opens the oven and they slide the trays of raw dough inside. Later the oven is opened again and trays of golden baked croissants come out steaming, filling the table.

4377.meaning: the lowest part of a building, below the ground
4377.scene: A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.

4384.meaning: to spring back after hitting something
4384.scene: A pastel cartoon bedroom. A girl in pyjamas is caught in mid-air above her bed, knees bent and hair flying upwards, having just sprung off the mattress. The duvet is flung up on one side and two pillows float in the air around her. A bedside table with a round lamp stands to the right.

4388.meaning: a plant with flower heads of white ray petals
4388.scene: A soft cartoon meadow. A round cartoon bee with blurred wings hovers in the middle of the frame, trailing golden pollen from its legs. All around it grow big white daisies with fat yellow centres, some of them filling the whole bottom of the picture, along with a few pink clover heads.

4390.meaning: the feeling of lively, cheerful joy
4390.scene: A woman in a bright blue jacket stands in a hallway with her hands clasped together, bouncing and beaming as if she cannot believe what is happening. Then she is outside at dusk with a friend, laughing and hurrying along a road towards a lit-up arena, and finally the two of them are in the crowd under coloured lights, holding each other's arms and jumping and dancing.

4392.meaning: a sudden drop from standing up
4392.scene: A cartoon park in autumn. A man in a blue jacket and backpack has gone over the back of a wooden bench and is caught upside down in mid-air, arms out and one hand grabbing at a bin. His paper lunch bag and its contents fly out above him, orange leaves swirl around, and a fat pigeon on the back of the bench watches him go down.

4401.scene: A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.

4402.meaning: a feeling of craving food or something else
4402.scene: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.

4409.scene: At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.

4412.meaning: to make a way unsuitable for passage
4412.scene: A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.

4415.meaning: a remark expressing praise or admiration
4415.scene: In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.

4418.meaning: to come open suddenly from pressure inside
4418.scene: In a rustic kitchen a woman in an embroidered blouse leans over a gas hob where a blue flame burns under a small saucepan. Beside it a big pot of water rolls at a full boil and white steam streams off the surface towards the window. She reaches for a huge lidded pot, lifts the heavy lid, and a thick white cloud of steam bursts up into her face; she rears back with her mouth open.

4423.meaning: a structure that blocks free movement
4423.scene: A sunlit desert checkpoint photographed from the side. A long red and white striped boom bar is raised at a steep angle across the top of the frame, its counterweight end low on the left. Under it a person in an olive jacket with a canvas backpack walks over a broad white line painted on the cracked asphalt, kicking up a small puff of dust. A white concrete marker post stands to the left, a plain wooden guard hut to the right, and behind them a chain link fence and bare brown mountains under a clear blue sky.

4424.meaning: a line that marks a boundary
4424.scene: A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.

4427.meaning: a formal event on a special occasion
4427.scene: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.

4433.scene: A loose pen and watercolour sketch of a doorstep at evening. A young man in a beige jacket stands side on in the foreground, glancing back over his shoulder with a small pleased smile, one hand in his pocket. In his other hand, held down behind his back, he grips the stems of a big bundle of flowers: red and pink roses and yellow blooms gathered together, with a single petal drifting away. Behind him the front door stands open with warm yellow light spilling out, a young woman inside clapping her hands to her face in delight, a lantern glowing on the wall and terracotta pots either side of the step.

4434.meaning: a traveling show with rides and games
4434.scene: At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.

4435.meaning: a collection of things for public display
4435.scene: In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.

4436.scene: A colour cartoon of a beach in Rio. A player in a yellow shirt, blue shorts and brown boots is upside down in mid air doing an overhead bicycle kick, sand spraying up behind his heel and a worn brown ball flying off above him. A green and yellow flag flies on a pole at the left, and behind the beach rise a green mountain topped by a statue with outstretched arms and the rounded peak of another headland. On the right three children stand with their arms thrown up and their mouths wide open, and on the left a boy watches with his mouth open too.

4441.meaning: the process of taking in and letting out air
4441.scene: A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.

4457.meaning: to bend your knees and lower your body
4457.scene: On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.

4458.meaning: a state of extreme ruin and misfortune
4458.scene: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.

4459.scene: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.

4461.meaning: to turn up or remove earth
4461.scene: A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.

4466.meaning: on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
4466.scene: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.

4469.meaning: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves
4469.scene: A fine black-and-white pen drawing of a kitchen. A young man in a shirt and jeans stands on tiptoe and pulls open the tall wooden wall unit above the worktop, one hand on the swinging door and the other reaching up into it. The shelves inside are packed with stacked plates, tins and rows of preserving jars. Two jars have already tipped out and are falling through the air towards the floor, one past the tiled wall and one large in the foreground.

4472.scene: A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.

4475.meaning: to show something, make it visible
4475.scene: A warm ink-and-sepia drawing of a small café on a rainy evening. In the foreground the barista pours a stream of milk from a steel jug into a cup on the wooden counter while steam curls off the espresso machine behind him. Cups, mugs and saucers are set out in rows on the shelves above the machine and stacked along the counter. A cake stand with a glass dome shows a cut sponge cake with one slice missing, and a blank chalkboard sign stands beside it. At a small round table by the window a woman in a coat lifts a cup to her lips, with rain and warm street lights outside.

4480.meaning: a line that bends, changing direction
4480.scene: A stylised woodblock-style illustration of a camel with a patterned saddle blanket striding along the top of a desert dune at sunset. The whole bottom half of the picture is one long sweeping ridge of sand that bends across the frame in bands of orange, red and cream, and the camel's neck and the swirling clouds above it repeat the same bending line. A red sun sits low behind it.

4484.scene: A man in a red checked shirt kneels in a wooden canoe on a still turquoise mountain lake, mid-stroke with a wooden paddle. Behind him a wall of snow-capped rocky peaks catches the first low golden light of the morning on its faces while the lower slopes and pine forest are still in cold shadow, and a moose wades in the shallows near the far shore.

4488.meaning: an official piece of writing with information
4488.scene: A large bearded man in a white shirt sits in a busy open-plan office with a telephone handset wedged against his ear. His desk is buried under printed forms and official papers, many of them already marked with big red crosses. He grabs a sheet, slams a rubber stamp down on it and leaves a red X across it, then bangs the stamp onto the ledger in front of him again and again, getting angrier until sheets of paper are flying up all around his head.

4502.meaning: the upper surface of a room, overhead
4502.scene: Three shots of people looking up at what is above them indoors. A man lies flat on a bed and stares up at a plain white surface with a single bare bulb on a round fitting. A woman on a sofa leans back and looks up at the wooden beams and rafters of a bright open room. A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.

4505.scene: A bright cartoon of a small boy who has tipped his chair too far. He is caught mid-fall, leaning back with the blue and yellow chair going over behind him, both front legs off the floor and his trainers kicking up in the air. His eyes and mouth are wide open, his arms fly out to the sides, and motion lines show the chair swinging over. Beside him is the table he was sitting at, a green chair still standing, and a patterned rug on the wooden floor.

4506.meaning: a relaxed state with no pain
4506.scene: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

4519.meaning: what remains when something is burned
4519.scene: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

4521.scene: A photograph on the Great Wall at sunrise. A woman in a red jacket and black trousers walks straight towards the camera along the brick walkway with her arms held out wide, a cream paper parasol in her left hand. Behind her the wall drops away to a square stone watchtower, and beyond that the wall and its towers climb over one wooded ridge after another until they fade into the mist and the pale gold sun far away.

4526.meaning: a vote to choose a winner for a position
4526.scene: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

4533.meaning: a room in which a law court sits
4533.scene: A photograph in a wood-panelled courtroom. A woman in a patterned dress stands in the middle of the floor in front of the bench and holds a large certificate with a ribbon seal up over her head with both arms, laughing. Behind her an older man in a suit and three other family members clap and wave small paper flags, two little boys among them, and paper confetti falls through the light from the tall window. A small flag stands on the desk beside a signed document, and seated guests watch from the front row.

4536.meaning: the skilled practice of a practical job
4536.scene: Close-up of two clay-covered hands shaping a wet pot on a turning potter's wheel. The upper part is already a smooth thrown neck with curled clay handles; the lower part is still a rough lump. Specks of wet clay are flung across the wooden wheel head and the bench. Behind, out of focus, wooden shelves hold rows of finished pots and lumps of raw clay, with wooden tools lying on a bench.

4537.meaning: to rid a place of obstructions
4537.scene: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

4540.meaning: the things needed to do a job or service
4540.scene: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

4541.scene: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

4542.scene: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.

4559.meaning: to give emotional strength to someone sad
4559.scene: A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.

4560.meaning: the men and women who run a ship or aircraft
4560.scene: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.

4561.meaning: an instruction with authority to do something
4561.scene: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.

4564.scene: A soft watercolour of a village barn raising on a summer meadow. A long line of villagers in waistcoats and caps leans back on a rope, hauling a big wooden roof frame upright, while an old man in a straw hat stands on the platform pointing and directing them. On the left, women in aprons carry trays of loaves and pies out from a trestle table under an awning; a girl holds a basket. Children run across the grass with buckets and tools for the men on the ladder, and thatched cottages sit behind.

4572.scene: A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.

4577.scene: An ink drawing on aged paper. A woman in a blue robe and a conical straw hat stands on a rocky cliff edge with her arm stretched out towards the land below her. Beneath her lies a wide valley: a patchwork of green and gold fields, a broad river winding through it, small villages of tiled roofs, and a walled town on a hill in the distance. Snow-capped mountains close the horizon, birds fly below the cliff and tall grass leans in the wind in the foreground.

4578.meaning: what plants yield in one growing season
4578.scene: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.

4580.scene: A cartoon of a diner with a red-and-white checked tablecloth, a jukebox and neon signs on the wall. A boy and a girl lean their heads together over one tall milkshake glass topped with whipped cream and a cherry, each drinking through their own bent straw. Their hands are joined on the table in front of the glass, both are blushing, and a pink heart-shaped balloon floats above them.

4583.meaning: the thick muscle at the back of your lower leg
4583.scene: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

4585.scene: A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.

4586.meaning: a striped place on the road where people cross
4586.scene: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

4595.meaning: to shed tears because of sadness or pain
4595.scene: A young man in a green hoodie sits on a sofa in a living room at night, sobbing. His face is wet, his mouth is pulled down and his eyes are screwed up. He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.

4600.meaning: to give something and receive something back
4600.scene: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.

4601.meaning: to put things into a proper order
4601.scene: A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.

4607.meaning: a reddish-brown metal that bends easily
4607.scene: Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

4617.meaning: to be engaged in a fight
4617.scene: A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

4618.meaning: a sudden rush toward someone or something
4618.scene: A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.

4629.meaning: seeming to have no end, tiresomely long
4629.scene: A woodcut print in ochre, orange and brown. Sand dunes roll away one behind another, their curving ridges carved in fine parallel lines, until they blur into a flat line at the horizon with no end in sight. A tiny robed figure with a walking staff is climbing one of the ridges far off, no bigger than a thumbnail against the sand. In the foreground a bleached longhorn cattle skull lies half buried in the dune. A large stylised sun hangs in the empty yellow sky above.

4631.meaning: to make or work out a plan for something
4631.scene: A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.

4633.meaning: marked by despair or loss of hope
4633.scene: A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

4635.meaning: the place set as the end of a journey
4635.scene: A girl in a denim jacket stands in front of a torn-out photo of a lighthouse stuck on a wall and draws a circle on it with a marker, pointing at it. She is then on a train, looking out at the sea while holding the same photo. Finally she stands on a grassy clifftop at sunset and holds the photo up in front of her, lining it up with the real white lighthouse in front of her.

4640.meaning: a liquid or powder for washing dishes or clothes
4640.scene: A man opens the blue cap of a rainbow-coloured bottle in a laundry room and pours thick blue liquid from it into the measuring cap. He pulls out the drawer of a white front-loading washing machine and tips the blue liquid in, then closes the drawer and starts the machine, which we see running with washing turning inside. At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.

4645.meaning: to fasten something so it is attached
4645.scene: Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. They press a blue ball onto each end of a short rod to make a dumbbell shape, drop a red ball into a green cup piece, and push finished pieces down into the holes of the tray. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.

4646.meaning: the legal ending of a marriage
4646.scene: A charcoal drawing of a wooden table seen close up. Two gold wedding rings lie on the bare tabletop. A large hand on the right has just set one ring down and is drawing back from it, while a second hand reaches in from the left towards the other ring. Behind them a city skyline is sketched in soft grey.

4648.meaning: to consider something in detail to understand it
4648.scene: An illustration of a consulting room in which a woman in a white coat crouches in front of a small boy sitting on the examination couch. She holds the disc of her stethoscope against his chest and rests her other hand on his head while she listens; the boy holds a teddy bear and looks worried. Behind them are an eye chart, a shapes chart, a lamp and a glass cabinet of bottles; a reflex hammer and a lollipop lie on a metal tray in front.

4652.meaning: to take part in a contest against others
4652.scene: At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.

4661.meaning: the season when leaves fall from the trees
4661.scene: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

4664.meaning: a measured portion of medicine taken at one time
4664.scene: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

4684.meaning: the joint between the forearm and upper arm
4684.scene: In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

4687.meaning: a building where ambassadors live or work
4687.scene: Dusk in a European city, seen through the bars of a tall black iron gate. Behind the gate stands a lit stone building with arched windows and a flag on a pole above the entrance. A woman in a beige trench coat stands at the gate and hands a stack of cream-coloured document envelopes through to a man in a dark uniform and peaked cap. A parked car and lamplit street are visible behind her.

4691.scene: A young man in a mustard jumper with a backpack and an ID card on a lanyard walks in through the glass entrance turnstile of an office building, smiling. In the open-plan office a bearded man carrying files walks up to him and they greet each other with a handshake and a clap on the arm. The young man then sits down at a desk in a long row of desks and works at a computer; other people are typing at desks around and behind him.

4694.meaning: a binding agreement enforceable by law
4694.scene: In a bright office a woman with short white hair in a blue suit leans over a desk and spreads a printed document on a clipboard in front of a young man in a suit, pointing at the line where he has to sign. He takes a pen and signs it. They stand up, she puts a hand on his shoulder and they shake hands while the staff at the desks behind clap. At the end she leads him to a free desk with a small box marked Welcome on it, and the whole office applauds.

4695.meaning: a state of extreme confusion and disorder
4695.scene: In a flat with a parquet floor a man lifts the body of a plastic bin off a full bin bag, then tips a cardboard box of odds and ends into a bigger box on the floor. He pulls a metal drawer out of a cabinet and empties that in too. By the end the whole living room floor is buried under a spreading heap of toys, boxed games, plastic tubs and building blocks, and he stands behind the emptied cabinet holding it, mouth open at the state of the room.

4696.scene: In a climbing gym an older woman with glasses chalks her hands and takes hold of a red grip on a bouldering wall. A group of young climbers stands on the mats below her, shouting up at her, punching the air and clapping. She pulls herself off the ground and works her way up the overhanging wall while they keep cheering, raising their arms and applauding as she reaches high above them.

4702.scene: A brown and white goat pushes its head out between the boards of a wooden gate in a barn pen where other goats are standing. It works its horns and shoulders through the gap and squeezes its whole body out of the pen. Outside, a farmer in a straw hat lunges for it past a row of feed sacks but misses, and the goat gallops off down a red dirt track between rows of olive trees, growing smaller as it runs away.

4705.meaning: a group of people who play music together
4705.scene: A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

4721.scene: A woman in a soaking wet orange hooded raincoat films herself on a grassy hillside above a lake, grinning and pointing back over her shoulder at a full rainbow arching right across the grey sky. She turns to look at it, and second by second the colours grow weaker: first the left hand side thins out, then only a short faint band is left low on the right, and then the sky is empty and grey. She keeps standing there in the wet grass looking at the place where it was.

4736.meaning: the permanent military land forces of a nation
4736.scene: A large group of soldiers in matching camouflage uniforms train together on sand and black mats under a grey sky. In the foreground a woman in uniform with her hair in a tight bun hits a black padded shield held by a comrade, her gloved fists up in a guard. Behind her rows of other uniformed soldiers work in pairs across the whole ground, and one lifts another clean off her feet and throws her over her shoulder onto the mats. The clip ends on the woman still punching, with dozens more soldiers drilling behind her.

4752.scene: A young man in a white apron is baking in a bright kitchen. He looks worried at the hob, where a pale pancake sits in a frying pan and he prods it with a spatula. He pulls on black oven gloves and opens the oven, which glows orange inside. He lifts out a baking tray of biscuits that have come out completely black and cracked, holds it up, and leans over it with his face screwed up in disappointment.

4759.meaning: someone who bakes bread and cakes as a job
4759.scene: Rows of pale baguettes on a wire rack slide out of a glowing bakery oven. Trays of croissants and pains au chocolat are pushed into a shop window while a crowd in winter coats watches from the wet Paris street outside. A man in a shirt and a flour-smeared apron picks up a baguette, holds it to his ear like a telephone, then turns to the camera grinning and holds it up in front of the bakery door.

4761.meaning: salted and smoked meat from a pig's back
4761.scene: On a frozen lake under a low winter sun a man in an orange hooded parka cooks breakfast on a small portable gas stove. A single egg fries in a black pan; he lays strips of streaky bacon in beside it and they curl and brown. The shot widens to a large flat pan holding rows of bacon rashers around a heap of fried potato chunks and two fried eggs, which he lifts towards the camera, steaming in the cold air.

4770.meaning: getting on a plane or ship as a passenger
4770.scene: A claymation airport departure area. A traveller with a backpack and a duffel bag walks through an open rounded door into a ribbed jet bridge tunnel. On the right an agent in a blue uniform and cap sits at a wooden desk with a monitor and raises a hand towards him. Blue rope barrier posts snake across the floor, rows of moulded seats stand empty and a white and red airliner waits outside the tall window.

4789.meaning: the power to give orders and make decisions
4789.scene: A wood-panelled office with a huge political map of Africa covering the back wall, stuck with coloured pins. A woman in a green suit sits behind a broad polished desk; a man in a dark suit stands beside her holding out an open folder, and she gestures with a rubber stamp in her hand as she speaks to him. An assistant with a tablet stands to one side while the man works at the map behind her. She signs a document, presses the rubber stamp onto it, closes the folder and sits back alone at the desk facing the camera.

4790.meaning: an open clash between two opposing sides
4790.scene: A dark ink-and-wash drawing of a long boardroom table in a panelled government room with heavy curtains and flags. Two men lean in from opposite sides of the table, faces twisted, shouting and jabbing their fingers at each other. Papers are strewn across the polished wood and one sheet is still in the air. Other men in suits sit or brace their hands on the table between them, and a woman with a folder has stopped in the open doorway at the back of the room.

4796.meaning: to bring something into balance so it is steady
4796.scene: A boy in a cap and blue T-shirt runs along a gravel path past flower beds, then leaps into the arms of an elderly man outside a modern house, who swings him up off the ground. The boy and a white-haired woman tip a metal watering can together over pink dahlias in the garden. At a wooden garden table the boy leans on his elbows and carefully leans two playing cards against each other into a standing triangle, with more cards laid flat on the boards in front of him. The last shot is the whole family in the back garden, children at the picnic table and on a rug on the lawn.

4803.meaning: a bunch of flowers arranged and held together
4803.scene: A woman in a coat and a checked scarf arrives at an open front door holding a wine bottle and a paper-wrapped bouquet, hands the bouquet to the man who greets her, joins a table lit by fairy lights where food is served out of a red pan, and clinks a glass of white wine with the others.

4806.meaning: a round roof shaped like half a ball
4806.scene: A young man in a white shirt stands in front of the Trevi Fountain holding an open photo book up against the carved figures and the green water, sits on stone steps turning its bright-tabbed pages, then stands at an iron railing above the city and holds the book up beside a great domed church on the skyline before hugging the book to his chest and smiling at the view.

4808.meaning: hair woven together into one plaited strand
4808.scene: In a salon a stylist combs out a client's very long glossy black hair, then weaves a thick braid along the top of her head and down through the length of the hair; at the end the client stands up and swings the hair, which reaches almost to the floor, with the finished braid running over the crown.

4809.meaning: an enclosed passageway inside a building
4809.scene: A long narrow passage inside a flat, white walls on both sides, coat racks with jackets hanging on each wall and two long rows of shoes on the floor. A woman carries a laundry basket down the passage towards the camera; two men squeeze past her carrying a big cardboard box over a bicycle parked in the passage; at the end the passage is empty again, with only the shoes and coats and a blue door at the far end.

4817.meaning: a long time with a shortage of rain
4817.scene: A cartoon drawing of a burnt orange landscape under a huge spiralling sun. The ground in the foreground is baked hard and split into deep cracks, and a winding riverbed running through the hills has dried to a thick orange sludge. A shaggy dog lies panting in the last of it with its tongue out, a lone tree droops and melts like wax, and a man in a soaked shirt walks slowly forward wiping his forehead as heat lines rise off the ground around him.

4823.scene: A freediver in a black wetsuit and long carbon fins hangs head-down far below the surface of deep blue open water, sliding down beside a pale guide rope that runs from the sunlit surface into the dark water below him. Small bubbles trail up from his mask towards the light above.

4829.meaning: a small piece broken off something
