4829.scene: Close-up of an old wooden surface covered in cracked, blistered cream paint. A hand pushes a wide metal scraper under the paint and small chips and flakes break off and fall away, leaving patches of bare orange wood, and the scraper keeps going until a large area is stripped.

4860.meaning: a small ball of gas inside a liquid
4860.scene: In a kitchen a woman in an apron drops a white tablet into a glass of water and small bubbles stream up through the water. She stirs it with a spoon, then lowers a big white block into a large glass tank where it fizzes into a swirling white cloud while she gasps at it.

4866.meaning: a small flying machine with propellers
4866.scene: A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.

4879.meaning: an event where a winner is chosen
4879.scene: At an outdoor strength contest a woman in a black lifting suit and belt presses a loaded barbell overhead, then hauls a huge grey stone up to her chest and above her head. Next she balances a thick length of tree trunk, bark still on and the sawn end showing, across her shoulders, and finally holds a small black car over her head while the crowd watches from behind a rope.

4882.scene: A line of people in matching gym kit hauls on a thick rope across a mown field, teeth gritted, dragging a wooden sled loaded with people, then an old saloon car. The scene cuts to an airfield where the same line of people pulls the rope hand over hand and drags a huge grey military transport plane, with four jet engines under its wings, along the tarmac towards the camera.

4888.scene: A blonde young woman in a white sundress walks barefoot along the wet sand at the edge of the sea; shallow waves wash over her bare feet and she leaves footprints behind her; the camera pulls back to show a long line of people walking barefoot on the same shoreline.

4889.meaning: having the shape of a circle
4889.scene: In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.

4890.meaning: to travel around something in a ring
4890.scene: A rainbow-striped spinning top spins on the hexagonal paving of a city park while a teenage boy circles around it with one leg swung out; more and more people join in, running in a wide ring around the spinning top while the city skyline glows behind them at sunset.

4893.scene: A young woman in a navy T-shirt sits smiling in the stands of a baseball stadium; the camera pulls back over row after row of seated fans in caps and team shirts, past a packed lower tier, and rises into a wide shot of the whole bowl filled with spectators to the very top.

4903.meaning: to drive or push people together
4903.scene: An aerial shot looking down on a wide, sunlit paved plaza in front of a glass building. At first single people walk across the tiles in every direction, casting long shadows. More and more people arrive, and the loose scattering turns into a dense mass that packs together in the middle of the square until the paving is barely visible.

4908.meaning: a stem growing out from a plant's main stem
4908.scene: Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.

4913.meaning: a band wrapped around the wrist
4913.scene: Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.

4920.meaning: a group of people living in one local area
4920.scene: In a garden between two apartment blocks, an elderly man, a young woman and a small boy kneel at a raised wooden bed and press a seedling into the dark soil. A striped watering can is passed from hand to hand among the neighbours standing around, adults of different ages plus the little boy. The young woman waters the seedlings, the water streaming from the spout onto the soil. She then holds a hand-painted COMMUNITY GARDEN sign over her head, and the whole group of residents cheers and throws their arms up around her.

4925.meaning: to look after someone who needs care
4925.scene: A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.

4928.meaning: to put something broken back together
4928.scene: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.

4931.meaning: a drawing that explains how something works
4931.scene: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

4935.meaning: a tool with a needle that shows direction
4935.scene: A woman in a white captain's cap, navy jacket and rubber boots walks up a metal gangway in a marina. She takes hold of the big wooden ship's wheel of a boat, with white yachts and masts behind her. A close-up shows her finger touching a brass compass set into the console, its needle and marked dial clearly visible. She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.

4940.meaning: a person whose job is cutting and selling meat
4940.scene: A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.

4959.meaning: a small house with one floor
4959.scene: Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

4960.meaning: to hold someone close in your arms lovingly
4960.scene: An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.

4962.meaning: double lenses you look through to see far away
4962.scene: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

4963.meaning: any of the long parts on your hand, not the thumb
4963.scene: A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face. She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.

4971.meaning: things that explode in the sky with bright colours
4971.scene: Night scene in front of a floodlit domed capitol building: an officer in a white dress uniform hauls a rope and runs a red, white and blue flag up a tall pole while a huge crowd watches; the sky then fills with burst after burst of gold, red, white and blue fireworks over the dome, and the shot ends among the crowd waving small flags and sparklers and cheering.

4984.meaning: a stiff case with a handle for work papers
4984.scene: On a seaside promenade lined with palm trees an older woman with a grey plait, knee pads and elbow pads rolls along on a skateboard, laughing. A jogger passes her, then a man in a dark coat hops onto a board behind her and copies her, and finally a man in a business suit carrying a black briefcase in one hand steps onto a skateboard as well. All of them roll down the promenade together past the benches and the sea, grinning.

4985.meaning: to attach something firmly in place
4985.scene: In an office two workers put up screens. A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.

4996.meaning: any cone-shaped object you can hold
4996.scene: A sunny photo on the lawn in front of the cathedral and the Leaning Tower of Pisa. A young woman in a white summer dress and a straw hat walks towards the camera holding a pale ice cream in a pointed wafer cone in her raised hand. Pigeons walk on the grass around her and several take off with spread wings on both sides of her.

4999.meaning: to battle against someone in a fight
4999.scene: A manga-style drawing inside a wooden training hall. A barefoot young man in a dark blue training robe grips a long bamboo sword in both hands and drives forward against an opponent, whose own bamboo sword and gloved hands come in from the left edge of the frame. Speed lines cut across the whole picture, dust bursts from the floorboards under his heel, and a Japanese flag hangs on the wall behind him with a stone garden visible through the open sliding doors.

5002.meaning: the time when daylight fades just before night
5002.scene: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.

5003.meaning: someone who travels into little known places
5003.scene: An ink-and-wash drawing of a dense green rainforest. A man in a wide-brimmed hat and a dirt-stained shirt stands in the middle of the frame and swings a machete, cutting through the hanging leaves in front of him so that fronds and scraps fly off. Thick vines loop across the whole picture, huge dripping leaves hang on both sides, mist rises off the tangled roots at his feet, and a macaw flies overhead against a pale sky.

5030.meaning: clothes worn in a play or at a fancy party
5030.scene: A street carnival in a city of tall shuttered houses hung with bunting. A woman in a rainbow feather costume walks down the middle of the road carrying a tall banner on a pole, smiling straight ahead, with a large crowd of people walking close behind her. Drummers in matching yellow and blue tops move along the road in rows with drums strapped to them, and the balconies on both sides are packed with people watching.

5039.meaning: a box of metal bars for keeping birds or animals
5039.scene: At sunrise on a city rooftop an old man with a white beard stands in front of a tall stack of wooden and wire bird cages with small birds inside, and unlatches the little doors one after another. Birds burst out of the cages and the sky fills with a huge flock. He holds an empty cage in his arms and looks up, and the crowd of people behind him watches the birds circle over the city.

5040.meaning: a big comfy chair with side supports for arms
5040.scene: At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.

5061.meaning: a glass tank filled with water where fish are kept
5061.scene: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.

5065.meaning: a narrow walkway between shelves or rows
5065.scene: A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.

5083.meaning: small soft fruits that you can eat
5083.scene: Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.

5095.meaning: a huge feeling of wonder at something
5095.scene: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

5102.meaning: a narrow street with walls on both sides
5102.scene: A woman with a large hiking backpack walks through an old North African medina, following a map on her phone. She turns down a very narrow lane between tall ochre and blue walls, close enough to touch both sides, checking the screen and pointing at it. She keeps walking, squeezes past a man standing in the lane, then passes through a covered market passage hung with clothes and lined with stalls, and out through a low brick archway. At the end she comes out into a huge open square in front of a mosque with a tall minaret, looks at her phone again and smiles.

5105.meaning: a long narrow channel dug into the earth
5105.scene: A painted illustration of flat Dutch countryside. A straight water-filled ditch runs from the foreground into the distance between raised grass banks. Three big windmills with red and white sails stand along the left and centre, a church tower far behind them. Ducks swim on the water and glide down to land on it. On the bank at the right a boy in a cap and red scarf cycles along a dirt path beside a strip of red and yellow tulips, and tall clouds fill the deep blue sky.

5107.meaning: to hold someone gently in your arms like a baby
5107.scene: A mother and father stand cheek to cheek in a bright room, cradling their swaddled newborn in their arms and smiling down at it. The shot changes to the two of them leaning over a clear hospital bassinet with their reflections in the plastic and the newborn asleep inside. The camera then pulls back across a hospital nursery filled with rows and rows of identical bassinets, each holding a sleeping newborn, the rows stretching away down the ward.

5117.meaning: a shop where books are sold
5117.scene: A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.

5140.meaning: to give someone permission to do something
5140.scene: At an airport border control desk, an officer in a peaked cap and uniform takes a passport, opens it on the black counter and inks a rubber stamp. He presses the stamp down and a large green tick appears on the page. The traveller lifts the passport up: the whole spread is covered in blue ticks, coloured stamps, little aeroplanes and a green cross. A woman in a yellow beanie then holds the stamped passport up to the camera, free to walk on, with the queue of waiting travellers behind her.

5144.meaning: the white bird of peace, a kind of pigeon
5144.scene: Two elderly men in suits meet in front of a tall white stone monument under a clear blue sky, shake hands warmly and then pull each other into a long hug while a crowd of onlookers watches. Rows of schoolgirls in navy uniforms line both sides of the paved square, each holding a wicker basket with white birds sitting inside. The girls tip the baskets open and the white birds burst upwards, first a handful and then dozens, until the whole sky above the monument is filled with them. The two men stand together at the centre looking up at the birds.

5158.meaning: to fasten two or more pieces together
5158.scene: A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.

5160.meaning: to run or move very quickly
5160.scene: A black-and-white ink drawing of a rainy night on an old European market square: a young man in a long open coat runs at full stride across the wet cobbles, arms swinging, while a dozen pigeons burst into flight around him. Rain streaks down the sky, a tall church tower, a clock tower and an arcaded market hall stand behind him, a lit street lamp glows on the right, and the lamplight reflects in the puddles between the cobblestones.

5161.meaning: a very large and important church
5161.scene: A young man in an orange rain jacket with a backpack films himself on a big city square in front of a brick church tower while pigeons take off around him, then at a wooden railing above a turquoise mountain lake ringed with rock walls, then at a wooden table in a restaurant where he lifts a spoonful from a plate piled with fried dumplings and eats with wide, delighted eyes.

5164.meaning: a race between candidates for office
5164.scene: A woman in a red campaign T-shirt pastes election posters onto a city wall with a wide brush, smoothing down a blue poster with a candidate's silhouette; then two candidates in suits argue from glass lecterns on a brightly lit debate stage in front of a seated audience and a moderator; then, at a night rally, a crowd holds up red and blue placards, confetti falls, and a young woman in a red shirt cheers with her fist in the air.

5172.meaning: to hit something hard and violently
5172.scene: A rustic farm-shop kitchen with shelves of jars and crates of fruit. A young man in an apron slams both palms down onto a round of bread dough on a floured table. Then a pair of hands drives a heavy stone pestle down again and again into a mortar full of peppercorns and dried chillies. A woman in denim beats a djembe drum hard with her palms, laughing. Another man swings a heavy rubber mallet down onto the dough, and then pounds the pestle into the mortar with both fists.

5174.meaning: bright and happy in a way that lifts your mood
5174.scene: At an outdoor dinner table at dusk a young woman in a bright patterned dress pours orange juice from a glass jug into tall glasses while older relatives sit around the loaded table, laughing and clapping; she finally lifts the jug high over her head and pours a long stream into a glass.

5182.meaning: the action of finishing something difficult
5182.scene: A woman in paint-spattered dungarees and a headband paints the last strokes of a huge mural of suns and waves on a city wall from a stepladder, then climbs down, backs onto the pavement and stands with her hands on her hips, looking up at the finished painting and smiling.

5188.meaning: the feeling when your expectations are not met
5188.scene: Two men on a wooden jetty on a still lake at dusk. A bearded man in a bucket hat fights a deeply bent fishing rod, winding the reel hard, sure he has a big fish. His friend sprints up the jetty with a landing net ready. What breaks the surface and swings up onto the planks is a green rubber boot full of water and weed. Both men stop dead and stare at it, the friend lowering the useless net.

5196.meaning: hair twisted into a round knot on the head
5196.scene: A young woman with glasses and her blonde hair twisted up into a round knot on top of her head stands reading a paperback in a moving tram, city buildings sliding past the windows. She then sits cross-legged on a park bench in autumn sunshine, the same knot of hair on top, reading and yawning behind her hand. In the last shots she is under a blanket in the dark with a single candle burning beside the open book, eyes wide behind her glasses, then grinning as she reads on.

5208.meaning: a style of preparing food, or that food
5208.scene: A young man in a suit sits down to three very different meals in three countries. At a blue plastic table on a narrow southern street a pan of meatballs in tomato sauce lands in front of him; in a trattoria with red checked cloths a waiter lifts the lid of a steaming tagine of stew; at a rooftop restaurant above a night skyline a plated steak with vegetables is uncovered under a silver cloche. Each time his eyes go wide with amazement.

5220.meaning: to remove something by snipping it off
5220.scene: A woodblock-style print of a deep red rose with a dew drop on one petal; a pair of iron garden shears is held open around the thorny green stem just below the flower, about to snip it off, while a single petal falls away through the air and leaves and a patterned sky fill the background.

5226.meaning: a train car where passengers ride
5226.scene: Under the glass-and-iron roof of a station, a man in a beige trench coat with a green duffel bag runs down the platform beside a long dark green train while other travellers walk the other way with suitcases. He reaches an open door in the side of the train, grabs the frame and hauls himself in as it starts to move. The last shot is from the platform looking into the open doorway: he is standing inside the lit interior of the train, holding his bag against his chest and looking back out.

5235.meaning: goods carried by a large vehicle
5235.scene: A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.

5236.meaning: the space between two objects or points
5236.scene: A watercolour illustration of a desert at sunset. A man in a white robe and red-and-white headscarf walks along the crest of a tall red dune, leading two loaded camels behind him. Sand sprays off the ridge under his feet. Far away across the flat desert, small in the haze, stands a cluster of glass office towers.

5238.meaning: a hill of sand made by the wind
5238.scene: A selfie-style travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and checked headscarf holds the camera at arm's length on a red dune with the sun setting behind him, laughing and turning. He then stands at a sandstone cliff and runs his hand over huge human figures carved out of the rock, tilting his head back to see the top of them. At night he sits by a campfire under a starry sky while tea is poured into his cup, and he holds the cup up smiling.

5241.meaning: an enclosed space, natural or man-made
5241.scene: A science-fiction illustration of a sealed medical room. A young woman in a pale blue gown lies on a padded table that slides into the mouth of a large white ring-shaped machine; the opening glows with blue and green light. Cables and control panels line the metal walls. Behind a thick window on the left, a technician in dark uniform watches her and works at a lit console.

5242.meaning: refined and tasteful in appearance or style
5242.scene: A woman in a silky champagne slip dress with a matching long satin robe stands at an open window in a Paris apartment. She sprays perfume onto her wrist, rubs her wrists together and sprays her neck, then walks slowly through the perfume mist, flicks her hair back and turns to the camera smiling. A table beside her is crowded with perfume bottles, and Paris rooftops are visible through the window.

5245.meaning: material used in or made by a reaction
5245.scene: A cartoon laboratory: a young person in a white lab coat, orange goggles and rubber gloves holds a round flask of glowing purple liquid up above their head, mouth open in excitement, while swirling blue and pink smoke and floating bubbles rise out of it. Their other hand turns a dial on a big grey machine. The bench in front is covered with beakers and conical flasks of bubbling green and yellow liquid, and behind them stand test tubes of pink and purple liquid, boxy old monitors and shelves of jars.

5256.meaning: to speak to a group of people
5256.scene: A large wood-panelled hall of a court. A judge in a red robe and white wig stands at a raised lectern and speaks to the room from written notes. Five more judges in wigs and black gowns sit in a row behind him. In front of him a packed hall of seated people listens; a man at a table in the front row stands up while the judge is still speaking.

5257.meaning: the head servant in a rich person's house
5257.scene: A pencil and charcoal drawing of a man in a black tailcoat, white waistcoat and bow tie standing in the hall of a grand house. He holds a silver tray with a teapot, a milk jug and a cup on it in one raised hand, a folded white cloth over his forearm and his other hand behind his back, his head bowed towards the tray. Behind him a chandelier hangs above a curving staircase between marble columns.

5278.meaning: the place where two streets meet
5278.scene: A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.

5298.meaning: a smart, formal jacket worn over a shirt
5298.scene: A young woman in a beige tailored jacket over a white top stands at a perfume counter in a brightly lit shop. She holds a paper test strip to her nose, then lifts a glass bottle and sniffs it, closes her eyes, waves the scent toward her face with her hand and reaches for another bottle on the display.

5302.meaning: a flower on a tree, like cherry blossom
5302.scene: A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.

5311.meaning: relaxed and not agitated or upset
5311.scene: A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.

5312.meaning: the open ground at the back of a house
5312.scene: In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.

5316.meaning: having hair that grows in curls, not straight
5316.scene: A young woman in a red dress with a backpack twirls under tiled arches beside a fountain. She then sits close to the camera at a bar counter with a glass of red wine, a plate of thin cured ham and a dish of fried potatoes; her thick dark hair grows in tight rings and springs around her face as she leans in, laughs and drinks. The clip ends on a mosaic rooftop terrace at sunset with her arms thrown open over the city.

5320.meaning: to show something to an audience
5320.scene: In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.

5327.meaning: a sleeveless garment like a short cloak
5327.scene: In a brightly painted hair salon a client sits in the styling chair with a black sleeveless salon cape fastened at her neck and hanging over her shoulders and arms down to her lap. The stylist stands behind her and sprays a can of hairspray over the client's large curled updo, holding a comb in the other hand; a cloud of spray drifts over the hair. At the end the camera holds on the finished updo and the black cape covering the seated client's back.

5331.scene: A very muscular young woman stands at a thatched beach bar in front of a big glass jug on a wooden table. She squeezes an orange in her bare hands until the juice runs into the jug, then picks up a whole watermelon and crushes it between her hands until it bursts and its juice pours into the jug. At the end she turns to the camera and flexes her bicep while the guests behind her laugh and cheer with their drinks.

5335.scene: A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.

5339.meaning: to handle a machine and make it function
5339.scene: A woman in a denim shirt sits in the driver's seat of a small parked car with her seat belt on, both hands on the steering wheel, turning it one way and then the other and watching where the car points. The shot cuts to the same woman in the driver's cab of a city bus, taking hold of a huge flat steering wheel with both hands and turning it, grinning at how big it is, with buses and the depot visible through the windscreen.

5349.meaning: to give something as an honor or reward
5349.scene: A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.

5350.meaning: a small natural stream of water
5350.scene: A watercolour illustration of a wooded valley in summer. A narrow, shallow run of clear water winds between mossy boulders and pebbles, dropping over a small ledge into little waterfalls. A girl in a blue jacket, brown trousers and boots is caught in mid-air as she springs from one mossy rock to the next, arms flung out for balance, water splashing under her feet. Ferns, tree trunks and dappled green foliage fill the background and a few orange leaves drift on the surface.

5363.scene: An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.

5364.meaning: to give someone help with something
5364.scene: A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.

5370.meaning: a narrow boat that you move with a paddle
5370.scene: A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.

5373.meaning: to become larger in size or volume
5373.scene: In a sunny back garden, three people stand at a picnic table watching a striped beach ball get bigger and bigger until it fills the frame. A glass bowl of dough on the same table then rises until it bulges over the rim. Next a woman on the lawn watches a blue paddling pool grow out to its full size, and finally the whole group stands watching a yellow and blue bouncy castle rise up into a full castle with towers.

5379.meaning: to change something to make it different
5379.scene: In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.

5383.meaning: a wide street in a town
5383.scene: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.

5384.meaning: someone who won first place in a competition
5384.scene: A cartoon drawing of a sports team on a green pitch just after winning. Ten players in red-and-yellow striped shirts and shorts pile together, mouths open in a roar, fists in the air. One player is hoisted above the others, arms spread wide, laughing; a ball and a water bottle fly through the air over his head. Behind them a blurred crowd in the stands cheers and the goal posts rise into an orange sunset sky.

5389.meaning: to make a sudden move to avoid something
5389.scene: In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.

5393.meaning: staying steady in your mind under stress
5393.scene: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.

5394.meaning: to demand something as your own property
5394.scene: A two-colour woodcut print. A person in a heavy padded coat, knitted hat and thick gloves leans their whole weight onto a tall flagpole and drives it down into the frozen ground. A ragged ochre flag snaps out sideways in the wind at the top of the pole. Splinters of ice burst up where the pole strikes and cracks run out across the white surface. Behind them lie empty snow dunes and, far off, a second small flag already standing in the snow.

5417.meaning: a station where vehicles load passengers
5417.scene: A young woman in a mustard coat with a canvas tote bag steps up to an old red wooden tram standing in a cobbled old-town street and boards it, her mouth open in delight. Inside the carriage she leans towards the window and watches pastel-coloured townhouses slide past. The tram then runs into a large tram yard: several trams stand on parallel rails under a web of overhead wires, and she stands on the narrow platform between the tracks looking around at them.

5426.meaning: a group of representatives sent somewhere
5426.scene: In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.

5434.meaning: the energy made by moving electrons
5434.scene: Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.

5435.meaning: having the same or similar features
5435.scene: Phone footage of two young red-haired women walking side by side across a sunny university campus. They are dressed exactly the same: white polo crop tops, blue jeans, white trainers and black backpacks, and they wear their hair in the same ponytails, so from behind and from the front they look like one person doubled. They stop, open a bag of crisps together and share it, then walk on laughing at each other while other students pass on the lawn behind them.

5437.meaning: an open paved space with buildings all around
5437.scene: A travel reel in three parts. First a young woman in a white embroidered shirt leads the camera by the hand through a field of sunflowers at sunset. Then she walks across a cobbled cathedral square as a flock of pigeons takes off around her in front of a white church with golden domes. Finally the clip ends in the paved courtyard of an old manor: the walls and arcades of the building close the space in on every side, strings of warm lights hang overhead, and a long table of guests in embroidered shirts claps and cheers as she lifts a big braided loaf of bread above her head.

5438.meaning: any material that fills a space or container
5438.scene: A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.

5444.meaning: to work together on a common project
5444.scene: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.

5448.scene: A young man in a red jacket with a backpack turns on the spot in the middle of a busy city crossing, arms flung wide and mouth open in delight. All around and above him the building fronts are covered floor to roof in enormous lit advertising boards - bright pink, blue and white panels the size of whole walls, stacked one above the other and wrapped around the corners of the towers - while yellow taxis and crowds pass behind him. The clip then cuts to him leaning on the rail of a ferry, grinning, with a tall green statue on an island behind him, and finally to him standing on a rock at the rim of a huge red canyon at sunset with his arms raised.

5449.meaning: the opening in a wall where a door is
5449.scene: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.

5450.meaning: a thing invented for a particular purpose
5450.scene: A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.

5455.meaning: the official act of approving something
5455.scene: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.

5461.meaning: a document listing the choices you vote for
5461.scene: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.

5462.meaning: a system where citizens elect their leaders
5462.scene: In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.

5470.meaning: the central business area of a town or city
5470.scene: A montage of people walking. First a low shot follows a woman in a navy business suit and nude high heels striding along a city sidewalk past taxis and office workers; then she is seen from behind crossing a street between glass skyscrapers in the financial district. The scene cuts to a bald hiker with a big backpack and trekking poles climbing a forest trail towards a mountain; then to a man in a blue t-shirt walking a golden retriever on a leash across a sunny park lawn; and finally to a high aerial view of a huge crowd streaming across the Shibuya-style crossing between illuminated billboards downtown.

5472.meaning: a piece of paper money from a bank
5472.scene: A black-and-white ink drawing seen from close up: two hands hold an open leather wallet upside down over a shop counter, and several banknotes slide out of it, one of them tumbling away through the air. Below the wallet a small clasp coin purse hangs open and a coin drops out of it towards the floor, with another coin already lying on the wooden counter. Behind the hands the blurred checkout of a shop is drawn, with a cash register, a customer display screen and a long printed receipt curling out of the till.

5476.meaning: the bits left when something is destroyed
5476.scene: A photograph of a destroyed street in daylight. A woman in a dusty beige utility vest and dark trousers walks towards the camera over a slope of broken concrete, carrying a bundle of grey blankets pressed against her chest; her face and clothes are grey with dust. On both sides stand bombed concrete buildings with their fronts torn open and their floors collapsing, a burnt-out car sits on the left, and pale smoke drifts down the street. The whole foreground is a field of smashed concrete blocks, twisted steel reinforcing rods, broken cables and dust.

5488.meaning: an expression of goodwill at parting
5488.scene: On a sunny quay a small group of people stand at the railing waving both arms at a white passenger ferry. An older woman in a flowered headscarf and a young man grin at the camera with their hands raised; others beside them swing pink scarves overhead. The ferry pulls away from the ramp, passengers crowded on its decks waving back, and it shrinks into the blue water towards the city skyline as the group on the quay keeps waving.

5494.meaning: not able to function because of injury or illness
5494.scene: A soft watercolour illustration: a young man in a green jacket and patched brown corduroy trousers sits in a wheelchair and drives it forward himself, gripping the hand rim of the big spoked wheel, which is blurred with motion. A girl in a knitted scarf runs laughing beside him with her arms out. Autumn leaves fall around them onto a leaf-covered path; behind them are yellow trees and an old stone arch bridge.

5497.meaning: a politician running for public office
5497.scene: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.

5505.meaning: photographic material you take pictures on
5505.scene: A comic-style illustration of a dark, teal-lit hospital imaging room. A young medic in a glowing jacket holds a chest X-ray film up against a bright lightbox and studies it; a second X-ray film showing a hand floats in front of her, and the monitors around her display ECG traces and readouts.

4004.meaning: to make something hot or hotter
4004.scene: A hand drops two slices of bread into slots on the spine of a grey twin-engine model fighter jet parked on a granite kitchen counter. The elements glow orange, then long blue flames shoot from both exhaust nozzles. When the flames cut out, two golden-brown slices stand proud of the slots and the hand reaches in to take them.

4017.meaning: a lamp in a case with a handle you can carry
4017.scene: A slow tour of a loft flat as the day ends. Low sun throws long bars across the herringbone floor and a big round red paper lantern glows beside the window. The kitchen is lit only by a strip under the units, then a warm orange paper lantern hangs over a bed facing the city skyline at dusk, and finally strings of bulbs and candles light a roof terrace at night.

4027.scene: A man in a chef's hat carries a big glass bowl of red and green apples through a kitchen, followed by a black and white cow that is also wearing a chef's hat. At the counter he rolls out dough with a rolling pin while the cow watches over his shoulder and licks its nose. He lays overlapping apple slices in a neat circle inside a pastry-lined dish and slides it into the oven. At a wooden table the finished golden pie sits whole beside a glass of milk, and in the last shot the plate holds only crumbs while the man laughs and the cow leans in over the table.

4029.meaning: to hit something with a sharp blow
4029.scene: Three young men with white blindfolds sit in a row on concrete blocks in a red dirt yard, with a fourth man watching from a chair beside them. A big blue water bottle hangs from a rope above them and is pulled back and released, swinging down the line like a pendulum. It sweeps past the first two and slams into the third man, who is knocked backwards off his block with his legs in the air. He picks himself up and sits back down, and all four laugh.

4032.meaning: a state of confusion and untidiness
4032.scene: Three young men sit at a white table wearing pink sleep masks over their eyes, with a big clear plastic box in front of them. The one on the left lifts a smaller tub and tips a thick stream of bright green slime over the head of the man in the middle. The slime coats his hair and face and hangs down in long strings into the box below. He gropes about, lifts a whole stretched sheet of slime up over his head, and the box, the table and all three of them end up smeared with green goo while the other two shake with laughter.

4048.meaning: to set something up for use
4048.scene: A time-lapse of two men converting an empty cargo van into a home. First the van stands open and bare in a car park and one man climbs in through the back doors. Inside, the two of them press timber studs and purple insulation panels into place along the walls under a new wooden roof frame, standing on a fresh plywood floor. On the roof under a blue sky they lower two large black solar panels into position and fix them down. The finished interior is lined with pale wood and has a white-tiled shower, a kitchen with a sink, and a skylight; four men stand inside cheering and dancing.

4051.meaning: a motor vehicle with two wheels
4051.scene: In a car park a man in a black t-shirt and cap stands beside a huge grey six-wheeled expedition truck with a living box built onto the back. He bends down at a rack on the truck's flank and pulls a black electric motorcycle out on its carrier, then stands holding it by the handlebars in front of the truck's giant wheels while he talks to the camera. He then walks through the wood-lined interior of the truck, past a black oven and microwave, a bed and a sink under a skylight, with two long-haired grey cats sitting on the counter and the bed.

4054.meaning: a set of keys on a piano or computer
4054.scene: A dark apartment block at night against a deep blue sky, with one window lit orange among all the black ones. The camera zooms in on that window: inside, a golden retriever is sitting upright on a black office chair at a desk, facing a screen, with its front paws resting on a keyboard. Wearing small glasses, it looks at the screen and moves its paws over the keys, tapping away as if working late.

4060.meaning: the motion of a liquid or gas as it moves
4060.scene: A first-person view from a yellow kayak racing down a narrow jungle river, the paddler's blue sleeve and black paddle swinging in and out of shot. White water rushes past the nose of the boat between mossy rock walls and dense green foliage, with a rainbow hanging in the mist ahead. The kayak is carried straight over the lip of a waterfall and drops into the spray, the screen filling with white water; it comes out below in the mist and carries on downstream, where another paddler in a red kayak is running the same rapid ahead.

4061.meaning: the bones of the mouth that hold the teeth
4061.scene: An underwater shot in clear blue-green water with sunlight streaming down from the surface. A large great white shark swims straight towards the camera, head-on and filling the frame, its pale underside and pointed pectoral fins spread wide. As it comes closer the camera looks up into its face and its mouth opens slightly, showing the wide jaw lined with rows of triangular white teeth. At the last moment the shark turns and passes overhead, and the screen fills with churning white bubbles below the bright surface.

4062.scene: A head-mounted point-of-view shot from a kitesurfer riding on a shallow lagoon at sunset. Two bare forearms reach forward into the frame and both hands close around the horizontal control bar of a kite, the lines running up out of shot. The orange sun sits low over a line of palm trees on the far shore and other kites are visible as small shapes in the purple sky. The rider leans back, the board carves and white spray sheets up across the lens, and the shot ends with the red kite canopy overhead as he skims across the water.

4064.meaning: a long round rod of wood or metal
4064.scene: Two hands hold a small green parakeet that is wearing a tiny camera on its chest, sitting on someone's knee beside a road. Behind it a tall wooden pole carries power lines across a green field, and a huge untidy nest of sticks is balanced on top of the pole. The bird is let go and flies straight at the pole, the nest growing larger and larger until the bird slips in through a gap in the twigs. Inside the dark nest the camera passes through a tunnel of straw and comes out in a lit chamber where four young green parakeets sit around a small wooden table set with three little bowls of seed.

4067.scene: A wide shot of a lake at dusk under a clear blue and yellow sky. The water is completely flat and mirrors the dark line of fir trees on the far shore and the pale glow of the sky, so the treeline appears twice, once above the waterline and once below it. On the right a large rock juts out over the water and a person crouches in silhouette on its edge. They spring off, hit the water, and the smooth mirrored surface breaks into wide rings that travel outward. The swimmer's head appears in the middle of the rings and moves slowly across the lake as the water settles again.

4071.meaning: to move forward in big jumps
4071.scene: A rusted shipwreck stands tilted out of bright turquoise shallows under a sky of white clouds. A woman in a bikini runs along the wreck's raised bow, bends her knees and leaps off the end, stretching out flat as she flies over the water. She hits the surface and the shot follows her down in a stream of white bubbles. Underwater she levels off above a sandy bottom dotted with coral heads, where several large tiger sharks are cruising. She swims in among them and glides right alongside one, her arms wrapped loosely around its back, as a second shark passes behind.

4072.meaning: a calm pool of sea water sheltered by rocks
4072.scene: A drone shot that starts close on three women in bright swimsuits standing together on a small strip of white sand, then climbs and pulls back. As it rises, two enormous grey limestone walls come into the frame on the left and right, rising sheer out of the sea and closing in on the little beach so that it sits at the bottom of a narrow slot. Palms and thick green jungle spill over the top of the beach behind them. In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.

4078.meaning: a cushion for your head when you sleep
4078.scene: A plain bedroom with a woven wall hanging above an enormous bed made up in white. A row of seven identical white pillows is lined up along the head of the bed against the wall. A woman in a black top and grey joggers climbs onto the end of the bed and crawls slowly up the middle of it on her hands and knees, dragging the white duvet into long folds behind her. When she reaches the top she turns, drops back against the row of pillows and flings her arms out wide, lying flat with the pillows behind her head.

4081.meaning: the pointed top of a mountain
4081.scene: A chest-mounted point-of-view shot from a skydiver sitting in the open door of a helicopter over the Alps. His own legs in a white padded suit and tan boots hang out over a wall of high mountains whose ridges and summits are thickly covered in white snow, with a bare green valley running between them and the sun blazing overhead. He drops away, and the helicopter tips over above him and shrinks into the deep blue sky as the snow-covered peaks and glaciers slide past below. Under canopy he comes down towards a bright green alpine meadow with a large orange landing cross laid out on the grass, his boots pointing at it.

4103.scene: A black Labrador puppy is in a kitchen doorway behind an orange cardboard screen. On a flat sheet of cardboard in front of it stands a single upright sausage, with small dark plastic figures beside it. The puppy peeps around the orange screen at the sausage and holds still for a long time, only watching and edging closer. After several seconds it finally gives in, lunges forward, takes the sausage in its mouth and chews it, then sits back on the cardboard with its mouth open and only a hole left where the sausage stood.

4109.meaning: a field of short cut grass
4109.scene: A sunny back garden with a mown grass lawn and a tall green hedge along the back. Two fluffy dogs stand on the grass: a small cream Pomeranian and a bigger black and tan Lapphund. Between them on the lawn sits a round blue pet drinking fountain that shoots a thin jet of water straight up into the air. The dogs watch the jet, then the black and tan dog steps up to the fountain and drinks from it while the cream one circles around, jumps up and paws at the water, and the two take turns at the bowl on the grass.

4114.scene: An animated shopping centre with polished floors, glass shopfronts and bright ceiling lights. A woman in a gold dress walks hand in hand with a very large, heavily built man in a white T-shirt and white shorts. She spots a gold dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window, spins round and pulls him towards it. Her face fills the screen, beaming with excitement; then his face fills the screen, eyebrows raised and mouth open in dismay. In the last shot she strides out of the shop holding a fan of pink and white bags while he trudges behind her with both hands full of shopping bags.

4130.meaning: having a level surface with no slope
4130.scene: A bright marble barber's shop with lit mirrors and shelves of bottles. A gorilla sits in the barber's chair under a black cape, with an enormous round afro standing out around its head. A ginger cat in a white barber's coat and a red bow tie stands on the arm of the chair and runs a pair of electric clippers up the side of the afro, cutting a clean line into it. Clumps of black hair drop onto the cape. The cat works its way round, then swaps to scissors and trims across the top, and what is left is a squared-off block of hair with a perfectly level top, like a table top on the gorilla's head. The gorilla looks straight ahead, unimpressed, while the cat finishes and gives a small nod of approval.

4139.meaning: a line of travel, a way to walk along
4139.scene: A travel sequence in thick mist. A man in a teal jacket stands on a windswept grassy hilltop swinging a big white sheet through the fog. Then a point-of-view shot looks down at a pair of orange trainers standing at the top of a long, narrow stone stairway that runs straight down the ridge and disappears into the cloud, with a huge rock pillar looming ahead. Next, an empty road runs between two rows of golden ginkgo trees towards a red pagoda under a cliff. In the last shot the man, now with a blue rucksack, walks away up a narrow dirt path worn through the green grass, past a wooden handrail, climbing towards the fog-covered rock tower above.

4141.meaning: to be lying flat, not standing
4141.scene: A travel sequence. Five young men in swimming shorts lie side by side on their backs on the low heather and grass beside a still forest lake, feet towards the camera, resting in the sun with dark pine trees on the far shore. The next shot shows friends lying stretched out in long grass on a hillside high above a patchwork of green fields, only their heads and knees showing above the grass. Then a point-of-view shot looks down a long red wooden staircase dropping down a green cliff towards a turquoise bay and a white beach far below. In the last shot the camera sits in the grass at the top of a cliff, legs stretched out in front, looking across at a wide waterfall pouring into a gorge under an orange sunset sky.

4148.meaning: something nice you want but do not need
4148.scene: In a concrete parking garage a man in a navy suit runs his hand slowly along the bonnet of a bright red sports car. He opens the door and lowers himself into the red leather seat, then reaches for the start button on the steering wheel and the dials light up. The car rolls out of the garage with its headlights on, and the last shot shows it standing alone in profile on an empty rooftop deck under a grey sky.

4149.scene: An animated cartoon. A small fluffy beaver-like animal with big round eyes falls backwards through a nest of sticks, then tumbles through a grey sky far above the ground. It lands flat on its face on the scaly grey head of an enormous reptile that is floating in a misty lake in front of a pine forest. The little animal sits up, sees the reptile's huge yellow eye opening right under it, and screams with its mouth wide open before running away over the water.

4157.meaning: to move fast in a race
4157.scene: On a wet tree-lined avenue covered with fallen brown leaves, hundreds of runners in numbered bibs race past the camera on both sides. In the middle of the road stands a small old woman in a beige coat and scarf, holding up a large piece of white cardboard with the handwritten words RUN IF YOU THINK I'M SEXY. She stands completely still, smiling, while the runners stream past her towards the start arch in the background.

4158.meaning: of great size, huge and bulky
4158.scene: An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.

4162.meaning: a public square in a town
4162.scene: A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.

4176.meaning: to shine with a soft light
4176.scene: Inside a dark burrow a yellow chick holds a glass jar with a single firefly glowing inside it, and the small flame of the insect lights up its face and its huge eyes. The chick carries the jar to the round mouth of the burrow and looks out at a whole forest filled with thousands of drifting sparks under a full moon. The hen comes and stands beside it in the glow.

4178.meaning: willing to give and share with others
4178.scene: A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. At the bottom of the hole a family of mice gathers round a big heap of corn lit by a candle.

4180.scene: An elderly woman in a pink shirt walks a full-grown alligator on a red leash down a tiled colonnade in the sun. A young man carrying a small black puppy stops her and points out that the animal on the leash is an alligator and that her actual dog is right there in his arms. She looks down at it, says she forgot her glasses, and carries on walking.

4185.scene: On a yellow woven placemat in a kitchen sits a small grey crocheted mouse with white eyes, pink ears, pink feet and a long pink tail. A hand lowers a white ceramic mug onto the mouse's back and lets go. The mug's weight pushes the mouse's body flat so that only its head, feet and tail stick out from under it, and the mug stands there like it is resting on a coaster. Behind it a plate of waffles with raspberries stands on the table.

4200.scene: A fast drone shot at sunset. It sweeps over a dry clifftop past a single wide tree, where a woman in a white dress stands looking out to sea. It tips over the edge and dives towards a turquoise bay with a natural rock arch in the headland, then races low across the water past a lone swimmer. In the last shots the camera skims the sea surface straight towards the sun on the horizon, and the water and the cloudy sky are one sheet of deep warm yellow light.

4210.meaning: to have something in your hands or grip
4210.scene: A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.

4226.meaning: to pursue wild animals for food or sport
4226.scene: A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.

4227.scene: A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.

4229.meaning: to let someone out of confinement
4229.scene: A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.

4239.meaning: a seaport or airport where people enter a country
4239.scene: A first-person shot shows two gloved hands holding leather reins that run to a seagull flying just ahead, harnessed like a horse. The gull carries the camera over a huge suspension bridge half lost in fog, then drops down and races along a narrow strip of green water between two big red cargo ships tied up at a dock. It skims through the spray, and finally levels out over the harbour towards a white lighthouse with a city skyline behind it.

4240.scene: In a carpeted living room next to a white curtain, one husky rolls on its back with its paws in the air while a second husky stands over it, nosing at it. The two of them then stand side by side facing each other, almost identical black and white dogs with the same markings and the same pale blue eyes. One lifts a paw and paws at the other's chest. The camera closes in on one of them looking straight into the lens.

4241.scene: A young man in a white pilot's shirt with gold striped shoulder boards and a green headset with a boom microphone sits in the cockpit and looks into the camera. The view swings forward through the windscreen: deep blue sky above a flat white deck of cloud stretching to the horizon. The aircraft sinks into the cloud until everything outside is featureless grey, then breaks out low over flat ground. Finally the nose lines up with a grey runway and the centre line and markings rush past underneath.

4267.scene: A small white Pomeranian stands on a dark grooming table in front of a window looking onto a sunny green garden. A groomer works round it with scissors, snipping the straggly hair on its back and legs; little tufts of white fur drop onto the table. The dog pants happily, screws its eyes shut while its face is cupped and shaped, and ends up with a perfectly round, smooth, even coat.

4291.meaning: the part of the face above the eyes
4291.scene: A bald man in a blue shirt with dark sweat patches lies back on the sofa of a bright living room and rolls a cold glass across his forehead, groaning; he looks up at the wall air conditioner, raises the remote and switches it on, then stands with his arms flung wide under the vent with his face tipped up, while the family cat watches from a shelf.

4295.meaning: to take a picture on film or a camera
4295.scene: In the desert beside an airport, a man in a grey thobe and keffiyeh with a camera round his neck points up at an airliner coming in over the sand and the perimeter fence; he lifts the camera to his eye and shoots as the green-and-white jet passes low overhead with its gear down, then turns back to the lens grinning as the plane rolls out on the runway behind him.

4299.meaning: to show a response to something
4299.scene: A curly-haired young man sits in a living room with a big fluffy ginger cat on his lap; as he strokes it his eyes go red and streaming and he sneezes into a paper tissue; a woman in denim lifts the cat off him and carries it across the room, and he keeps sneezing and wiping his nose while she holds the cat at a distance.

4301.scene: A young traveller with a backpack and a camera walks away down a whitewashed blue lane in a Moroccan medina hung with drying laundry, then turns into an extremely tight slot between two blue-painted walls; he edges through the narrow space almost sideways with a wall at his chest and his back, looking up at the sliver of sky above him, and squeezes out of the far end laughing.

4306.meaning: a place where persons are locked up for punishment
4306.scene: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.

4312.scene: A cartoon of a man in a red and blue tracksuit and blue gloves standing on empty sand dunes under a violet sky. He leans forward, cups both hands around his open mouth and calls out. Four curved yellow arcs are drawn in the air in front of his mouth to show the sound travelling out across the empty desert; there is nobody else in the picture.

4313.meaning: a building with a bar where people drink
4313.scene: A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.

4321.meaning: a representation of something, often smaller
4321.scene: A glass-walled office. A woman in a headscarf and a beige blazer leans over a large technical drawing, holding a rule down and marking it with a yellow pencil while two colleagues lean in on either side. She then stands at a table holding a miniature city built in beige card and plastic, with tiny tower blocks, low houses, roads, green lawns and little trees, and reaches in to adjust one of the small towers. Finally she stands outdoors in a yellow hard hat, holding a drawing up in front of a real cluster of tall glass towers.

4330.scene: A photograph of a wide dirt parade ground under a clear blue sky. Rows and rows of young soldiers in matching tan uniforms and brown boots move forward in step, all with the same leg swung out and the same arm thrown straight up in front of them. One soldier at the front wears a tan helmet. Behind them the ranks stretch back to a long concrete wall with coloured flags on poles above it, and dust rises around their boots.

4333.scene: A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.

4336.meaning: a manual explaining how to use a device
4336.scene: In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.

4341.scene: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.

4342.meaning: to pull something slowly and heavily
4342.scene: A pencil-sketch attic under sloping roof beams. A young woman in a work shirt and loose trousers has both hands on the rope handle of a heavy wooden trunk and is dragging it across the bare floorboards towards the viewer, leaning her whole weight back and bending her knees.
