Dust rises in clouds around the trunk and off the torn dust sheet it has pulled off the furniture. Behind her stand two stacked suitcases with an oil lantern on top, a rocking chair, rolled rugs and a small dirty window; cobwebs hang from the beams in the foreground.

4343.scene: A soft pastel cartoon of a bright child's playroom. A young woman with a brown ponytail in a rainbow-striped jumper spins on the spot with three small children hanging off her: a boy on her back, a toddler girl held out at arm's length in the air, and another girl clinging to her leg. All four have their mouths wide open, eyes screwed up, heads thrown back. A polka-dot party hat and a rainbow lollipop fly out of the spin. Balloons float at the left, cushions are scattered on the floor, and a wooden toy box full of teddy bears and building blocks stands by the wall.

4346.scene: A photographic outback scene at sunset. A man in a wide-brimmed bush hat and dusty work clothes walks across bare red sand with a canvas duffel bag slung over one shoulder, turning to look back over his shoulder at the camera; his boot kicks up a puff of red dust. Behind and to his right a mob of five or six grey kangaroos is bounding past through the spinifex grass, each caught in mid-air with its long tail out behind it and its back legs tucked under. A huge red rock monolith glows orange in the low sun on the horizon, with scattered trees and dry golden grass in front of it.

4351.meaning: a hard rock that takes a high polish
4351.scene: A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.

4360.meaning: a container for carrying money and small items
4360.scene: A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.

4368.meaning: to make something lighter or brighter
4368.scene: A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.

4371.meaning: a large entrance or reception area
4371.scene: A woman in a dark suit pushes through the glass doors of a bank. At the counter a clerk feeds banknotes through a counting machine. She then walks into the wide marble entrance hall, a big information screen on the wall and a row of staffed desks along the side. At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.

4395.meaning: a contestant you are matched against
4395.scene: Four friends sit around a coffee table playing a big fantasy board game covered in coloured miniatures. A woman with red hair leans over the board while the man beside her sips from a can. She reaches across and moves a piece into his territory, and he turns to the camera with his mouth wide open in disbelief while she smiles to herself.

4403.meaning: a single thickness of some material
4403.scene: A man in a grey jumper sits on a sofa in a sunlit living room and reaches for a folded blanket beside him. He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.

4404.meaning: physical damage to the body from an accident
4404.scene: A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.

4420.meaning: artwork that helps make something clear
4420.scene: An old book plate on yellowed, foxed paper inside a hand-inked border. In the middle, drawn entirely in fine brown pen strokes, is a single long thigh bone seen at an angle: the round ball at the hip end at the top right, the smooth shaft running diagonally down, the two knobs of the knee end at the bottom left. Dense cross-hatching behind it gives the shading and shadow.

4432.meaning: to refuse to notice or acknowledge
4432.scene: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.

4438.meaning: a ceremonial procession of people marching
4438.scene: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.

4450.meaning: a small part that looks different from the rest
4450.scene: A cartoon of a children's bedroom with a wooden bunk bed. A laughing boy in blue dungarees carries a smaller boy upside down over his shoulder. The dungarees are worn out and have square patches of a different shade of cloth stitched onto the leg and the hip, the stitching drawn as a line of little dashes around each one. On the lower bunk lies a quilt sewn together from many differently coloured squares, and a cushion made of the same patched squares flies through the air above them, while toy trucks, wooden blocks, a rugby ball and a skateboard lie on the floor.

4460.meaning: the inner surface of the hand
4460.scene: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.

4462.meaning: a ceremony where a dead person is buried
4462.scene: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.

4468.meaning: a person employed to carry luggage
4468.scene: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.

4471.meaning: how tall something is, its vertical size
4471.scene: A dramatic painted illustration of a cable car high in the mountains. A red and cream cabin hangs from a thick steel cable, tilted as it swings past a steel lattice pylon capped with icicles, with snow spraying off the wheels. Passengers in winter clothes look out of the windows and one points ahead; a figure in a yellow jacket leans out of a lower window. Far below, snow-covered peaks and small fir trees fill the bottom of the frame, and a second cabin hangs tiny in the distance. Swirling purple and blue clouds fill the sky around it.

4483.meaning: a piece of a tree trunk with the branches cut off
4483.scene: An illustration seen from behind of a woman in a red checked jacket running across a frozen lake, ice skates slung over her shoulder and a hockey stick in her hand. On the right bank stands a small cabin built of stacked round tree trunks with snow on its roof and smoke rising from the chimney, next to a Canadian flag on a pole. Snowy pines and a rocky peak fill the background and red maple leaves blow across the ice.

4492.scene: A man in a long black coat carrying a cream folder walks across a wide cobbled square in the early morning light, scattering a group of pigeons that flap up around his feet. Behind him two rows of tall flag poles line the square and lead the eye to an enormous ornate stone building with a gilded dome and a statue on a column in front of it, lit gold by the low sun, with a red tram and cars passing along the road at its foot.

4496.meaning: to put something in a certain place
4496.scene: A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.

4508.meaning: to fill or place a load on something
4508.scene: A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

4516.meaning: dried grass used as food for animals
4516.scene: A soft pastel cartoon inside a wooden barn. A plump speckled brown-and-white hen has just launched herself off her nest and hangs in mid-air with her wings spread, eyes shut and beak open, loose feathers drifting around her. Below her sits a round nest built of dried yellow grass with three pale eggs in it and two more eggs on the ground beside it. The whole barn floor is covered in the same loose dried yellow grass and more of it is heaped in the stalls behind.

4517.meaning: the act of pulling something toward you
4517.scene: A dark woodcut-style print of a Victorian rooftop. A young sweep in a flat cap and long coat braces himself on the steep slate roof, one boot on the tiles and one against the brickwork, and grips a rope with both hands, one high and one low. The rope runs up over the tall brick chimney stack and down into one of its clay pots. Thick black smoke pours out of the pots and blows across a grey sky, and the roofs and chimneys of the town stand behind him.

4524.meaning: to bend so that one part covers the other
4524.scene: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.

4528.meaning: a place in the ground where a dead body is buried
4528.scene: A woodcut of a village church at night. The tall stone tower with its pointed spire rises against a swirling blue sky with a crescent moon and stars; a bell hangs in the open window of the tower with its rope swinging, and a flock of black crows scatters away from it. Warm light shows through the pointed stained-glass windows and small figures in pale robes walk in through the open wooden doors. All around the church, leaning stone markers stand in the rough grass over the buried dead, with a bare tree on each side.

4534.meaning: a worker who holds an office
4534.scene: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.

4549.meaning: a substance burned to produce energy
4549.scene: A charcoal drawing in blacks and greys. A bare forearm grips the wooden handle of a shovel and tips its load of chunky black lumps forward; the lumps and a shower of black dust fall through the air onto a big heap of the same shiny black rock below. Behind is a dim brick cellar lit by a single bare bulb hanging on a flex. Some of the lumps have spilled out over the drawn border onto the pale grey paper.

4554.meaning: the burning of a fire, giving heat and light
4554.scene: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.

4555.scene: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.

4556.scene: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.

4557.meaning: the top of your thighs when you sit
4557.scene: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

4563.meaning: a legal document of rules for an activity
4563.scene: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.

4582.meaning: to find the size or measurements of something
4582.scene: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

4589.meaning: a person walking in a street, not driving
4589.scene: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.

4592.meaning: the part of the leg below the ankle
4592.scene: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

4598.scene: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.

4599.scene: A close-up at a market stall in low evening sun. A hand tips a small drawstring cloth pouch upside down over a scrubbed wooden counter, and coins and folded paper notes in red, green and cream pour out of it and tumble through the air. A dozen coins have already landed and lie scattered across the boards. Brass balance scales, glass jars and a wicker basket stand blurred behind.

4614.scene: A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.

4620.scene: A charcoal drawing of an airport terminal in the middle of the night. A young man lies stretched across a row of metal seats with one arm flung over his forehead, a backpack beside him and a wheeled suitcase parked at his feet. Behind him more stranded passengers sleep across the seats, curled up in their coats. A big round clock on the wall reads about half past four. Beyond the black glass wall, planes sit on the dark apron. A cleaner pushes a mop cart down the empty concourse and a crushed paper cup lies on the floor.

4624.meaning: more than half of the votes
4624.scene: A photograph looking down a packed town hall with a bare wooden floor and tall windows. More than a hundred people of all ages sit on rows of plain wooden chairs, and almost every one of them has a single hand raised straight up in the air to vote. Papers rest on their laps. A long empty table with stacks of paper and three chairs faces them at the front of the room. Sunlight falls in stripes across the floorboards between the rows.

4636.meaning: a tall tower by the sea whose light guides ships
4636.scene: A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.

4639.meaning: having the characteristics of a liquid, flowing
4639.scene: A woodblock-style illustration of a hand tipping a dark bottle over a kitchen sink. A thick blue-green stream pours out of the bottle's neck in a smooth curve and falls into the sink, where it breaks into swirling waves and masses of white foam. A brass tap sits on the left and two patterned plates lean in the soapy water on the right.

4642.meaning: a sizeable hole in the ground
4642.scene: On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

4643.meaning: a show made for stage, screen or radio
4643.scene: In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.

4651.scene: A soft watercolour painting of the open sea at sunset. A grey bottlenose dolphin arcs through the air above the water, its body dripping, with a second dolphin breaking the surface just behind it. Below, green-blue waves catch the golden light and white spray rises where the dolphins left the water. The sky is peach and pink, with a low dark coastline on the horizon.

4653.meaning: soft wet earth, soil soaked with water
4653.scene: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

4656.meaning: to attach something to a support
4656.scene: A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

4669.meaning: garments that can be cleaned by washing
4669.scene: A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.

4688.scene: Two young men in yellow raincoats lean over the wooden rail of a small boat on a calm blue sea. A dark shape the length of the boat glides just under the surface beneath them. It blows a tall column of spray, then a barnacled humpback whale pushes its head and long ribbed throat up out of the water right beside the hull, rising higher than the men before sliding back down.

4693.scene: A painted scene in a corner office at sunset. A confident man in a grey suit and tie stands behind a big wooden desk, one hand on the desktop, and leans forward to shake hands with a younger man in a brown jacket who sits with his back to us in the visitor's chair. A signed folder, papers and a telephone lie on the desk between them. Through the wide window behind him is a city skyline with traffic in the streets below.

4698.meaning: a machine that turns energy into motion
4698.scene: A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.

4699.scene: A painted factory interior. A man in a yellow hard hat, safety glasses and a work jacket stands in the foreground holding a clipboard with a technical drawing on it and points upwards with his other hand. Behind and above him rises a wall of old industrial machines: a giant toothed gearwheel on a shaft, riveted drums and pipes, round pressure gauges with coloured dials, control panels with buttons, and steel walkways, with steam drifting up between them.

4703.meaning: to move something from lower to higher
4703.scene: A man in a navy suit and a white hard hat presses a carved wooden sign into place above the door of a new stone building, then pulls a cord to drop the cloth covering beside it. Outside on the steps he hauls on a halyard and pulls a green flag up a tall white flagpole while a crowd of people in suits and hard hats claps and two drummers play. He then cuts a teal ribbon stretched across the steps and the crowd applauds.

4708.meaning: to direct the course of someone's travel
4708.scene: A soft watercolour of a dirt track winding through vineyards and olive trees towards a little chapel with cypresses on a hill. A cream and orange minibus is stopped at the roadside with its door folded open. A boy in a straw hat and backpack jumps down from the step with his arms out, another boy in a yellow shirt points up the track, and a woman in a green dress runs after them with a wicker picnic basket and a camera. Ahead of them on the track a man in a white shirt with a lanyard holds a wooden paddle high above his head so the group can see where to follow, and a second picnic hamper stands on the ground by the bus.

4713.scene: On a stone quay in an old harbour, two men in black overcoats and flat caps hand a heavy brown leather suitcase down to a white haired old man in a long dark coat as he steps into a small wooden rowing boat. Along the harbour wall a line of villagers in headscarves, shawls and old fashioned coats stand pressed together with their hands lifted, waving at him. The boat pushes off and is rowed out of the harbour; the camera holds on it as it gets smaller and smaller on the flat grey sea until it is only a dark speck on the horizon.

4735.scene: Soldiers in camouflage uniforms train in hand-to-hand combat on a churned muddy field under a grey sky. A woman in uniform drives blow after blow with her gloved fists into a black padded shield held up by a man in front of her. He then grabs her from behind around the chest and they grapple, stumbling in the mud. Around them dozens of other soldiers do the same drill in pairs on grey mats laid over the mud, and at the end she stands close to camera throwing punches into the air, breathing hard.

4737.meaning: a container with a handle and spout for liquids
4737.scene: A sunny tropical back garden by a pool. A woman in swimwear holds a tall glass under a brass garden tap and lets the water run into it until it brims over. She then tips a grey metal jug with a curved handle and pours a long stream of water from it into a rainbow-striped watering can, and pours another jug of water into a big black bucket. Finally she stands over a blue inflatable paddling pool and fills it with a green garden hose while friends on sun loungers behind her cheer and raise their arms.

4743.meaning: a journey traveling by air in a plane
4743.scene: A young man with headphones round his neck films himself in a window seat of an airliner. In the first shot the plane is racing along the ground past green fields and low houses outside the window and he grins into the camera as it lifts off. The shot cuts to cruising altitude at sunset: the wing and engine are lit orange above a floor of cloud, and he holds up a plastic cup of orange juice from the drinks trolley that a crew member is pushing past behind him. In the last shots it is night, and through the window a whole coastal city glows in orange lines of street lights far below as the plane descends; he turns from the window and claps his hands together with delight.

4745.meaning: to move along smoothly like water in a river
4745.scene: A boy in a green t-shirt crouches on a bank of round pebbles beside a clear turquoise mountain river and sets a small white paper boat down on the water. The current takes it at once: the boat is carried out from the shallow pebbly edge into the deeper green water and moves steadily away downstream, turning slowly as the surface ripples past it. The camera follows it as it travels the length of the reach and passes under the arch of an old stone bridge, with white rapids visible upstream beyond the bridge, until the boy is left standing on the grassy bank watching it go.

4749.meaning: a group of people arranged as one unit
4749.scene: A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.

4753.meaning: to stop blaming someone and forgive them
4753.scene: Two young men stand on a suburban pavement beside a low brick wall with a road bike leaning against it. One in a navy hoodie stands with his arms folded tight and his jaw set, refusing to look up. The other, in black with a takeaway coffee cup, leans on the wall and talks to him steadily. The folded arms drop, the first one looks down and half-smiles, and the two step together into a long hug over the wall.

4754.meaning: to say words that show you disagree
4754.scene: An amateur football match on a worn grass pitch. A player in a dark maroon kit shoulder-barges a player in white off the ball and the white player goes down. The female referee in black points sharply at the offender. He turns to her with both palms raised, arguing and pleading that he did nothing. She raises a yellow card above her head; he keeps talking at her with his hands open, then walks off grimacing.

4755.meaning: a break or crack in a bone
4755.scene: In a clinic a doctor in a white coat stands at a lit X-ray viewer showing the bones of a hand and wrist. She points a pen at a thin dark line running across one of the bones. The young man beside her leans in and looks at the line on the film. He then sits back with his forearm in a thick white plaster cast held up in a blue sling, winces, and holds the casted arm against his chest.

4762.meaning: a room where works of art are shown
4762.scene: A man carrying a leather briefcase walks through a doorway into a narrow white room hung with small framed drawings. He moves on into a larger white hall where other visitors stand in front of sculptures on plinths, and tips his head back to look up at a big block-coloured abstract canvas. The last shots put him alone in a vast glass-roofed hall, walking towards an enormous painting on the far wall and spreading his arms in front of it.

4763.meaning: a person who plays video games a lot
4763.scene: A young man slouches on a sofa with a controller, playing a racing game on a big TV. Next a young woman sits at a desk in a dark room lit by pink and green RGB lights, hands on a glowing keyboard and mouse in front of a game on the monitor. Then a whole living room of friends leans towards the screen with controllers up, shouting. It ends in a packed esports arena where the crowd stands and cheers as a champion is shown on the giant screen above the stage.

4765.meaning: a building with glass walls and roof
4765.scene: A modelling-clay scene of a cottage garden. A woman in a straw hat and blue dungarees strides along a sandy path tipping a watering can, and a thick blue stream of water pours over a raised bed of tomato plants. Behind her stands a small greenhouse with a clay frame and pale glass walls and roof, with plants inside. A cottage with washing on the line, a wooden gate, seedlings, empty flower pots and a trowel fill the rest of the garden.

4772.meaning: a group of birds flying together
4772.scene: An orange and pink sunset over a flat coastal marsh. An enormous mass of starlings wheels across the sky, thousands of dark specks moving as one body and changing shape from a curl to an S to a wide spiral. People stand along a wooden boardwalk watching; an older woman in a plaid coat and beret points up at the birds while a grey-haired man beside her stares open-mouthed at the sky.

4773.meaning: a group of people together in one place
4773.scene: A cobbled city square with cafe terraces and pastel townhouses. A young man stands alone in the middle of the square playing an accordion, his open case on the stones in front of him. A few passers-by slow down, then more stop, a cyclist halts, and within seconds dozens of people have collected around him in a wide ring. By the end a large crowd fills the square and everyone is clapping. A woman with a long red plait watches from the foreground.

4775.meaning: born a very short time ago
4775.scene: A bright living room with plants on the windowsill. A white-haired woman in a cream cable sweater sits on a sofa cradling a tiny swaddled baby whose face is still red and crumpled, only days old. She smiles down at it. A second older woman sits beside her and rests a hand on the bundle, then a teenage boy and a young woman lean in from either side. All four gather around the baby and finally look up at the camera, smiling, the infant still asleep in the great-grandmother's arms.

4791.meaning: official writing that gives you information
4791.scene: A formal meeting in a tall wood-panelled room with a blue flag on a stand and daylight through a shuttered window. A woman in a dark suit stands and leans over the long table, setting down an open buff folder of documents in front of the others. Loose white sheets and a notepad lie on the polished wood beside a glass water jug. Five colleagues in suits, some seated and some standing behind the leather chairs, watch her place the folder.

4792.meaning: to put seeds or young plants into the ground
4792.scene: A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup. In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.

4800.meaning: the man who is getting married at a wedding
4800.scene: A man in a black tuxedo straightens his bow tie in a hotel mirror while a second man watches, walks out through a white door into a garden, waits with his back to the camera in front of a large arch of white and pink roses with guests seated on the lawn, then turns and smiles with a white rose pinned to his lapel.

4810.meaning: a piece of timber fixed upright in the ground
4810.scene: A bearded man in a checked shirt works outdoors on a sunny lawn beside a wire fence. He raises a hammer over his head and drives it down onto the top of a short round wooden upright. He kneels and sets the upright into a freshly dug hole in the earth next to a taller square one, then stands and swings the hammer down on it again to drive it into the ground, and wipes his forehead on his sleeve.

4813.meaning: a sheltered place on the coast for boats
4813.scene: A young man in a wool jumper and rubber boots stands on a stone quay at sunrise with seagulls flying past. Behind him a small wooden boat is tied up on still water, then rows of white sailing yachts moored side by side; he runs his hand along a mooring line stretched from a yacht to the quay. Further along he leans on a rusty iron bollard with a thick rope coiled around it while a container ship is loaded by tall cranes and a tugboat crosses the water behind him.

4818.meaning: the rounded back part of the foot
4818.scene: In a gym with a wooden floor, a finger points in close-up at a foot in a navy sock that has a thin stiletto spike fixed under the rounded back part of the foot, so the sock stands on a heel with no shoe around it. The camera pulls back to show three people in matching navy gym shirts trying to walk across the floor on these spikes, arms held out for balance, wobbling and laughing, one man in shorts leading and a woman and an older man following behind him.

4831.meaning: a successful stroke of the bat in baseball
4831.scene: In a grassy back garden ringed by a wooden fence, a young man in a cap sets up over a coloured ball balanced on a batting tee, swings a blue aluminium bat and sends the ball flying high over the lawn. The camera follows the ball into the grey sky, and he stands watching where it lands among the other balls scattered on the grass.

4846.meaning: to press clothes smooth with a hot iron
4846.scene: A woman in a kitchen runs a steam iron over a white shirt spread on an ironing board by the window. Cut to a bedroom, where a man in a blue polo presses a pair of dark trousers laid flat across the end of the bed. Then an older woman at a wooden dining table works the iron over a stack of grey linen napkins. Next two women stand at opposite sides of a long table in a bright loft and run an iron each over a big white sheet. Finally the two of them hold the finished sheet up between them, hanging smooth and flat.

4852.meaning: a toothed wheel that turns inside a machine
4852.scene: A young man in a workshop apron grins as he works an adjustable spanner on a blue circuit board at his bench, tools hanging on the pegboard behind him. Cut to him in goggles with his hair on end, holding the small board up in both hands over a heavy bench vice. Then he stands back with a screwdriver as a small mechanism is clamped in the vice, and next a larger machine with a motor and rails sits on a rolling bench in front of him, his mouth open. Finally he throws both arms up in a garage in front of a huge machine of purple pistons and interlocking metal gears.

4865.meaning: a glass device that bends light to form images
4865.scene: A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.

4868.scene: A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.

4870.meaning: a mass of small white bubbles
4870.scene: Close up, a man's face is covered in thick white shaving foam and he draws a straight razor down his cheek, leaving a clean stripe. In a bathroom mirror he trims his beard with an electric trimmer. In a barbershop a barber shaves his beard line with a straight razor while he sits under a white cape. By a swimming pool a bare forearm with a white stripe of foam is shaved smooth. Finally he sits grinning in the barber chair while four men around him applaud.

4878.meaning: a platform built from the shore into the water
4878.scene: A young man in swim shorts dives head first off the end of a wooden platform that runs out from the shore over a green lake, and hits the water with a big splash. He surfaces in the ring of foam, two more people plunge in, and then a long platform on posts over turquoise water appears, lined with dozens of teenagers who all jump off it together.

4887.meaning: not wide, small from side to side
4887.scene: A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.

4898.meaning: a flat sheet that forms part of something
4898.scene: Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.

4912.meaning: a person whose job is teaching
4912.scene: In a wooden-floored dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands in front of a class of students in white suits, who all bow together. She then demonstrates for them: she raises one knee and drives a high kick out to the side while the students behind her copy her stance. She holds a wooden board out at arm's length towards the class, calls out an instruction, and finally takes a wide stance with both arms out as the students watch and follow.

4919.meaning: being a member of a group
4919.scene: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.

4934.meaning: a device you wear over your ears or eyes
4934.scene: A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.

4942.meaning: bags you carry your things in when traveling
4942.scene: A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

4943.meaning: words or clapping that show approval
4943.scene: A young man in a striped knitted sweater sits with his eyes closed while a hand dusts powder onto his cheekbone with a make-up brush. He then stands on a film set lit by big softbox lamps, pulls a huge open-mouthed shocked expression twice while a crew member moves equipment behind him, and finally the crew - five people in dark clothes - line up and clap and cheer for him. He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.

4944.meaning: a long formal dress for special occasions
4944.scene: A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.

4946.meaning: hair tied back so it hangs like a tail
4946.scene: A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.

4947.meaning: a likeness of a person in paint or a photo
4947.scene: Two hands squeeze a tube of acrylic paint so a ribbon of yellow lands on a wooden board already loaded with blobs of blue, red, purple, orange and white. A young woman in paint-spattered dungarees works at a big canvas on a wooden easel in a sunlit studio, sweeping red and green strokes on with a brush, then stepping back to look at the swirl of colour. The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.

4950.meaning: the part of the body below the waist
4950.scene: In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

4953.meaning: to wish for something and expect it to happen
4953.scene: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.

4955.meaning: a storage box for your clothes and valuables
4955.scene: A cartoon of a crowded shared dorm room with metal bunk beds on both sides and a bank of tall grey lockers along the back wall. Washing lines strung across the room are hung with socks, underwear and small towels, and backpacks, hiking boots and rolled sleeping mats lie all over the floor and beds. One boy is climbing down from a top bunk and has thrown an orange rolled-up mat through the air; a small child standing on a lower bunk reaches out to catch it, while a boy on the top bunk opposite laughs so hard that tears fly off his face.

4967.meaning: the characteristics by which a person is known
4967.scene: A neon-lit night scene in comic style: a young woman with dark hair stands at a checkpoint window in the rain, wearing a transparent visor while a glowing grid scans her face. She holds up a plastic card that carries her own photo and printed personal details, and a hand in the foreground points a scanner at the card to check that she is who the card says she is.

4972.meaning: inspired by love for your country
4972.scene: At night outside a lit domed parliament building, an officer in white uniform raises a pale blue and yellow national flag up a white pole; the crowd below holds up matching flags and phone lights, fireworks fan out over the dome, and a young woman with her country's colours painted on both cheeks screams with delight in the middle of the flag-waving crowd.

4973.meaning: a structure built to remember a person or event
4973.scene: A young traveller films himself in three places: first standing with arms thrown wide in front of a white marble domed mausoleum at the end of a long reflecting pool, then leaning grinning over cones of bright yellow, orange and red spice at a covered market stall, and finally in a street where people in white clothes hurl clouds of pink, yellow and green powder over each other, until his face and shirt are smeared with colour and he laughs into the lens.

4987.meaning: to give an exhibition of work to an audience
4987.scene: In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

4991.meaning: dirty and not in any order
4991.scene: A man in a colourful tie-dye shirt and glasses stands over a bed heaped with a big pile of crumpled clothes. He pulls a badly creased blue shirt out of the heap and pulls a face at the state of it, then irons it flat on a board and finally holds it up, smooth, beside a rail of hanging shirts.

4997.scene: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.

5015.meaning: made at home by yourself, not bought
5015.scene: In a rustic kitchen with painted pottery on wooden shelves, a young woman in an apron and an older woman in a headscarf stand at a floured wooden table. They push and fold a large pale mass of bread dough with their hands, laughing together, until it is shaped into a smooth round loaf on the flour-dusted table.

5026.scene: A student with blue hair in a yellow hoodie sits in a lecture hall staring at his phone and laughing so hard that he covers his mouth and wipes tears out of his eyes. A girl with braids leans over to look at the screen and laughs with him, and a classmate behind them roars with his mouth wide open while the rest of the room carries on working.

5027.meaning: an official who settles questions in court
5027.scene: A wood-panelled courtroom lit by tall windows. A woman in a black robe sits behind the raised bench and brings a wooden gavel down onto its block, papers spread in front of her and a set of brass scales standing at the edge of the bench. In the foreground a stack of files lies on the counsel table.

5029.meaning: a motion of the hands or body to show a feeling
5029.scene: An ink drawing of a courtroom in heavy cross-hatching. A man in a suit and loose tie strides across the floor mid-step, one fist punched high above his head and the other arm swung back holding an open folder. Behind him a judge sits at the bench, a flag stands in the corner and people watch from the benches on both sides.

5038.meaning: how fast you are walking or running
5038.scene: A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.

5041.meaning: a sudden burst of bright light
5041.scene: An anime-style illustration of a night storm over a city. Thick black clouds fill the top of the frame, and a huge white-violet bolt of lightning splits the sky and slams down onto a wet concrete rooftop, bursting into a blinding white flash with sparks and debris flying out sideways. Smaller branching bolts spread across the clouds, rain falls in streaks, and the skyscrapers behind the roof are lit violet by the strike.

5042.meaning: causing pain in your body or mind
5042.scene: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.

5050.scene: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.

5051.meaning: to put something where you cannot find it
5051.scene: A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.

5053.meaning: a short description that identifies something
5053.scene: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a hijab loops a clear plastic ID tag onto the pulled-up handle of a black hard-shell suitcase, threads the strap and clicks it shut, then shows the card with her photo and name inside. The scene cuts to an airport baggage hall, where she waits by the carousel with her phone; a black case with a bright pink fluffy tag comes round and she pulls it off the belt.

5054.meaning: to take hold of something and move it
5054.scene: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

5055.meaning: a body part in an animal with its own function
5055.scene: A flat cartoon drawing on a mint-green background: a pair of pink lungs seen from the front, with the windpipe branching down into both sides and pale blue airway trees drawn inside each half. Curling light-blue lines and dots swirl around them to suggest air moving in and out. Nothing else is in the frame.

5056.meaning: a female worker who cleans a house
5056.scene: A hotel housekeeper in a turquoise uniform with a pink-trimmed apron snaps a white sheet out over a bed and lets it settle, plumps and squares up the pillows, then folds two towels into a swan and tucks a pink frangipani flower against its neck. She steps back smiling, then goes back to her trolley of stacked towels and toiletries in the doorway.

5060.meaning: a person of the sex that cannot have babies
5060.scene: A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.

5067.meaning: the state of being a married couple
5067.scene: A cartoon bride and groom float in the air in front of a pastel flower arch, kissing. She wears a white gown, a veil and pearls and holds a bouquet up in one hand; he wears a black tuxedo. Confetti and ribbons fall around them while guests in the foreground clap and cheer with their eyes shut.

5070.meaning: the soft thick part of a bed that you lie on
5070.scene: In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.

5072.meaning: a substance that is liquid, not solid or gas
5072.scene: A painted illustration: a pale woman wrapped in a green and red checked cardigan sits up at a bedside table while a second pair of hands tips a brown glass bottle and pours a thick brown liquid into a metal measuring spoon she is holding. A drop is falling from the spoon; a white mug and a folded blanket stand on the wooden table beside her.

5078.meaning: meat that comes from a pig
5078.scene: At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.

5079.meaning: a huge ancient building with triangle sides
5079.scene: A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.

5090.meaning: a room in a home for a baby
5090.scene: A claymation-style scene set in a small baby's room. A woman in a blue jumper kneels on a patterned rug and holds a baby in yellow striped pyjamas up in the air; both are laughing. Behind her stands a wooden cot with white bedding, and around the room there are wooden building blocks on the floor, a knitted purple elephant toy, a chest of drawers, a shelf with potted plants and a curtained window letting in warm light.

5093.meaning: covered with plants grown out of control
5093.scene: A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.

5101.meaning: the sick feeling that you may vomit
5101.scene: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

5111.meaning: to care for someone who is ill
5111.scene: A soft cartoon hospital room. A smiling woman in pink scrubs and a white cap, a thermometer tucked behind her ear and a clipboard under one arm, leans over a hospital bed in white gloves and adjusts the pillow of a small child who lies under a yellow blanket with a spotted rash on the arms and face. A drip bag hangs on a stand beside the bed, and a vase with a daisy and a glass of water stand on the bedside table.

5112.meaning: a small particle of a substance
5112.scene: A bold ink illustration over a wave-patterned background. Two hands in blue sleeves have just thrown food into the air above a wooden bowl that tips on a plank table: spinach leaves, halved tomatoes, walnuts and almonds, blueberries and red berries, slices of salmon, halved boiled eggs and a falling shower of small golden grains of rice or oats. A few loose grains have already landed in the empty bowl.

5114.meaning: a tall pink water bird with long legs
5114.scene: Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

5123.meaning: to fill something too quickly and spill over
5123.scene: A cup under a coffee machine has filled past the brim and coffee is running out over the black worktop and pouring off the edge onto the kitchen floor. A young man in a purple hoodie rushes in and finds the kitchen sink filled to overflowing, the tap still running and white foam and water sheeting down the cupboard doors onto the tiles. He runs down the hallway to the bathroom, where the bathtub is full to the rim and a wall of foam is pouring over the side and spreading across the floor. He stands in the doorway with his hands in his hair, shouting, as the foam keeps rising out of the tub.

5124.meaning: a very long, hard effort you must finish
5124.scene: A phone-held point-of-view shot from inside a road race: the camera runs with the pack along a narrow cobbled street in an old town, passing other runners in numbered vests. Spectators stand behind metal barriers on both sides and clap as the runners go by. The camera drifts sideways past several runners, then holds on one runner in a blue vest striding away up the street between tall pastel buildings.

5132.meaning: a substance of two or more things mixed together
5132.scene: In a bright home kitchen a young man in a beanie makes a pancake. A knob of butter melts and slides across a large non-stick pan on the hob. He holds a ladle high over the pan and pours a thick pale batter into it in a steady stream; the batter spreads into a wide circle and bubbles rise on its surface. At the end he lifts the pan off the hob and tilts it towards the camera to show the browned pancake.

5137.meaning: the assembly that makes a country's laws
5137.scene: Inside a large circular legislative chamber. A woman in a black suit stands among the seated members and raises her hand to vote. The camera pulls back to show the whole hall: hundreds of members in curved rows of desks, packed public balconies above, everyone standing and applauding. A man then speaks from the podium at the centre while the seated members listen.

5142.meaning: the region around where you live
5142.scene: An older man in denim overalls stands on a stepladder outside a clapboard house and pins a string of red, white and blue triangular bunting under the porch roof, then hangs a large striped flag beside the front door. A wider shot shows the same thing happening along the whole street: other men on ladders at their own porches, flags on the houses opposite, and a small child with painted cheeks running across the front lawn behind a wooden picket fence. In the last shots the man stands on the pavement in the middle of the decorated street, bunting strung above him and neighbours waving from the gardens on both sides, and puts his hand flat on his chest.

5150.meaning: directions a doctor writes down beforehand
5150.scene: A young man in a dark red bomber jacket walks into a small pharmacy past a lit green cross. At the counter he holds out a folded white slip of paper to the pharmacist in a white coat, who reads it, turns to the wall of medicine boxes behind her and picks out the packet the paper asks for. She comes back and hands him the medicine across the glass counter, and he takes it and smiles.

5154.meaning: a plant kept indoors in a pot as decoration
5154.scene: A man in a white linen shirt stands at an open window with jungle and rice terraces behind it. He presses a tiny seedling into the soil of a terracotta pot standing on the windowsill, then lifts a metal watering can and pours water over it. The shot opens onto a room crowded with indoor plants - monsteras, ferns and trailing vines in pots on the floor, on stands and hanging in baskets from the ceiling - and he stands among them looking up at them.

5156.meaning: to go down and rest on your knees
5156.scene: Under floodlights on a small caged pitch, a footballer in a yellow number 10 shirt takes the ball past a defender in dark blue, drives into space and finishes. He runs towards the goal, drops down onto his knees on the grass and stays there, head back, mouth wide open, shouting, until a teammate in the same yellow shirt arrives and grabs him round the shoulders while spectators press against the fence behind them.

5157.meaning: the nearby area around where you live
5157.scene: On a cobbled street in a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses, a young man in a yellow vest keeps a football up with his foot while a bigger man in a dark T-shirt watches him. People come out of the doorways and windows of the houses around them and a game starts in the middle of the street, with folded shirts and a small metal frame for goals and women watching from balconies and doorsteps. It ends with all the players running together into one laughing huddle in the road.

5163.meaning: a leader who works in government
5163.scene: A black-and-white comic panel of a political meeting: two men in suits stand on wooden podiums either side of a flight of steps in a hall with tall columns and hanging banners, leaning forward and pointing at each other with angry faces. Below them a packed crowd in suits raises fists and blank white placards, and a giant wooden gavel comes down into the frame from the top right corner.

5165.meaning: a material that can be molded into objects
5165.scene: A woman in navy overalls and work gloves stands knee-deep in a brown river whose surface is covered with floating plastic bottles, plastic cups, plastic bags and white foam; a factory with a smoking chimney and pipes stands on the bank behind her. She bends down, pulls a plastic bottle out of the water, grimaces at it, and straightens up holding it while more rubbish drifts past along the shore.

5169.meaning: to send something by the postal service
5169.scene: A young man in glasses and a cardigan sits at a metal cafe table by the sea, writing on the back of a picture postcard with a blue biro; a stamp lies on the table beside it. He then stands at a rotating rack of postcards on a village street, turning it and pulling out a fan of cards. Finally he stands at a yellow street postbox, holds the postcard to his lips, pushes it through the slot and pats the box.

5170.meaning: a wrapped container you send or give
5170.scene: A postman in a bright red high-visibility uniform and red cap wheels a red bicycle along a street of English terraced houses; a red bag stuffed with letters hangs from the handlebars. He pushes a bundle of letters through the letter slot of a red front door, knocks on the door, waves to a woman watering her front garden, hands a wrapped birthday parcel over a brick garden wall to a resident, then rides off smiling at the camera.

5175.meaning: the hair a man grows on his upper lip
5175.scene: In a busy restaurant a waiter with a thick black moustache, in a white shirt and dark apron, sets down a glass, then lifts a metal pot high above his head and pours a long thin stream of tea into a small tulip glass on the table without spilling, and finally lowers the pot and looks up.

5178.meaning: a piece of cloth worn wrapped around the head
5178.scene: In a white kitchen a woman in a navy headscarf opens the door of a tall built-in oven, turns to a baking tray of chocolate chip cookies on the counter beside her, lifts it, and slides it onto the rack inside the lit oven.

5179.meaning: to move your arm forward to touch something
5179.scene: A woman in a navy headscarf and lilac sleeves stands beside an open built-in oven that glows orange inside; she carries a metal tray of pale dough balls over, stretches her free hand out toward the open oven to feel the heat, then slides the tray onto the rack and closes the door.

5183.scene: A charcoal sketch of a lecture hall. An elderly man with wild white hair, round glasses and a long flowing coat strides at a blackboard, one arm flung out to write while a piece of chalk flies through the air behind him and his other hand is spread wide. The board is packed with arrows and diagrams; rows of students sit at desks behind him writing. His whole body is thrown into the explanation.

5185.meaning: being considerate and sympathetic to others
5185.scene: Heavy rain on a city street. A frail elderly man in a dark jacket stands soaked, clutching a paper bag with two baguettes in it. A young person in a black raincoat steps in behind him and holds a big yellow umbrella over his head, taking all the rain themselves, then puts an arm around his shoulders. Water pours off the umbrella. The two walk on together under it and the old man smiles.

5192.meaning: the line where the sky and the earth seem to meet
5192.scene: Close up on black gloved hands gripping a white rope on a flagpole, a red flag bunched at the top of the frame; behind, a flat field of snow runs out to a straight line where the white ground meets the blue sky. Three people in orange polar suits pull the rope together and the red flag climbs the pole. In the wide shots the empty snow plain stretches to that same distant line in every direction, with one small dark hut on it. The four of them finish standing at the foot of the pole, looking up at the flag.

5193.meaning: red itchy spots on the skin
5193.scene: Two young women in gardening dungarees sit on a wooden bench in a green garden. One of them, red-haired, screws her face up in pain and holds out her bare forearm, which is covered in a patch of angry red blotchy spots, and scratches at it with her fingers. Her friend uncaps a white tube of cream and squeezes a blob onto the red patch, then it is rubbed into a white circle over the spots. The red-haired one winces and grimaces at the sting while her friend laughs beside her.

5199.meaning: to act in the way rules tell you
5199.scene: In a sunny kitchen a young woman in an apron and a green headscarf works through a handwritten page step by step. She leans over it and points at a line, chops cherry tomatoes on a board, tips them into a big bowl of cut vegetables, holds the page up and reads the next step, pours olive oil over the salad, then lays the page flat on the worktop and smiles at the finished bowl.

5205.meaning: a serious promise to tell the truth
5205.scene: At an outdoor ceremony in front of a domed parliament building a woman in a dark suit raises her right hand and lays her other hand on a book held open in front of her while she speaks into a microphone. The crowd behind the barrier waves small red-white-and-blue flags and confetti drifts down. She then appears wearing a tricolour sash, waving to the cheering crowd, and finally turns on the stage and spreads both arms while photographers shoot from below.

5209.meaning: to sit or lie back comfortably doing nothing
5209.scene: A run of people settling into total idleness: a construction worker in a hi-vis vest drops back onto a living-room sofa with his boots up; a woman lies stretched out in a white hammock under palm trees with her hands behind her head; a shirtless man reclines on a striped beach lounger under an umbrella, sipping from a can; a man lies flat in a green field under a blue sky; a woman lounges in a hammock on the sand as the sun sets over the sea.

5213.meaning: the line that runs trains for passengers
5213.scene: On a covered platform a boy holds a blank white sign above his head and a woman waits beside him with a bouquet, a red train standing at the platform edge and the rails running away past them. Passengers come out of the train and walk down the platform with their cases; a young woman in a denim jacket runs along the platform towards a man with a rucksack and jumps into his arms. The whole group closes around them in a hug, the flowers still in someone's hand.

5229.meaning: a small number or amount of something
5229.scene: A photograph taken on a bright, freezing winter morning in a snow-covered public square. A woman in a long dark fur coat, black gloves and a patterned fringed shawl stands side-on to the camera, has just scooped up as much powdery snow as her two hands could hold and thrown it upwards; the small cloud of snow hangs in the sunlight in front of her while the rest falls back down. Behind her rises a cathedral with brightly painted onion domes, with bare birch trees and snow-covered ground around it.

5231.scene: A big family sits along both sides of a long wooden table inside a log house with a lit stove behind them. A tall brass samovar steams in the middle of the table, which is loaded with a platter of dumplings, a stack of pancakes, dark rye bread, jars of pickles, radishes, cucumbers and jam. An elderly woman in a headscarf and apron works the samovar tap, filling glasses of tea and handing them round to the children and adults; at the end everyone reaches in and clinks their glasses together over the food.

5233.meaning: connected with soldiers and the army
5233.scene: Rows of young officers in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold shoulder cords and shiny buttons stand at attention and hold a salute, with rows of blue and yellow flags on poles behind them. The shot pulls back to a huge parade ground where hundreds of soldiers stand in straight blocks across the tarmac, a single officer in a beret out in front of them, while a crowd of spectators watches from behind steel barriers in the sunshine.

5234.meaning: a row of soldiers standing side by side
5234.scene: Row after row of young women in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold cords and white gloves stand shoulder to shoulder in a parade square, each row exactly level with the next. They all hold a salute with the white-gloved hand at the cap. The camera moves back over the block of them, showing a packed stand of spectators and a line of national flags on tall poles behind the formation.

5246.meaning: a narrow-necked glass container for liquids
5246.scene: A young woman in a white lab coat, white cap and safety goggles works in a busy laboratory. She pipettes bright blue liquid into a rack of test tubes, swirls a conical glass flask of blue-green liquid over a hotplate, then holds the flask up to the light and smiles at it. She bends to a microscope with a flask of blue liquid beside her, and at the end holds up a flask of glowing pink liquid while a colleague at the next bench watches.

5247.meaning: the marks your feet leave on the ground
5247.scene: A trail of big muddy footprints runs the whole length of a white tiled hallway. A small elderly woman in an apron stands at one end holding a mop and wags her finger at a large young man in a black T-shirt who is holding a motorcycle helmet; his boots and his dog are both caked in mud. She hands him the mop, he lowers his head and takes it, and starts pushing it over the prints while the dog sits and watches.

5255.scene: A courtroom. An elderly judge in a red robe and white wig sits at a high wooden bench and reads a document aloud. A young man in a dark suit stands in the dock below her and stares up, shaken, as she speaks. She lifts a wooden gavel and strikes it on its block. A wide shot shows the packed court, barristers in wigs and gowns at their tables and a full public gallery.

5259.meaning: the thick hairy coat of an animal
5259.scene: A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.

5269.meaning: to obtain or acquire something by paying
5269.scene: A young woman in a beige coat and orange beret shops her way through a city: first in a wood-panelled chocolate shop where she holds up a chocolate bar, then at a clothes rail where she takes down an olive coat, then at the till where she hands the coat over and pays at the card terminal, then walking through the glass atrium of a shopping centre, and finally out through the doors holding a large white gift bag tied with a gold ribbon.

5272.meaning: a person who walks long distances in nature
5272.scene: The same three backpackers at the Grand Canyon railing, filmed closer. The woman calls out over the canyon, the bearded man lets out a roar while she points at him laughing, and then all three throw their arms and fists up in the air and whoop together over the view.
