5273.meaning: a person who poses for a photographer
5273.scene: A male model walks a fashion-show runway in a yellow denim jacket over a purple shirt and green trousers with white and yellow trainers. The catwalk is painted in soft colour blocks and rows of guests sit along both sides filming him. He walks towards the camera, turns at the end, checks the watch on his wrist and poses smiling in sunglasses.

5284.scene: An oil painting of a knight standing in a castle courtyard. He wears a full suit of polished plate armour that catches the light, a dark red cloak hangs behind him, he rests both gauntleted hands on the pommel of a long sword whose point is set on the ground, and he holds a feathered helmet under one arm. Castle towers, a banner and a flag stand behind him.

5289.scene: A soft painted illustration of a bare forearm and open hand against a cream background. A single clear drop of liquid sits on the inside of the forearm. In the top left a round magnifying inset shows the same skin close up, dry and cracked into a fine network of lines with visible pores.

5292.scene: A montage of people falling asleep where they should be awake: a young man at a computer in an open-plan office yawns hugely, then drops face down onto his keyboard; a student in a grey hoodie and glasses sleeps on an open book in a library; a man in a jacket sits slumped back on a park bench in bright sunshine with his head tipped back, asleep; a man in a grey tracksuit sprawls yawning on a sofa beside a coffee table holding a twin-bell alarm clock and a phone.

5295.meaning: a thing you blow to make a loud noise
5295.scene: A blue ballpoint drawing in a notebook: a smiling man in an embroidered folk costume and sheepskin waistcoat stands on a patterned hillside, leaning back and blowing into a very long curved horn decorated with folk carvings that rises high above his head. Sheep run and graze around him, and wooden log cottages with smoking chimneys sit on the slope behind, under stylised clouds and rolling hills.

5313.meaning: glowing with bright electric colors at night
5313.scene: A young woman in a pink and mint traditional Korean dress spins in front of a tiled palace gate in daylight. She then sits at a night street-food market strung with paper lanterns, eating an orange rice cake from a paper cup and pulling a wide-eyed face at the taste. The last shot is a night city crossing where whole building fronts are covered in glowing electric signs in red, blue and yellow; a bus passes behind her while she makes a small finger heart.

5336.scene: In a floodlit stadium at night a grey-bearded man in a flat cap and black denim jacket takes off his cap, holds it against his chest and lays his hand over it. He looks up towards the stands and sings along with the anthem while the men and women around him stand with their hands on their hearts. The camera drifts back to show a long row of supporters all doing exactly the same.

5337.scene: A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.

5341.scene: A pencil sketch on white paper. In a workshop a bearded man kneels beside a half-built wooden go-kart and tightens a bolt on its frame with a wrench. Next to him a boy in a baseball cap kneels on the floor and swings a hammer down onto a nail he is driving through a plank beside the kart's wheel. Behind them stands a workbench with a pegboard of spanners, an angled lamp and a shelf, and wood shavings and a screw hang in the air around them.

5344.meaning: a warm cover sewn from many pieces of fabric
5344.scene: Close-ups of hand sewing: a needle and white thread pull a button tight on a checked shirt, a needle closes a rip in blue jeans, and a colourful flower is embroidered on white linen; a pocket knife points at a denim jacket button. Then a bright room of young women sitting on the floor with fabric squares, who lift a big finished patchwork quilt of many coloured pieces and cheer behind it.

5345.meaning: to bend your body away from upright
5345.scene: A blonde woman in an orange running top jogs along a riverside bridge beside a running partner. Her face twists, she grabs her side and slows to a halt, then lays her forearm on the white bridge railing and rests her weight against it, bent forward and screwing up her face while her partner stops next to her.

5352.meaning: the feeling of being blocked from your goals
5352.scene: A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.

5353.meaning: work that means handling forms and papers
5353.scene: An open-plan office. A woman in a rust-coloured blouse sits at a desk with a corded handset wedged against her ear, talking into it while she reaches for a pink sticky note and taps at her keyboard. Around her the desk fills up with towers of loose printed sheets and ring binders - one stack to her left, another rising in front of the monitor, more piling up until they reach above her head and box her in. Colleagues move about in the background. She stops, puts the handset down and slumps forward onto the desk between the paper towers.

5358.meaning: to take a quick secret look from behind something
5358.scene: A young woman in glasses and a beige cardigan sits at a long wooden table in a grand library, writing in an open textbook with a blue pen while other students work behind her. She piles more and more thick books on the table until the stacks form a wall taller than she is, and at the end she is hidden behind it, only her eyes showing as she looks out through a gap between the piles.

5360.meaning: an electric railway that runs below the ground
5360.scene: A young man with bleached hair, glasses and a varsity jacket films himself pulling the camera along by the hand through an underground station. He taps through the ticket gate, stands on the platform as a train rolls in, steps into the carriage among other passengers, and then walks down a long underground corridor packed shoulder to shoulder with commuters, looking back at the camera with an astonished face.

5371.meaning: a ring or chain of flowers used as decoration
5371.scene: At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.

5388.meaning: things wrapped together in one package
5388.scene: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.

5395.meaning: a large farm where cattle are raised
5395.scene: A wide dry plain under a pale sky. A young ranch hand in a canvas jacket, denim shirt and leather chaps rides a bay horse at a trot along a barbed-wire fence, one gloved hand brushing the top of a fence post as he passes. The fence runs dead straight away to the horizon, dust drifts up behind the horse, and a windmill and flat-topped mesas stand far off in the haze.

5396.meaning: to designate a place with a mark
5396.scene: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.

5397.scene: A woodblock-style print of an enormous dark blue wave rearing up over a rough sea. The crest curls right over and breaks into white foam and scattered droplets; smaller waves roll away behind it towards a flat horizon, and four seagulls glide against a pale, streaked sky.

5412.meaning: a tall stone post that holds something up
5412.scene: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.

5413.meaning: without hope that things can get better
5413.scene: A dark ink-and-wash comic panel of a city gridlock at dusk. Cars, vans and a box lorry stand nose to tail across every lane under an elevated flyover, tail lights glowing red and exhaust smoke drifting between them, with the jam stretching away to the horizon. In the foreground a driver has climbed halfway out of his car window and raised an open hand at the unmoving queue, a man in a cap leans out of the van beside him, and a motorcyclist edges along the narrow gap between the lanes. Blank billboards and tower blocks fill the smoky skyline behind, and nothing in the picture has any way out.

5414.meaning: a barrier made of a horizontal bar on supports
5414.scene: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.

5416.meaning: the engine at the front that pulls a train
5416.scene: A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.

5418.meaning: the space that is inside of something
5418.scene: A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.

5428.meaning: goods carried by a big truck or ship
5428.scene: A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.

5440.meaning: the son of your brother or sister
5440.scene: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing on cream paper. A grown bearded man in a denim jacket runs across a meadow with a kite reel in his raised hand, his cap blowing off behind him, and a small laughing boy in dungarees runs along beside him holding the string of a second kite. Two patterned diamond kites with long curling ribbon tails climb into a sky of drawn swirls above a low sun; dandelions and daisies fill the grass in the foreground.

5446.meaning: covered with thin fog, hard to see far
5446.scene: A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.

5451.meaning: a substance pushed into the body under pressure
5451.scene: In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.

5454.meaning: a liquid used for printing or writing
5454.scene: A close photo of a wooden desk where a hand in a khaki sleeve presses a round rubber stamp down onto the open page of a passport. The other hand holds the booklet flat. The page already carries one black rectangular stamp mark, and fresh black drops have splattered around the one being pressed, with a dark stamp pad standing at the top left of the desk.

5459.meaning: melted rock that flows out of a volcano
5459.scene: A dark ink-style illustration of an erupting mountain at night. A huge boiling cloud of ash rises from the crater, lit orange from below, and glowing molten streams run down every slope of the mountain in bright branching lines. Burning lumps of rock fly through the black sky trailing smoke. In the foreground the ground is cracked into plates with orange-hot rivers glowing in every crack.

5463.meaning: a daily written record of your experiences
5463.scene: A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.

5466.meaning: following the established rules, like formal dress
5466.scene: An illustration of a smart restaurant dining room in warm orange light, with brass chandeliers, wood panelling and tables under white cloths. A young waiter walks through it in the strict uniform of the trade: white shirt, black bow tie, black waistcoat, long white apron and black trousers, a folded white cloth over his forearm. He balances a tray of stacked plates and wine glasses high on one hand and sets a plate down with the other. Seated guests in jackets and dresses dine at candlelit tables.

5471.meaning: flat, with no part higher or lower
5471.scene: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

5477.scene: In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.

5484.meaning: to look at something steadily for a long time
5484.scene: A boy, a woman and a man stand side by side at the wooden railing of a rooftop terrace at night, with the roofs of a town behind them. Fireworks climb and burst in the dark sky above them. All three keep their heads tilted back and their eyes fixed on the sky for the whole clip, mouths open in wonder, the boy pointing upwards once as another rocket goes up.

5493.meaning: the central part of a wheel, around the axle
5493.scene: In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.

5501.meaning: making goods and services to sell
5501.scene: A charcoal drawing of a large dim factory hall with a steel roof truss, hanging lamps and heavy machinery lining both walls. In the middle a man in a hard hat, dirty overalls and thick gloves leans into a hand truck loaded with wooden crates and a metal drum, pushing it forward across the concrete floor. Dust hangs in the light. More crates and a second hand truck stand in the foreground.

5503.meaning: the way the body and limbs are arranged
5503.scene: A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.

4006.meaning: clear, so you can see through it
4006.scene: Bare feet walk along a bleached log lying just under the surface of a glass-clear alpine lake. The water is so transparent that the stones and sunken branches on the bottom stay sharp. The camera lifts to a snow-capped mountain mirrored in the still surface, then drops under the water, where a small orange frog swims towards the lens above the sunken log.

4008.meaning: to move something quickly back and forth
4008.scene: A young man in a red tracksuit jacket stands under an apple tree in a garden at night, with a black dog beside him and yellow apples already scattered over the grass. He grabs a low branch and shakes it hard, and more apples drop around him. The dog trots through the fallen fruit and he climbs up onto the concrete fence.

4014.meaning: to move by turning over and over
4014.scene: A young man in a white shirt and red shorts rides a skateboard through an empty airport car park, towing a hard-shell suitcase along beside him by its handle. He carries on down a glazed walkway, steps onto a travelator at sunset and glides out across the open roof deck past concrete bollards.

4019.meaning: a round shape with a hole in the middle
4019.scene: A man in swim shorts stands at the edge of a garden pool holding a folded towel and smiling at the camera. In the pool a golden retriever puppy floats with its head and front paws resting through a bright pink inflatable ring. A grey pitbull drifts past in a red one, and the camera returns to the puppy dozing in the pink ring.

4031.meaning: at the top or highest position
4031.scene: Three young men stand behind a blue ping-pong table in a games room, staring at a plastic bottle in front of them with two tennis balls balanced one on top of the other on its neck. One of them throws a third tennis ball, which arcs up over the table. It comes down and lands on the very top of the stack without knocking it over, so that three balls now sit in a column on the bottle. All three throw their arms up and shout in celebration.

4043.meaning: to cause someone to be surprised
4043.scene: A woman in a black leather jacket and beige trousers walks along a sunlit street of honey-coloured stone buildings, tucking her hair behind her ear. She turns and sees a man getting out of a black car parked at the kerb, carrying an enormous bouquet of pale pink peonies. He walks up to her and holds the flowers out; she takes them, and in the final shot she is behind the huge bouquet with her hand over her mouth, laughing and crying at once.

4046.meaning: to show you are unwilling to do something
4046.scene: A couple sits close together on a dark sofa in a room lit by candles and warm lamps at night. The woman in a floral top turns to the man in an olive t-shirt and talks to him, smiling. He turns his head towards her, raises his index finger in front of his chest, shakes it and says no. She keeps hold of his arm and bursts out laughing while he holds the finger up and keeps saying no.

4063.meaning: to let something go from your grip
4063.scene: A man in a dark jacket and jeans hangs from two red webbing straps clipped to a harness across his chest, suspended in the air high above an unbroken sea of golden clouds at sunrise. He looks down between his boots. The straps let him go and he drops straight away from the camera, shrinking to a small dark speck against the cloud layer. The camera keeps looking down as he disappears into the clouds, and at the end a pale ledge slides into the bottom of the frame.

4068.meaning: to touch lightly again and again
4068.scene: An underwater shot in clear blue water just above a white sandy seabed. A large tiger shark, its grey back marked with dark vertical bars, cruises slowly from left to right across the frame. A freediver in a bikini, mask and long fins swims down beside it, matching its speed, and reaches out with one hand. She lays her palm on the shark's back near the dorsal fin and runs it slowly along the animal's flank as the two glide side by side over the sand. She keeps her hand on it for several seconds before the shark turns away.

4069.meaning: a long thin bar of metal or wood
4069.scene: An animated scene on a wooden dock under a grey sky. A tall white pigeon with long eyelashes stands beside a small scruffy grey and green chick, and the chick holds a thin fishing rod with the line dropping down into the dark water. The camera looks down at the water, where rings spread from the float. A mermaid with long black hair rises out of the sea, a city skyline behind her, smiling with her eyes shut. She lifts the chick in her cupped hands and sets it gently back on the planks. The big white pigeon glares, spreads a wing over the chick and stares the mermaid down.

4070.meaning: one of the two side parts of an airplane
4070.scene: Inside the cramped white cabin of a small aeroplane, several people in swimwear and parachute rigs shuffle barefoot towards the open door. The shot cuts outside: two of them are hanging from the wing strut under the plane's long wing, high above a coastline, with the landing wheel beside them. They hold the strut with both hands, dangling in the wind, then let go one after the other and drop away. The camera stays with the plane, and the frame is filled by the underside of the wing with the blue sea, the white surf line and the flat coastal city far below.

4073.scene: An animated autumn park with orange trees and benches. A plump teal and purple pigeon stands with its eyes closed and a soft smile. A large angry white hen with a red comb stands over three yellow chicks and swings a wooden stick at the pigeon; the next shot shows the pigeon wide-eyed with the stick pressed across its beak. A yellow chick has fallen asleep tucked into the pigeon's blue chest feathers with the stick lying across it. The hen lowers the stick and walks off with her chicks, and the teal pigeon turns to a white and pink pigeon beside it, their wings touching.

4079.scene: A point-of-view shot from the front of a yellow kayak dropping into a white-water river in a steep pine gorge. The pale green water rushes past on both sides, piling into standing waves and white foam between dark rocks, and the boat is carried down fast. A hand works a black paddle across the bow, spray bursts over the lens and blurs it, and the walls of fir trees rush by. The river then widens and slows, and the kayak arrives at a calm stretch where four paddlers in red kayaks and helmets are waiting on a grey gravel bank.

4080.meaning: the joint between the hand and the arm
4080.scene: An animated scene in a home. A mother in a purple jumper stands behind her small daughter, who sits scowling in a pink hoodie with her arms folded. The mother gathers a handful of the girl's long brown hair in one fist and holds it up, looking around with a worried face for something to tie it with. She leans over and rummages through an open wooden drawer, then searches a dressing table lit by round bulbs around a mirror, pushing aside bottles and tubes. She presses a hand to her forehead in despair. Then she notices three grey hair ties looped around her own wrist, and a close-up shows her fingers hooking one off her wrist as she smiles.

4082.meaning: turned over, in an inverted position
4082.scene: Filmed from inside the open door of a small plane flying high above a turquoise coral reef. A woman in a white and blue jumpsuit and harness hangs from the wing strut outside the plane, laughing, her legs swinging free in the open air. She swings under the wing, hangs upside down, and then lets go and drops away from the plane, shrinking to a tiny figure against the blue water far below.

4090.scene: A tall silver rocket stands beside its steel launch tower on a concrete pad under a clear blue sky, venting white vapour. The engines light and orange flame and white smoke burst out around its base. The rocket lifts off the pad and rises past the tower, its exhaust turning to a bright pink and white column. It climbs out of frame and a huge cloud of pale smoke and dust rolls across the pad, leaving only the tower and the trail of fire above it.

4093.scene: A telescope view of the moon against a black sky scattered with faint stars. At first only a small pale disc shows in the corner of the frame. The camera zooms in steadily until the moon fills most of the picture: a large round grey body with its curved bright edge on one side, the darker flat plains in the middle, and thousands of small craters picked out along the shadow line.

4098.meaning: a line or route leading to a place
4098.scene: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a narrow dirt track that runs along a steep green alpine ridge, with deep valleys and misty mountains beyond. Two brown cows with bells around their necks are standing right on the track, blocking the only way through. One walks straight at the camera and the rider reaches out a gloved hand and pushes its face gently aside. The cows step off the path, and the rider rolls on down the empty track over the ridge.

4121.meaning: a series of pictures forming one part of a film
4121.scene: A film shoot in a stone quarry, seen from behind a big cinema camera on a rig in the foreground with its monitor turned towards us. Across the pit stand two tall concrete silos with a metal walkway running from them to the rock face. An orange fireball bursts out at the walkway and black smoke rises; a stuntman hanging on a wire swings away from it across the quarry. The metal walkway tears loose and crashes down the rock face, throwing up a huge cloud of pale dust that fills the pit while the camera keeps rolling and crew in yellow high-visibility vests watch from below.

4123.meaning: crying, with tears running down the face
4123.scene: A hand-drawn cartoon on a grey background. A girl with long dark hair kneels holding a sheet of paper marked with a big red A+. Her face crumples, her mouth turns down and two thick turquoise streams of tears run from her eyes. She throws her head back and wails with her mouth wide open while the tears gush out in great arcs on both sides of her head and pool on the ground around her knees, until she is kneeling in a spreading puddle of her own crying, still holding the paper. The cartoon then cuts to two grinning men in small gold crowns standing on a cliff, each holding up a sheet marked 50, waving them over a crowd of small figures cheering below.

4125.meaning: a platform where people stand to be seen
4125.scene: A theatre stage under a single beam of spotlight, with the dark silhouetted heads of the audience along the bottom of the frame. Something huge stands on the sand-covered stage floor under a turquoise silk sheet. A man in a white suit walks on from the side, takes the corner of the silk and pulls; the sheet lifts and floats away, and on the stage stands a life-size elephant made entirely of red, orange and white flowers. He steps back and the whole flower skin bursts apart into a curtain of falling petals that pours down over the stage. When the petals clear, a real elephant is standing there in the spotlight with a ring of red flowers on its head, lifting its trunk, and the stage floor is carpeted with petals while the audience films it.

4150.scene: A dark green sports car speeds along a narrow country road, filmed from a camera held close to its side so the grass at the roadside blurs past. Close-ups show the rear wing with the badge on it, and a gold wheel with a yellow brake spinning fast just above the gravel. Another shot runs along the green bonnet towards the road ahead. At the end the car stands still on a sandy track by the dunes with the sea behind it, and a man in a brown t-shirt walks up to it.

4152.meaning: something that transports people or objects
4152.scene: A large black closed trailer stands on a gravel drive in front of green summer trees, filmed from behind. Its whole back wall begins to tip down slowly, turning into a ramp. As the ramp lowers, the dark inside of the trailer appears and a pale grey sports car is revealed standing inside it. The ramp comes all the way down to the gravel so the car could be driven straight out.

4175.meaning: to go quietly so nobody notices
4175.scene: In deep snow at sunset a brown hen creeps low along a drift past a pile of sleeping wolves, one of them curled around a pale egg-shaped stone. She burrows into the snow until only her red comb shows above the surface, waits there, and then stands up covered in snow with a hard stare. The last shot has her out in the open on the pink snow, facing two wolves between bare black trees.

4188.meaning: an elevated slope of ground, a hillside
4188.scene: A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.

4193.meaning: under the level of the ground
4193.scene: On the brick-paved forecourt of a large brick country house, a whole section of the paving tilts up on a hinge like a huge trapdoor. A dark green Porsche sports car reverses down the opening onto the platform below the paving. The brick lid lowers back over it until the forecourt looks solid again. The last shots are inside the space below the drive: the car parked in a concrete room lit by warm orange wall lights, with the brick ceiling above it.

4201.meaning: in a vertical position, standing up
4201.scene: Two riders on blue dirt bikes ride side by side across a wide beach at sunset. The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.

4203.scene: A shirtless man in neon green swim shorts stands over a shark stranded in the wet sand at the edge of a turquoise sea. He grips it by the tail, hauls it backwards through the shallow water until it is deep enough to swim, lets go, and steps back to watch it move off on its own into the waves.

4209.meaning: the natural state of rest at night
4209.scene: Two hamsters lie on a thick white fluffy blanket in a warm, dimly lit room strung with fairy lights. The one on the left wears round glasses and taps at a small silver laptop, still awake and working. The one on the right has a white sheet face mask over its face and a pink bow headband, and lies on its side with its eyes shut, not moving, deep in sleep while the other works on beside it.

4222.scene: A small green cartoon gecko stands in a bright circle of light, seen as if through a peephole. It raises one hand and waves at the camera, then breaks into a dance, spinning and throwing its arms out. It settles, folds its arms across its chest and grins with its eyes shut, then leans right up to the lens until its face fills the frame.

4223.scene: A green cartoon gecko leans over a white bowl heaped with small red chilli peppers and starts eating them. Its eyes bulge, its skin turns from green to orange to bright red, and a jet of flame shoots out of its open mouth over the bowl. It dives into a tall glass of water and sits curled up inside, still glowing red. Finally it slumps out of the bowl onto the table, back to green, dripping wet with its tongue hanging out.

4245.scene: A long concrete aqueduct wall runs through a jungle of tall palm trees, with water spilling over its edge as a wide waterfall. Young men lie on their backs in the shallow water on top of the concrete channel and slide along it with their arms flung out, throwing up spray. They then stand under the falling water at the foot of the wall, the white torrent pouring over their heads and shoulders. A drone shot pulls back to show the whole mossy wall, the sheet of falling water and one man still sliding along the top, surrounded by green jungle.

4250.meaning: a large building for storing goods
4250.scene: A tall storage warehouse with long aisles and racking stacked to the roof with wrapped pallets. In the foreground a chihuahua wearing a yellow hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest stands on its hind legs looking off to the side. Behind it a golden retriever drives an orange forklift carrying pallets of bottled water, while another small dog in a hi-vis vest walks down the aisle. The forklift catches the stack and the pallets of water burst apart, spilling packs of bottles all over the concrete floor. The chihuahua turns to the camera with wide eyes.

4251.scene: An animated walk-in wardrobe. A hand points along a completely bare wooden shelf and an empty hanging rail on one side of the room, then sweeps across to the other side. The camera pulls back to show the whole wardrobe crammed with pink and purple clothes on the rails and folded in stacks on every shelf, with a deep heap of clothes covering the floor. A muscular cartoon man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers stands in the middle of the heap staring at it, and the shot closes in on his shocked face.

4256.meaning: to cause friction by rubbing with something sharp
4256.scene: A grey kangaroo stands upright on a green hillside pasture under a grey sky, with gum trees and a fence in the distance. A person's hand reaches in from the side and scratches the kangaroo's chest and neck with the fingers. The kangaroo half closes its eyes and leans into the hand, then slowly sinks down and lies flat out on the grass, stretching its long back legs and heavy tail behind it while the hand keeps scratching its head and neck.

4258.meaning: a strong metal made of iron and a little carbon
4258.scene: A long curved steel slide runs down a green mountain meadow, its polished grey chute filling the bottom half of the frame, with dark pine forest and hills behind. A spotted fawn lies curled up in the steel chute at the top of the slide. It sits up and looks straight down the slide at the camera with its ears out, settles back down into the chute, then gets to its feet and walks off into the tall grass beside the slide.

4262.meaning: wild animals and other living things
4262.scene: A mother brown bear and two cubs walk along a wide grey sand flat at low tide, below a steep mountainside streaked with snow, with pale glacial water behind them. A black raven stands on the sand nearby, spreads its wings and hops aside as the cubs trot past. The family walks on along the shoreline and away from the camera.

4270.scene: A point-of-view shot from inside a go-kart: a driver in a bright striped racing suit grips the small steering wheel and speeds along a sunlit tarmac circuit with red and white kerbs, tyre barriers and eucalyptus trees, another kart running ahead. Then a duck waddles out onto the track in front, and the kart drops from full speed to a crawl and creeps along behind the bird until it has crossed.

4282.meaning: a structure that gives protection from danger
4282.scene: A couple crouches at a wire kennel door inside an animal rescue centre and greets a tan dog through the mesh; a staff member in a green polo shirt opens the kennel and the couple hug the dog; at the front desk the same woman stamps their adoption paperwork; the couple then walk the dog out on a red leash down the bright corridor and out through the exit.

4287.scene: An estate agent in a green blazer with a lanyard and a folder opens the door of an empty flat and waves a young couple in; she pulls the sheer white curtains aside and opens the balcony door onto a city skyline, and the three of them stand looking out; in the hallway she hands the couple a set of keys and they laugh with delight.

4296.meaning: a gesture or action that sends a message
4296.scene: An illustrated view down from an airport control tower at sunset: ground marshals in orange vests stand on the apron with both arms raised holding marshalling wands to guide the aircraft in, a tug tows a train of baggage carts past a dropped suitcase, fuel tankers cross the taxiway, airliners sit at their jet bridges, and beyond the grass another plane lifts off the runway under a windsock.

4300.meaning: worthless material to be thrown away
4300.scene: An inked comic-book panel of a narrow night-time alley between two brick tenements: metal dustbins in the foreground are heaped over the rim with crumpled paper and waste, a hooded figure runs down the wet cobbles clutching a satchel, a ginger cat leaps off a dumpster lid, steam pours from a grate in the ground, and fire escapes and washing lines criss-cross the dark blue sky above.

4308.meaning: a person who backs a team or politician
4308.scene: A floodlit football terrace at night. Rows of men and women in dark winter jackets stand shoulder to shoulder, singing with their heads back and their hands pressed to their chests, breath steaming in the cold. Behind them hundreds more hold club scarves in dark red, blue and yellow stretched above their heads in a long line up the stand.

4324.meaning: unusually great in size or extent
4324.scene: A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.

4328.meaning: a thick heavy fabric floor covering
4328.scene: A loose watercolour of a living room. A young woman has flopped backwards into a large floral armchair with her legs thrown up over the back, feet in the air, and has just tossed a yellow cushion up above her — it hangs in mid-air over the chair. A tall floor lamp stands to the left, a mug sits on a small wooden side table to the right, and a big window with curtains fills the background. On the pale floor in front of the chair lies a patterned rug with a fringed edge, and a second cushion has landed on the floor beside it.

4334.meaning: a workplace for practising or teaching an art
4334.scene: An oil painting of a bright, cluttered work room. A woman in a paint-spattered white smock stands at a tall wooden easel by a large window, a wooden palette loaded with yellow, blue and red paint balanced on her arm and a brush raised to the canvas. Blank stretched canvases lean in stacks against the walls and the easel, framed paintings hang behind her, jars of brushes stand on a stool and a low table, and squeezed tubes of paint lie on the table beside her.

4356.scene: A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.

4361.scene: A woman in a bright floral dress stands on a sunny city street holding up two big brown paper shopping bags, one in each hand, grinning. She then walks through a shopping centre past lit storefronts with bags hanging off both arms, adds more bags and totes, and finally rides up an escalator hugging a pile of paper bags to her chest.

4370.meaning: a strongbox where valuables are kept
4370.scene: A black-and-white noir illustration of a bank interior. The huge round steel door of the strongroom stands open at the back, its thick locking wheel and bolts showing, with neat stacks of banknotes on the shelves inside. In the foreground a man in a hat slides a bundle of notes across the marble counter to a clerk behind brass railings, while another man in a long coat walks across the chequered floor.

4375.scene: A charcoal drawing filling the frame with the outer skin of a tree trunk: thick ridges, deep cracks and hard flaking plates, with patches of lichen. A hand at the right pulls a long broken strip away from the trunk, and small crumbs fall from it against the pale background.

4379.meaning: a large open container you fill with water to wash
4379.scene: A stained-glass style picture of a woman cleaning a bathroom. She leans over a big white roll-top bath in yellow rubber gloves, scrubbing the inside with a stiff brush. The bath is full of white suds and they are spilling over the rim in a wave onto the tiled floor around her bare feet. A brass tap and shower fitting sit at the head of the bath, a towel hangs on the rail and a washbasin stands in the foreground.

4382.meaning: a large food fish of northern waters
4382.scene: A black-and-white charcoal drawing of a grizzly bear standing upright in a shallow river. A large salmon leaps out of the water in front of it with drops flying off its body, and the bear reaches out with its claws to grab the fish. Pine trees and mist fill the background.

4396.scene: A couple sit on a sofa playing a board game with red and blue pieces spread over a map board. He points at the board and talks, drinking from a green can; she quietly reaches over and moves her red pieces. When he looks back at the board his eyes go wide and his mouth drops open, and she sits back with a small satisfied smile while he keeps staring.

4400.scene: An anime-style drawing of a woman standing on a grassy clifftop above the sea, holding a battered pair of binoculars up to her eyes with both hands. The worn leather strap hangs down over her shoulders and her dark hair blows across her face. In each big round lens you can see what she has picked out far away: the open sea and a line of small birds flying over it.

4406.meaning: to make something smooth, as if by rubbing
4406.scene: A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.

4408.meaning: the sensation you get from food on your tongue
4408.scene: A man in a neon vest fills a blender jug with banana slices, mango chunks, raspberries and spinach, blends it to a bright orange smoothie and pours it into a tall glass. He lifts the glass, takes a long drink and pulls it away with an orange smoothie moustache on his upper lip, grinning at how good it is.

4411.meaning: medical care given to help someone get better
4411.scene: High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.

4414.meaning: an energetic attempt to achieve something
4414.scene: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.

4419.meaning: to move a boat with oars
4419.scene: A soft pastel cartoon of a girl in dungarees and a striped top sitting in a little wooden boat on a calm pond. She holds an oar in each hand, one blade lifted clear of the water and flicking up droplets, the other dipping in and leaving a swirl behind it. A golden puppy lies over the bow watching the water; lily pads, bulrushes, a small jetty and rounded hills fill the background.

4431.meaning: to gain points in a game
4431.scene: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.

4440.meaning: to deliver a sharp blow with the hand or fist
4440.scene: In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.

4454.scene: A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.

4470.meaning: to keep something for future use
4470.scene: A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.

4473.meaning: to give a sudden loud cry
4473.scene: A black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon set in a desert. A tall saguaro cactus with a face and a daisy on its head stands on a rock, covered in long sharp spines, looking innocent. Beside it a small round-headed cartoon character in dungarees has just touched it: he holds up one bare hand with spark lines flying off the fingers, his mouth open in a yell and his eyes wide. He is already running away, one shoe flying off and puffs of dust behind his heels, under a blazing sun and desert buttes.

4482.meaning: to make a film or photograph of something
4482.scene: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.

4489.meaning: a soft substance from plant, animal or mineral
4489.scene: A dark inked illustration of a woman leaning over a table and blowing hard at a tall candle in a metal holder. The flame is bent sideways by her breath and trailing smoke. Thick melted drops run down the whole side of the candle and pool on the holder, and beside it on the table lie a matchbox and the collapsed remains of an older candle that has melted into a puddle.

4493.scene: A black and white woodcut-style illustration of an old bearded seaman in a peaked cap on the deck of a ship in a storm at night. He is braced with both fists clamped on the spokes of the big wooden steering wheel, teeth gritted and leaning his whole weight into it to hold the ship on course while a towering wave curls over the rail behind him, rain slashes down and a lantern swings on its rope above his head.

4498.scene: A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.

4507.meaning: a label attached to something, showing its owner
4507.scene: An illustration of an airport check-in desk seen from behind the counter. A ground agent in a blue uniform and cap holds a long curling paper label and loops it around the handle of a battered brown leather suitcase that sits on the weighing plate. A second printed strip is already hanging from the handle. The passenger in a green jacket stands on the other side of the counter watching. Behind them the belt runs into a dark hatch, screens hang from the ceiling and three more travellers queue at a rope barrier.

4511.meaning: work done by one person that benefits another
4511.scene: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

4520.meaning: to spread over a large, long area
4520.scene: An ink-and-colour illustration of the Great Wall. In the foreground a woman in a long blue coat and a scarf climbs a broad stone staircase carrying a painted paper lantern, and a red flag flies from the watchtower above her. Behind her the wall runs on and on in one unbroken line: over a green ridge, down into cloud, and up again over the far blue mountains until it disappears at the horizon. Pine trees cling to the slopes and swallows dart over the battlements.

4532.meaning: worthless material to be thrown away
4532.scene: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.

4538.scene: A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.

4543.meaning: a source of danger, a chance of loss
4543.scene: A pencil-and-charcoal drawing of a huge sea cliff seen from the side. The rock face is a sheer, layered wall dropping straight into the sea, where white surf boils around its foot. A single thin rope runs down the middle of the face, and a tiny figure hangs on it about halfway down, dwarfed by the rock. Seabirds wheel in the empty grey sky to the left; tufts of coarse grass grow on the ledges at the bottom right.

4546.meaning: a room where you see a doctor or dentist
4546.scene: A soft watercolour of a doctor's consulting room. A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck stands with her back to us, one hand on a boy's knee. The boy sits on a green examination couch with his sleeve pushed up, holding his upper arm. Behind them are a cream cabinet with a tray of pens and papers, a blank framed notice on the wall and a potted plant. A blood-pressure cuff and its bulb lie on the counter in the foreground. Through the open door a woman and a small girl in yellow wait on chairs outside.

4547.meaning: a room with seats where people wait
4547.scene: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

4558.meaning: help given to a person or cause
4558.scene: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.

4566.meaning: the top point of a mountain or hill
4566.scene: A photograph taken at sunrise from the highest rocks of a mountain. A woman in an olive jacket and a climbing harness pulls herself up over the last granite slabs, one hand flat on the rock and the other arm swung up behind her, her hair blown across her face by the wind. Below and behind her, ridge after ridge of bare mountain drops away into a hazy valley with a pale river winding through it, and the ranges fade into blue haze at the horizon under a streaked dawn sky.

4573.meaning: kept private, not open or public
4573.scene: A busy diner with red vinyl booths, white tablecloths and a violinist playing between the tables. An elderly woman in a grey suit sits at a booth and slides a folded napkin across the cloth. A man in a blue shirt and tie with a gold watch heaves a brown leather briefcase up onto the table opposite her. The two of them then sit behind raised menus, glancing sideways at each other. The camera pulls back to show the long tablecloth is draped over a wheelbarrow parked at the table, and under the cloth the barrow is heaped with banded bundles of cash; they reach across and shake hands over it.

4584.meaning: a track or mark left by something passing
4584.scene: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.

4602.scene: A fine pen-and-ink drawing of a customs hall. An open suitcase on a metal bench shows neatly folded shirts and trousers; a uniformed officer in a peaked cap holds a rolled sleeping bag up above his head and squints at it. Beside him a worried traveller in a long coat stands with her hands clasped under her chin. To the right a second officer holds a spaniel on a lead, and the dog has its front paws up on the bench with its nose towards the case. Booths, striped barriers and a turnstile fill the background.

4605.meaning: a thin metal thread used to fasten things
4605.scene: A comic-style illustration of a red and cream tram running along rails set into a cobbled street. Its scissor-shaped arm is pressed up against the overhead line, and a burst of yellow lightning-bolt sparks flies off where the two pieces of metal touch. More lines run across the pink sunset sky to the corners of the frame. A girl in a yellow jacket leans out of an open tram window with her blue scarf streaming behind her, pigeons flap up from the cobbles in front of the tram, and a castle and a gothic tower stand on the hill behind.

4616.meaning: a large area densely covered with trees
4616.scene: A pencil sketch of a misty wood. Tall bare tree trunks rise on every side and thin branches criss-cross the pale sky, with fog drifting between them. In the middle a large stag with wide branching antlers rears up over a fallen mossy log, front hooves off the ground and head thrown back, its breath steaming in the cold air. Dry leaves swirl around its legs in the wind.

4622.meaning: to breathe out deeply and heavily
4622.scene: A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.

4625.meaning: to express your choice for a candidate
4625.scene: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

4632.meaning: the desk area where you set up to work or study
4632.scene: A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.

4638.meaning: the broken stones left when a building falls
4638.scene: A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.

4647.meaning: to turn round and round quickly
4647.scene: In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

4649.meaning: a child's toy bear, plush and stuffed
4649.scene: An illustration of a small boy in a striped jumper and jeans sitting on a green examination couch, hugging a brown plush teddy bear against his chest with both arms. A man in a white coat leans over him and holds a stethoscope to the boy's chest while resting a hand on his head. In the room there is a glass cabinet of medicine bottles, a fern on top of it, and a second stethoscope, a lollipop and instruments on the counter in front.

4650.meaning: a process in which substances change into others
4650.scene: In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.

4662.meaning: to give something useful or necessary
4662.scene: A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

4666.scene: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

4668.meaning: to inhale the odor of something
4668.scene: On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.

4672.meaning: tall grasses with hollow slender stems
4672.scene: A woodblock-style illustration of a pond. A brown duck with an orange bill and orange webbed feet drops down onto the water with its wings spread, throwing up a tall white splash and rings of ripples. Two yellow ducklings paddle nearby. Both edges of the picture are filled with tall green reeds and broad water-plant leaves rising straight out of the shallow water, with hills and clouds behind.

4680.meaning: a traveler who rides an animal like a horse
4680.scene: A photograph in the desert at Giza. A blonde woman with a beige scarf wrapped round her head and a loose linen shirt is climbing onto the back of a camel that is kneeling in the sand. She grips the wooden pommel of the leather saddle with both hands and swings one booted leg over the animal's back, kicking up a cloud of dust. Behind her stand the three great pyramids and the Sphinx in the dusty haze.

4682.meaning: someone who buys goods to sell them
4682.scene: A photograph in an old stone-arched spice market. A young man in a striped galabeya stands behind his open sacks of goods and pours bright orange-yellow turmeric from a big brass scoop into a sack heaped with the same powder, catching the falling stream with his other hand. Around him are more sacks with neat cones of red, yellow and orange spice, dried herbs and ginger root, with brass lanterns and a carved wooden screen behind.

4690.meaning: a place where work is done
4690.scene: A drawn open-plan office. A young man in a blue jumper with an ID card on a lanyard sits at a wooden desk in a cubicle and types on a laptop. A steaming mug of coffee, a potted plant and an open notebook sit on the desk; the cubicle wall behind him is a cork board with sticky notes and a printed sheet. Sunlight comes through a big window on the left. Behind him more people sit at their own desks with computers, under a wall clock and shelves of files.

4700.meaning: a mechanism that can move automatically
4700.scene: In a bright electronics lab a young man in glasses fits a black gripper onto the end of a jointed robotic arm bolted to the bench next to circuit boards and cables. He sits down at a sticker-covered laptop and types, watching the arm. The arm swings round on its own and holds out a white mug; he takes it, laughs and drinks from it, and two colleagues at the benches behind him raise their arms and cheer.

4706.meaning: to speak in a loud voice
4706.scene: A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.

4740.meaning: a cut or open injury on the skin
4740.scene: A grey, overcast roadside scene drawn in comic style. A young man in a beanie and fingerless gloves kneels on the cracked tarmac and holds the forearm of a second person who is sitting in front of him wearing a cycling helmet and torn trousers. The second person's elbow and forearm are grazed open and bleeding red. The kneeling man holds up a sterile wipe packet he has just torn open; the empty wrapper flies away in the air behind him. An open green first-aid tin sits on the ground with rolls of gauze, plasters and scissors spilling out of it, a loose bandage roll unwinding across the tarmac. A bicycle lies on its side in the background and a figure watches from a distance.

4778.meaning: a small workplace where things are made
4778.scene: Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.

4785.meaning: a paved outdoor area next to a house
4785.scene: A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.

4786.meaning: to shine with many small flashes of light
4786.scene: A dark tropical beach at night. A woman in a white shirt stands at the water's edge where the breaking waves shine bright blue, and bends down towards them. She crouches and drags her fingers through the wet sand, and hundreds of tiny points of blue light flash on around her hand. She draws a curling spiral in the sand that glows blue and slowly fades. In the last shot she stands back as a wide sheet of water rushes in, the whole shoreline flashing with blue points of light under a full moon and palm trees.

4787.meaning: worth a great amount of money or value
4787.scene: A high-contrast black and white illustration of a prospector's hands, dark water and trees behind them. The two hands tilt a wide round pan at the edge of a river; water and grit spill over the near rim in a black stream. Inside the pan, picked out in bright yellow against the black and white drawing, lie two solid gold bars, a heap of rough gold nuggets and a scatter of fine gold grains, with one nugget lifted between finger and thumb and glinting above the pile.

4793.meaning: to rub something smooth with sandpaper
4793.scene: A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.

4799.meaning: to fasten something with a cord or string
4799.scene: An anime-style young man in a navy suit stands in front of a tall mirror and ties his black bow tie with white-gloved hands, grinning nervously with a sweat drop on his face; his jacket and a red rose lie over a wooden chair and an open suitcase sits on a dressing table behind him.

4804.meaning: to make a trip round a place to see it
4804.scene: In a town of blue-painted houses a young local man in a striped robe leads a small group of tourists through narrow lanes, pointing things out and waving them on; they squeeze past a donkey pulling a wooden cart, walk under a blue archway and come out into a busy sunlit square.

4811.meaning: someone who is on the same team as you
4811.scene: On a sunny beach volleyball court by the sea, two players clap their hands together in a high five in close-up. The camera pulls back to show six young players in bright sports tops standing in a ring in the sand under the net; they laugh, pile all their hands one on top of another in the middle of the circle, then throw both arms straight up in the air together.

4812.scene: A young man in a knitted vest holds up a blue shirt, slides a wooden hanger into it and smooths the shoulders and sleeves flat. He holds the finished shirt up straight so the collar and buttons sit square. He then carries it to an open wardrobe where a long rail of shirts hangs sorted by colour, from white through blue to orange and dark green, and slides his shirt into its place in the row, evening up the neighbouring shirts with his hand.

4815.meaning: to move your hand over something with pressure
4815.scene: A woman in a cream blouse sits at a desk in a busy open-plan office with a monitor, keyboard and paper coffee cup in front of her. She presses her fingertips against both temples and moves them in small circles, screwing up her face. She keeps pressing, moving her hands up over her forehead and into her hair, then lowers her head into her hands and finally lays her head down on her folded arms on the desk while colleagues work behind her.

4821.meaning: the time in the evening when the sun goes down
4821.scene: Filmed from inside a car looking out of the open window across an empty marked car park. The sun sits low on the horizon at the end of the tarmac and floods the whole shot with orange light, throwing a long shadow behind a woman walking towards the car. She is barefoot in a white summer dress and carries a flat pizza box in both hands; she comes up to the window smiling, leans in and hands the pizza box through it while the sun goes down behind her.

4825.meaning: to rub something clean in circles
4825.scene: A wrecked kitchen is cleaned up. Spray foam is squirted over a black stove top covered in dried food, then a woman stacks dirty bowls and plates from a counter buried in washing-up, then a hand rubs a folded cloth over the white worktop in circles, and the last shots pan across the same kitchen completely clean and empty.

4832.meaning: a long narrow strip of high ground
4832.scene: A helmet-camera view straight down at a climber's red suit and boots as he stands on a knife-thin snow ridge. The ridge runs away from him in a long narrow crest of trodden snow that rises to a summit point, with a solid white sea of cloud far below on both sides and the curved horizon and deep blue sky beyond.

4836.meaning: to cut something using a saw
4836.scene: In a wood, a man in a blue T-shirt and work gloves cuts into a standing tree trunk with a chainsaw. A life-size bear is already emerging from the pale wood, and he saws around its shoulders and body, sending a spray of sawdust out to the side while the bark below is cut away to free the bear's legs.

4853.scene: Extreme close-up of a woman squinting through a gold eye loupe at a minute brass cog held in a pair of tweezers right in front of her eye. She sits back at a workbench covered with tweezers, tins and springs, in a shop whose walls are hung with wall clocks, and holds the loupe up to her eye. Next she points a fine tool into the open case of a mantel clock, its brass wheels visible behind the glass. Then a tall grandfather clock with brass weights and a swinging pendulum fills the frame, and finally she stands with her arms out under the enormous brass gears of a tower clock.

4858.meaning: a shape that curves round and round
4858.scene: A young man in a tie-dye shirt kneels on the floor of a big empty hall setting up coloured dominoes. The camera follows winding rainbow lines of standing dominoes across the floor, and a wide shot reveals they form one enormous spiral curling in on itself, with him crouched at the centre.

4867.meaning: the short thick finger on your hand
4867.scene: A montage of people making videos. A young man in a gaming chair with a headset shouts happily at a ring light, a lit keyboard in front of him. A woman in a kitchen holds up a big pan of chicken and vegetables toward the camera. A girl on a sofa laughs and holds both thumbs up close to the lens. A young man sings loudly into a studio microphone with an electric guitar. Finally a performer stands on a huge arena stage with arms raised, confetti falling, filmed by two camera operators.

4871.meaning: the act of signing up or enrolling
4871.scene: A close shot shows a hand writing a name into a spiral-bound book headed REGISTRATION, with other names already filled in. Two smiling staff in lanyards hand a printed name badge across the counter to a guest. Behind the desk more staff work with stacks of forms, badge printers and card scanners while a queue waits. The camera pulls back to show an enormous convention hall with a huge crowd lined up at long check-in tables.

4873.meaning: using your mind to learn a subject by reading
4873.scene: A woman with glasses pushed up on her head sits at a desk walled in by towering stacks of books and bundles of paper. She reads an open book, writes on a small sticky note and looks up in surprise. The camera pulls back and the stacks keep growing until she is a tiny figure in the middle of a wall of books and files reaching the ceiling.

4876.meaning: to spread your lips to show you are pleased
4876.scene: A woman in a denim jacket stands among stadium seats, mouth wide open, shouting and clapping. The camera pulls back to show the people around her on their feet doing the same, then keeps pulling back until a whole floodlit stadium of tens of thousands is shouting and applauding together.

4886.meaning: going up or down at a sharp angle
4886.scene: A young man with a large backpack and trekking poles pushes his way up a steep grassy mountain path; the camera follows him from behind and then from the front while the slope falls away below him to a wide alpine valley and rows of distant peaks.

4900.meaning: a neat pile of things placed on top of each other
