4900.scene: In a sunny back garden a wooden barrel rolls across the grass towards two onlookers; then a folding table with bats and balls appears, then a shopping trolley loaded with grocery bags; finally a very tall neat pile of wooden pallets stands on the lawn and topples into a scattered heap.

4902.meaning: a warship that travels under water
4902.scene: Swimmers splash and laugh in a calm blue lake; behind them a long dark grey military submarine rises out of the water with its conning tower streaming water, and then a humpback whale breaches beside it and throws spray over the swimmers.

4904.scene: Three shots of people and objects held up in precarious positions. A young man in black walks a slackline strung between two trees in a park, arms out to keep from falling. Then a very tall stack of wooden chairs balanced one on top of the other sways against a blue sky. Finally a group of men in black kit build a human tower, standing on each other's shoulders several levels high.

4905.meaning: to cover or extend over an area
4905.scene: Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.

4906.meaning: a shelter of cloth stretched over poles
4906.scene: A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.

4907.meaning: a device that converts signals into sounds
4907.scene: Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.

4918.scene: A young man in a grey hoodie jogs along a suburban pavement in golden evening light. In close-up he takes a full paper grocery bag from an elderly woman's hands. Carrying a bag under each arm, he climbs the flight of steps up to her house, where the white-haired woman waits smiling by the porch railing. His hand steadies a loaded shopping trolley rolling along the pavement. Finally he stands beside her and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

4921.meaning: a rough path through wild or hilly country
4921.scene: Two young men with big backpacks walk a narrow rough path cut through a spruce forest on a hillside. A selfie shot shows one of them breathing hard; the path behind him is loose dirt and stones. They laugh and point at each other, then climb on over a stretch of the path knotted with tree roots and rocks. At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.

4930.meaning: something you get for doing worthy acts
4930.scene: A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.

4932.meaning: to turn a wheel to control where a car goes
4932.scene: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

4948.meaning: the outline of a city's buildings against the sky
4948.scene: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

4949.meaning: the beautiful natural landscape you see around you
4949.scene: Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.

4958.meaning: a detached house in the suburbs
4958.scene: A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.

4964.meaning: to taste a little of something
4964.scene: In a modern kitchen at dusk, a man in a denim shirt with a towel over his shoulder lifts a spoonful of tomato-vegetable soup from a pot on the stove, blows on it and tastes it, then holds the spoon out for the woman beside him, who leans in and tastes it too. She smiles and nods. He then brings a bouquet of flowers out from behind his back; she gasps in delight, and they step onto the balcony and hug in front of the city lights.

4966.scene: A stop-motion style winter scene: a thick white slab of ice hangs over dark water with long icicles under its edge. A hand in a red-and-blue striped mitten presses down on the slab, and the ice separates into two parts along a jagged crack running across it, with small ice crystals and shards flying up. A frozen lake and snow-covered hills sit in the background.

4974.meaning: someone who exchanges goods for money
4974.scene: A street tea stall hung with orange marigold garlands: a vendor in an orange kurta lifts a steel pan high above his head and pours a long unbroken stream of milky tea down into a jug at waist height without spilling a drop, repeating the trick while a tight semicircle of young men film him, laugh and applaud; he then fills small steel cups and hands them round.

4976.scene: A woodblock-style print of flooded rice terraces: a barefoot farmer in a dark tunic, rolled trousers and a conical straw hat walks along a narrow earth dike, ankle-deep in the shallow water, with ripples and splashes curling around his feet. White long-legged birds lift off from the paddies behind him and a smoking volcano rises above the terraces and palm trees under a pink dawn sky.

4981.meaning: cells injected to protect you from a disease
4981.scene: In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.

4995.scene: A watercolour cartoon of an Italian town square. In the middle a stone fountain sprays three jets of water over a carved group of human figures on its basin. A young man in a striped shirt rides a red scooter across the wet cobblestones past the fountain, a pizza stall behind him. Pigeons take off in the foreground, an Italian flag hangs on a pole on the left, and the Leaning Tower of Pisa and a cathedral dome rise over the tiled roofs.

4998.meaning: a passage that goes through or under something
4998.scene: A selfie travel clip in three beats. A young man in a yellow jacket with a camera round his neck holds the phone out on a crowded city crossing at dusk, with lit screens and pedestrians behind him. Then the camera moves forward down a long shaded passage formed by hundreds of orange shrine gates standing one behind the other, with a bright opening far ahead at the end. Finally he sits at a lit night stall under red paper lanterns and eats a bowl of ramen with chopsticks.

5008.meaning: to open the lock of something with a key
5008.scene: A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.

5018.meaning: pleasing to the sense of taste
5018.scene: A soft watercolour illustration: a young woman in a pale blue traditional Korean dress sits at a table, chopsticks in one hand lifting shredded green and orange vegetables, a spoon in the other carrying a dollop of thick red chilli paste over a steaming stone bowl of rice topped with beef, noodles, greens and a sunny fried egg; small side dishes stand blurred behind, and white steam curls up across the paper.

5034.meaning: to let liquid fall out of a container by accident
5034.scene: A woman in a grey bathrobe holds up a white milk carton that is split at the seam; milk runs out of it and pools in a white puddle on the wooden table while she stares at it in dismay. She then crouches under a kitchen sink where water drips out of the plastic trap into a grey bucket. Finally she stands in a large stucco room where drips fall from the ceiling into a dozen coloured plastic bowls hung from strings, and she reaches up to steady one.

5043.scene: A hand-drawn illustration of a male lion standing on the edge of a rocky cliff above an African savanna. His mouth is wide open in a full roar, showing teeth and tongue, and his dark mane is blown back by the wind, drawn as curling white lines around him. Below and behind him dry grass, flat-topped acacia trees and purple hills stretch to the horizon, where a big orange sun is rising.

5048.scene: An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.

5064.meaning: a brass instrument you blow into
5064.scene: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.

5071.meaning: to make a machine fit to use again
5071.scene: A bearded mechanic in blue overalls lies on a creeper and slides out from under a silver car in a busy repair shop. He then works in the open engine bay with a ratchet, loosens the wheel nuts with a red impact driver, tightens them with a long torque wrench, and finally straightens up, wipes his hands on a rag and closes the bonnet with a satisfied look.

5075.scene: A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.

5077.meaning: to bring knowledge back from your memory
5077.scene: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.

5086.scene: In a high-rise office a woman in a dark uniform, yellow rubber gloves and yellow shoes pushes a flat mop across a wide stone floor. The floor she has already done throws back a clear mirror image of the ceiling lights and the windows. Behind a glass wall a meeting is going on at a long table with people in suits, none of whom look up. She works her way backwards across the hall, leaving one long polished strip after another.

5094.scene: In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.

5100.meaning: to put or fix something in place
5100.scene: A big coloured world map hangs on a wall framed by fairy lights. Four flatmates come to it one after another. A man in a green football shirt presses a small green flag and a square instant print of his face onto the map. A woman in a red jumper with a camera round her neck points at a spot, then pushes her own print and a red flag onto it. A man in a yellow t-shirt reaches up and pushes a yellow flag and a print onto Asia. The camera pans across the map showing four portraits, each held on by a coloured flag, and ends with the four of them squeezed together in front of the map, mouths open, cheering at the camera.

5104.meaning: a conversation where people exchange ideas
5104.scene: A hand-drawn cartoon of two neighbours talking over the low wooden fence between their gardens. On the left a man in a straw hat and patched overalls leans on the fence and holds up a teacup, a speech bubble full of squiggles above him. On the right a woman in a floral dress and apron listens with a hand at her cheek, laughing, while her watering can pours onto a flower bed. A black cat sits on a fence post between them, laundry hangs on a line and a smiling sun is in the sky.

5106.meaning: a building with big sails turned by the wind
5106.scene: A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.

5120.scene: A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.

5121.meaning: to take something off or out by lifting it
5121.scene: A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.

5133.meaning: to let out a sudden loud cry
5133.scene: In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.

5135.meaning: an area kept for one particular purpose
5135.scene: On a narrow town street at golden hour a woman edges a small blue hatchback into a tight kerbside gap between a white car in front and another car behind, leaning out of the open driver's window as she manoeuvres. The car settles into the gap beside the paved pavement, with shop fronts and cafe tables behind it. She then gets out, shuts the door and walks away along the pavement in the low sun.

5146.meaning: a long narrow piece of something
5146.scene: A woman in a bright headscarf and a floral apron sits on a sunny terrace with a big patterned bowl of apples and potatoes on her lap. She turns a red apple against a small knife so that the skin comes away in one continuous ribbon rather than in pieces. The red and white ribbon gets longer and longer, curling over the edge of the bowl and hanging down past her knees towards the floor while she keeps turning the apple. She looks at the camera with her eyes and mouth wide open at how long the unbroken ribbon has become. Behind her are terracotta roof tiles, red geraniums in pots and washing on a line.

5159.scene: A cartoon kitchen: a plumber in blue overalls and a red cap lies on his back on the tiled floor under an open sink cupboard, holding a big red pipe wrench. A pipe under the sink has burst and a jet of water hits him full in the face and soaks him while he grins. Puddles spread over the tiles, an open red toolbox stands beside him, a hammer and pliers lie on the floor, and an elderly woman in an apron watches from the doorway with a worried face.

5166.meaning: the pair of rails that wheels run along
5166.scene: An illustrated hillside street in an old Portuguese city at sunset. Washing hangs on lines strung between the pastel houses. A yellow tram comes down the slope on the right with sparks flying from the wheel where it meets the metal rails set into the cobbles. A young woman with a shoulder bag is caught mid-leap off the tram's step onto the street, and the sea and the setting sun fill the gap at the end of the road. Two parallel rails run from the bottom of the frame up the middle of the cobbled street.

5167.meaning: a flat square piece that covers a wall or floor
5167.scene: A selfie-POV clip through a Portuguese city. A young man holds the camera at arm's length while riding on the open step of a yellow tram down a steep narrow street at sunset. Next he walks along a building whose whole facade is covered in blue-and-white painted tiles; he presses his palm flat against them and looks up the wall. Then he is at a marble cafe table, breaking into a sugar-dusted custard tart with a fork beside an espresso, and eating it with a delighted look at the camera.

5181.meaning: your name written in your own handwriting
5181.scene: A grey-haired woman in a burgundy suit steps out of a black limousine onto a red carpet in front of a white palace lined with flags and guards and waves to the cameras, then sits at a desk and signs a document with a black fountain pen, holds the open folder up to show the fresh blue signature, and finally raises both arms to a cheering crowd from a balcony.

5184.meaning: showing or stirring love and romance
5184.scene: On a cobbled stone bridge at sunset a young man in a grey suit drops onto one knee and holds up an open ring box to a young woman in a yellow dress. She claps both hands over her mouth in tears. A close-up shows the diamond ring in the black velvet box against the golden sunset; an accordion player and passers-by watch from behind. She says yes, they laugh, and she throws her arms around him as strangers applaud.

5187.meaning: a wheeled vehicle pulled by a tractor or animal
5187.scene: A sunny mown grass field under a clear blue sky. A teenage boy in a white t-shirt and black shorts leans right back and hauls a thick rope towards himself hand over hand, face screwed up with the strain. The camera pulls back and the other end of the rope turns out to be tied to a green two-wheeled farm wagon, which rolls slowly across the grass behind him. He gets it moving, drops the rope and grins.

5197.meaning: to take part in a rebellion
5197.scene: In a big open-plan Japanese office full of identical grey cubicles, a woman in a company uniform climbs up and stands on top of her desk, glaring down at the room while the other workers sit at their screens. One by one the workers stop working: sheets of paper and a necktie fly up into the air as men and women jump to their feet and punch their fists upward. At the end the whole floor is standing between the desks with their arms folded, staring straight ahead at the camera while loose paper lies scattered on the carpet.

5198.meaning: paper you write or print on
5198.scene: A watercolour illustration of a desk seen from the side. A doctor in blue scrubs with a stethoscope round her neck holds out a small written sheet of paper across the wooden table, and a man in a brown jacket reaches his hand out to take it. An open spiral notepad lies on the desk with a black fountain pen beside it, and a potted plant stands behind them.

5203.meaning: a person related by blood or marriage
5203.scene: A family arrives at a front door hung with a Christmas wreath. A man in a patterned jumper carries an iced cake in while more people come up the path behind him. Inside the hallway there are hugs and kisses on the cheek between grandparents, parents, teenagers and children, the hall fills up, and the whole group raises glasses together for a toast.

5207.meaning: the salty fluid your skin lets out when hot
5207.scene: On a sunny alpine meadow below a wall of snow-covered peaks, two shirtless hikers with big backpacks toil up the grassy slope on trekking poles, skin glistening. One mops his face with his cap and sits down on a boulder, breathing hard; the other drops flat on his back in the grass with his arms out. They drink from water bottles and rest side by side, one sprawled on a wooden bench, the other on the rock.

5210.meaning: to move back or away from something
5210.scene: Three friends are having a picnic on a checked blanket in a park by a pond when a big white goose marches straight at them. They shuffle backwards with their hands raised, one still clutching a sandwich; as the goose spreads its wings they scramble to their feet and run off across the grass, abandoning the blanket. The goose stands on the blanket over the sandwiches, honking, while the group watches from a safe distance further down the path.

5211.meaning: a coming home again after time away
5211.scene: Keys hang in the lock of a wooden front door. A girl with braided hair hauls a sticker-covered suitcase in over the threshold, pulls it past the fridge into the flat, and stops in the middle of the living room with her arms spread wide, grinning as she takes in the familiar rooms. She spins round barefoot on the rug and then drops backwards onto her own bed, arms flung out.

5216.meaning: a slow, relaxed walk for pleasure
5216.scene: A woman in a long yellow dress with a film camera round her neck walks slowly through a narrow lantern-lit alley at dusk, then wanders between the stalls of a night flower market, and finally steps out onto a rooftop and spreads her arms in front of a city skyline at sunset.

5219.meaning: a person who shares a room with you
5219.scene: Two young men who share a flat argue over a full black bin bag and settle it with rock-paper-scissors; one of them lifts the bag to take it out, then the two cook a big pot of pasta together and hold up plates, and finally sit side by side on the sofa with a bowl of crisps, playing a video game and shouting at the screen.

5221.meaning: to move in a curving, twisting course
5221.scene: A woodblock-style print seen from above: a sandy path twists in long S-curves from the bottom of the picture, up and across green mountain ridges, and away toward a snow-capped peak in the distance. A lone traveller with a straw hat, cloak and walking staff is partway along it, small stone cairns mark the bends, and a blue lake with birds over it lies in the valley to the left.

5222.meaning: a flight of stairs you walk up or down
5222.scene: A hiker with a rucksack traces a red line across a laminated map with her finger, checks a trail information board at the edge of a forest, runs up a dusty path past a boulder painted with a red-and-white waymark, then climbs a long flight of stone steps built into the mountainside, and at the top holds the map up to the camera and points at the line she has just walked.

5223.meaning: an established line of travel you follow
5223.scene: A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.

5227.meaning: more than two or three, but not many
5227.scene: A young woman in a neon yellow crop top and shorts jogs towards the camera along a wide paved seafront promenade lined with palm trees, with a beach and blue sea on one side. At first a single black-and-white border collie runs beside her. As she keeps going, more dogs of different breeds and colours appear from both sides and fall in with her, until she is jogging in the middle of a small group of about six dogs, laughing and throwing her arms up.

5232.meaning: a boat with sails used for cruising or racing
5232.scene: A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.

5239.meaning: the act of setting someone or something free
5239.scene: A charcoal sketch. A young man in a long robe and a checked headscarf strides forward across desert ground with his gloved arm thrown up and out. A falcon is lifting off his glove, wings fully open, its leash swinging loose from his hand. A pickup truck waits on the sand behind him.

5240.meaning: a movable body part used for flying
5240.scene: A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.

5243.meaning: to plan a time for an activity or event
5243.scene: A woman in a beige blazer works at a huge blank month calendar drawn on a white office wall. She writes in a tabbed spiral notebook on the desk, then presses coloured sticky notes into the empty date squares one after another until the whole month is covered in pink, orange, green and blue notes, and steps back to look at the finished plan.

5252.meaning: from the hot wet regions near the equator
5252.scene: A street fruit seller in a conical straw hat stands behind an enormous pyramid of yellow and green mangoes stacked on her stall on a hot Vietnamese street, with scooters and shophouses passing behind her. A brass pan balance hangs on chains beside the fruit. She smiles, takes a mango, and holds open a brown paper bag; a close-up shows hands dropping spiky red rambutans into the bag over a bed of more rambutans and mangoes. A wide shot shows the whole mango pyramid with a pineapple perched on top under a blue awning. At the end she laughs happily and reaches across the wooden counter to hand the bag over.

5260.scene: A kitchen. A young man in a grey T-shirt sits at a counter and shovels a slice of strawberry cream cake into his mouth with a fork, cream smeared on his lips. A young woman in a purple cardigan appears in the doorway behind him and stands with her arms folded, staring at him. He freezes mid-bite, looks at her wide-eyed, pushes the plate away and finally hangs his head and hides his mouth behind his hand.

5261.meaning: the part you get when something is divided
5261.scene: A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.

5262.meaning: not likely to change position or fall over
5262.scene: A cartoon-style illustration of a room where a long wooden shelf has torn loose from its metal wall bracket and tipped downwards. Books, a framed picture, a ceramic vase and a potted plant slide off the tilted board and fall through the air. A young woman in an orange jumper and jeans throws herself backwards with her mouth open and her hands raised, and one book tumbles past the camera in the foreground.

5264.meaning: to change the place something is in
5264.scene: In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.

5268.meaning: a long gun you hold against your shoulder
5268.scene: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.

5274.scene: A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.

5275.meaning: only concerned with yourself, not with others
5275.scene: A claymation scene in a living room: a boy in a striped jumper and a girl in dungarees each grip one end of a TV remote and pull it towards themselves, scowling at each other. Two bowls of popcorn are knocked over and popcorn is flying through the air. A clay dog stands beside them watching, and a blank TV glows on the stand behind the sofa.

5276.scene: Two young sisters chase each other around the sofa of a bright living room. They then drape a big white blanket over the dining chairs to build a den and grin out at the camera from the gap underneath. Next they face each other across a kitchen counter, snarling over a single chocolate-chip cookie on a paper plate, and finally each of them bites into her own cookie, laughing at the camera above the empty plate.

5279.meaning: a long sheet of paper rolled up at the ends
5279.scene: A man in a dark suit sits at a polished wooden desk in a grand hall with EU and French flags behind him and writes a looping signature on a sheet of paper with a gold fountain pen. He works through a tall stack of pages, lifting each one as he signs. Then two aides unroll an enormous roll of paper the whole length of the table, and while photographers film he leans over it and signs it with an oversized pen.

5280.meaning: a post with arms that point the way
5280.scene: A woman in a green fleece stands on a country lane beside a weathered wooden post whose two arms read VILLAGE and LAKE, and she touches one arm as she reads it. Next she stands in a town square under a tall metal post covered in arms pointing to MUSEUMS, HARBOUR and OLD BRIDGE, looking up at them. Finally the same kind of post stands on a grassy clifftop above the sea and she throws both arms up beside it, holding a water bottle.

5290.meaning: a very tall city building with many floors
5290.scene: A young woman in a beige trench coat with long braids walks along a palm-lined street in a hot, sunny Gulf city, tipping her head back to look up. Behind her rises a huge curved glass residential tower, and the clip ends on a slow tilt up the mirrored flanks of an enormous spire-topped skyscraper against the blue sky.

5297.scene: A woman with a backpack walks up a cobbled path to a hilltop castle that has fallen apart - roofless stone shells, broken walls and empty window holes standing against a sunrise. She stops among the broken walls and throws both arms open. The clip then cuts to her at a railing above a mountain lake, and finally to her leaning over the side of a wooden boat drifting through a narrow gorge, trailing her hand in the turquoise water.

5300.meaning: something that is a source of danger
5300.scene: An ink-and-wash illustration of a large patterned viper coiled on sunlit rocks. Its body is wound in thick loops over the stone, the tail runs across the foreground, and the head is reared up high with the mouth wide open, fangs bared, ready to strike at whoever is looking. Dry bushes and a grey sky fill the background and a few leaves blow past the open jaws.

5304.meaning: the state of being covered with unclean things
5304.scene: A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime. She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.

5307.meaning: having a lot of open room inside
5307.scene: A man in a denim shirt sits alone in a grey armchair in a bright open-plan home, drinking from a white mug. He leans back on a colourful patchwork sofa and stretches both arms out along the backrest, taking up the whole seat. The shot then opens onto a very large, almost empty living room with a huge grey sectional sofa running around three sides of the floor, the man sitting by himself in the middle of it with a wall-mounted television behind him. People run in from both sides and throw themselves onto the sectional, kicking their legs up and cheering, and by the end a dozen friends are spread out around the whole sofa with room to spare, waving at the camera.

5317.meaning: a strip of frilly fabric that decorates clothes
5317.scene: On a wooden stage at dusk, under a web of small hanging bulbs, a flamenco dancer performs in a black dress whose skirt is built from tier after tier of folded red and black frills. A guitarist plays seated at the side and two women watch and clap. As she turns and stamps, the layered frills lift and swirl out around her legs, filling most of the frame.

5322.meaning: to eject saliva from your mouth
5322.scene: A man in a dark red T-shirt sits at a kitchen counter and tastes a bowl of green soup. He pulls a face and sticks his tongue out, gulps water from a glass, wipes his mouth with a napkin, drinks from a white mug, and finally spits the soup out of his mouth over the counter.

5325.scene: A man and a woman, both wearing wedding rings, walk together down the hallway of a house carrying a paper grocery bag between them. In the kitchen they stand side by side at a wooden counter, each signing an official-looking document with a blue pen and smiling at each other's page. They high-five in the hallway, then walk to the front door hand in hand.

5332.scene: Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.

5333.meaning: a set of stairs inside a building
5333.scene: A young man with a backpack films himself from below as he climbs one staircase after another inside four different buildings: first a plain grey concrete stairwell, then a white spiral staircase, then a wooden staircase under a crystal chandelier, and finally a huge marble staircase covered in red carpet in a grand opera-house foyer. His eyes widen and his mouth opens further at every new staircase.

5334.scene: In a packed floodlit stadium at night a big bearded man in a denim jacket gets to his feet and lays his hand flat on his chest. Around him the whole block of spectators does the same - older men in team hoodies, a woman in a black coat - all standing still and looking towards the pitch while flags are held up behind them. The camera then pulls back to show the entire stadium on its feet.

5342.meaning: the soft muscular part inside your mouth
5342.scene: In a bright kitchen a woman helps a girl hold a piping bag and pipe pink swirls onto a tray of cupcakes. The woman then dabs a fingerful of frosting onto the girl's outstretched tongue and both of them laugh. Later the woman braids the girl's hair while a man watches from the background; the girl holds up a crayon drawing of three figures under a red heart and shows it to her, they talk, and the two end in a long hug.

5343.meaning: being two identical ones that match
5343.scene: Two girls play in a bedroom that holds two identical white beds side by side, matching headboards and matching bare mattresses. They flop back onto one bed each, laughing at the camera. Sitting cross-legged on the beds they thread coloured beads into bracelets from a tray and fasten one onto the other girl's wrist. Then they pull jackets on in front of a tall mirror and dance together on the carpet.

5351.meaning: a tall lamp that lights a street at night
5351.scene: Dusk on a road beside a bare-treed park. A woman in a red beret, a knitted scarf and a fur-hooded parka holds the camera at arm's length and pulls it along behind her, glancing back and laughing. Above and behind her an ornate cast-iron lamp on a tall post burns orange against the deep blue evening sky, and a line of the same lamps recedes along the road, their light pooling on the tarmac and the pavement. She leads on into a wide open square where strings of white lights hang overhead and more lit lamps stand along the edges.

5355.meaning: someone who trains other people or animals
5355.scene: Early morning in a misty park among tall thin trees, the sun burning through the haze. A woman in a coral top and leggings stands on a low stone platform leading a group of mostly older people through an exercise routine: arms stretched overhead with hands clasped, then a side bend, then bending down to touch her toes, with the whole group copying her behind. A large ginger cat walks along the stone ledge right beside her and stretches its front legs out with its back arched, matching her movement, then sits calmly at her feet while she and the group raise both arms to the sky.

5356.meaning: the Hindu discipline of calm mind training
5356.scene: A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.

5365.meaning: an instrument used in fighting or hunting
5365.scene: A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.

5366.meaning: to give up to the power of another
5366.scene: A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.

5367.meaning: to cram something into a tight space
5367.scene: At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.

5368.meaning: to be subjected to something bad
5368.scene: A cartoon-style illustration of a young person outdoors in blazing heat. The face is flushed deep red, big drops of sweat run down the forehead, cheeks and neck and fly off in all directions, the eyes are half shut and the teeth are clenched in a grimace. One hand is pressed against the forehead pushing the damp hair back, and the background is a blurred golden street glaring with sunlight.

5369.meaning: not given to gentleness or soft feelings
5369.scene: A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.

5374.scene: A man swims front crawl through bright turquoise sea that is so low and clear that the sandy bottom and his own shadow are visible right underneath him. Boats sit on the horizon and a dolphin leaps out of the water behind him. At the end he stops swimming and kneels beside a pale sandbank, the water reaching only to his chest.

5375.meaning: to move something in a curve or arc to hit
5375.scene: A blonde woman in an orange shirt stands in a bay at a golf driving range and takes a full shot: the club travels in a wide arc over her shoulder and she watches the ball fly out over the green. The clip then cuts to a lake, where she grips a thick rope hanging from a gum tree, runs off the bank and rides the rope out over the water in a long curve before hanging from it above the lake.

5376.meaning: a device that turns the electricity on or off
5376.scene: A young man in a denim shirt stands in a dark flat at night and reaches for a white plate on the wall by the door. The lights come on and he grins into the camera in the warm light. A close-up shows his hand pressing the small white rocker on the wall plate, and the last shot pans across the now brightly lit living room with its ceiling spots, floor lamp and dining table.

5380.meaning: to get something into your hands
5380.scene: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

5385.meaning: a victory in a race or a competition
5385.scene: A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.

5386.meaning: to separate something by pulling it apart
5386.scene: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.

5387.meaning: deep sadness, especially about a loss
5387.scene: An extreme close-up of an eye with a tear welling up and rolling down the cheek. The shot widens to two friends lying together on a sofa at night under a thick knitted blanket, both crying, faces screwed up. One pulls tissues from a box on the blanket and hands one over; they dab their eyes and blow their noses, then lean their heads together and keep watching, still in tears.

5391.meaning: to look at something with fixed eyes
5391.scene: Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.

5392.meaning: an overwhelming feeling of fear and worry
5392.scene: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.

5402.meaning: the passage to your stomach and lungs
5402.scene: In a clinic a female doctor in a white coat and headscarf holds a wooden tongue depressor and looks into the wide-open mouth of a young man in a pink polo shirt. He then stands at a water cooler and drinks from a bottle with his hand on his chest; a close-up shows his neck and Adam's apple moving as he swallows, his head tilted back. At the end he faces the camera and speaks, looking relieved.

5405.scene: A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.

5411.scene: A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.

5419.meaning: moving something from one place to another
5419.scene: A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.

5420.meaning: a craft built for travel on water
5420.scene: A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.

5422.meaning: making new products from used materials
5422.scene: A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

5423.meaning: spread out across the entire world
5423.scene: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.

5424.meaning: a written agreement between two countries
5424.scene: A low, wide shot straight down a polished wooden table in a wood-panelled hall. Two men in dark suits lean in from opposite sides and shake hands above the table. Between them, open leather folders hold a signed document and a blank sheet, with a black fountain pen resting on the near folder. Behind them stand two flags on poles, one navy and one dark red, and two press photographers firing their camera flashes.

5427.meaning: a wax fastener that is soft when warm
5427.scene: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.

5432.scene: An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.

5433.meaning: to make something work by flipping a switch
5433.scene: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

5436.meaning: to move in a twisting motion
5436.scene: A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.

5442.meaning: the part of a garment that covers the arm
5442.scene: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.

5443.meaning: a union of purposes among members of a group
5443.scene: A city street at low golden-hour sun, filled end to end with people. In the foreground two hands clasp each other tightly, and behind them the crowd stretches away in two long facing rows, every person reaching across to grip the hand of the person opposite, forming an unbroken human chain down the middle of the road. The faces are serious and calm and all turned the same way. Behind the chain, plain coloured banners in red, blue and green are held up above the heads of the crowd, with city buildings and bare trees on both sides.

5445.meaning: having no beneficial use, not working usefully
5445.scene: A comic-style drawing of a city street in heavy rain. A man in a beige trench coat runs across the flooded road, splashing through a deep puddle. In his right hand he holds up a black umbrella that the wind has blown completely inside out, its ribs bent backwards into a bowl so that the rain falls straight past it onto him; his coat and scarf are flying and his hair is soaked. Behind him a big clock tower rises into the grey sky, a red double-decker bus and a black taxi drive through the standing water, a red phone box stands on the pavement and a flag whips on its pole. Diagonal rain streaks cover the whole picture.

5453.meaning: a container you put flowers in
5453.scene: An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.

5458.meaning: a substance your body needs in small amounts
5458.scene: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a grey sports top tips an orange jar labelled with a vitamin label and shakes a large white tablet into her palm. She drops the tablet into a tall glass of water on the counter; it fizzes hard, filling the glass with bubbles until the water turns bright orange. She stares at the glass with wide eyes, then lifts it, drinks, and pulls a satisfied face. A bowl of oranges and kiwis sits beside her.

5460.meaning: when your body cannot function normally
5460.scene: At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.

5465.meaning: the narrow middle of the body above the hips
5465.scene: In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

5469.meaning: a person who travels on foot
5469.scene: An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.

5473.meaning: having a lot of money and valuable things
5473.scene: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.

5475.scene: A pencil sketch on yellowed paper shows a battlefield. A line of soldiers in round steel helmets, with packs on their backs and rifles in their hands, runs forward through churned mud, the leading man leaping over a shell crater as earth sprays up around his boots. Behind them a heavy armoured vehicle with a long gun barrel, a turret and caterpillar tracks pushes through the smoke. Thick black smoke rises from a burning ruined town on the horizon, shattered tree stumps and torn barbed wire stand on the left, and a great coil of barbed wire fills the foreground.

5478.meaning: objects of all kinds, not named
5478.scene: A colour comic-style illustration of a bedroom. A young woman with brown hair has pulled both mirrored doors of a tall wooden wardrobe wide open and stands in the opening with her arms stretched out, eyes wide, as a mass of assorted things bursts out over her: shirts, jumpers, trousers and skirts in red, green, blue, yellow and pink, folded stacks toppling off the shelves, and a brown leather shoe flying out of the frame towards the viewer. Empty wooden hangers swing on the rail above her, a battered suitcase sits on top of the wardrobe, and a patterned rug, a potted plant and a pair of jeans lie on the floor.

5479.meaning: a long loose piece of clothing
5479.scene: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.

5483.scene: A young woman with curly hair and a yellow top stands at a seafront railing at sunset holding binoculars. She points at something far off on the beach, then raises the binoculars to her eyes and searches along the shore. The scene changes to a packed stadium at dusk where she lowers the binoculars with her mouth open in surprise, and fireworks then rise and burst above the crowd while she stares up at them.

5485.meaning: a container with a spout for watering plants
5485.scene: On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.

5490.meaning: a plant that crowds out garden plants
5490.scene: A young man in a straw hat and a football shirt kneels in a vegetable bed between rows of leafy green plants, a tall corn field behind him. He digs his gloved hands into the dark soil around the base of a big unwanted plant, works it loose, grips it low down and pulls hard. He rocks back, drags the plant out of the ground and stands up holding it above the bed, its long soil-covered roots and leafy top hanging down.

5491.scene: A young traveller with a rucksack and a suitcase arrives at the carved wooden gate of a tropical guesthouse. A smiling woman in a batik dress lifts a chain of white flowers over his head and settles it on his shoulders while the hosts laugh around him. A man carries out a tray of green coconuts with straws and hands him one, which he takes gladly and drinks. The whole household lines the path clapping and cheering, arms in the air, as he walks through the gate holding the coconut and grinning at the camera.

5492.meaning: a bar joining a wheel's hub to its rim
5492.scene: A rough charcoal drawing of a big tyred wheel standing upright on a workshop floor. The thin metal spokes run out from the central hub in a criss-cross pattern to the rim, and the axle stub sticks out of the middle. A gloved hand reaches in from the right and holds the wheel steady; behind it a car body is dimly sketched and spanners and other tools lie scattered on the ground.

5500.meaning: wood cut and prepared for building
5500.scene: A muted woodcut-style illustration of an open-sided timber shed at the edge of a misty forest. A young man in a flat cap and patched work clothes swings an axe down into a log standing on a chopping block; splinters fly and a split log falls away to the left. Behind him a sawhorse and a stack of round logs sit under the shed roof. In the foreground lies a neat pile of freshly sawn planks with visible grain, plus more cut logs and curls of wood shaving on the ground.

5502.meaning: the act of storing things somewhere
5502.scene: A large warehouse aisle with tall steel racking on both sides, full of shrink-wrapped pallets. A woman in a hi-vis vest and work gloves lifts cardboard boxes onto a wooden pallet beside a conveyor, building the load up layer by layer until it is chest high and wrapped in clear plastic film. She then takes the handle of an orange pallet truck, pumps it, and pulls the finished pallet away down the aisle past the racking, a forklift moving in the background.

5504.meaning: to cause something to be taken to another place
5504.scene: A young woman with a black bob sits at a wooden desk by a bright window, a green cardigan on, tapping a black fountain pen against her lips while she thinks over a sheet of writing paper. She then writes a handwritten letter across the page, folds the finished sheet, slides it into a cream envelope and presses the flap down flat with both hands. In the last shot she stands in the street at a red pillar postbox, smiling as she pushes the envelope through the slot.
